title.en: Burnham to tell Commons more public ownership is only way to grow UK economy
title.zh: 伯纳姆将告诉下议院，更多的公共所有权是增长英国经济的唯一途径

summary.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham plans to tell the UK parliament that bringing essential services back under public control is the only way to boost economic growth and "bring back hope" by addressing the cost of living crisis. He will make this announcement in the House of Commons on Tuesday, marking his first address...
summary.zh: 首相安迪·伯纳姆计划告诉英国议会，将基本服务重新置于公共控制之下是提振经济增长、通过解决生活成本危机“重拾希望”的唯一途径。他将于周二在下议院发表此次讲话，这是他16年来首次从前排议席发表演讲。

body.en: Exclusive: Prime minister wants to ‘bring back hope’ by tackling cost of living as MPs call for electoral reform Andy Burnham will drive home his pledge to bring more essential services back into public control, telling MPs in the Commons on Tuesday that it will be the only way to improve growth across the country. Burnham will address the house for the first time in 16 years from the frontbench, and six weeks since he became prime minister, after spending the summer recess announcing a slew of policies that will now be put before MPs. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：随着国会议员呼吁选举改革，总理希望通过解决生活成本问题“重拾希望”安迪·伯纳姆将兑现他的承诺，将更多基本服务重新纳入公共控制，他周二在下议院告诉议员，这将是改善全国经济增长的唯一途径。伯纳姆在夏季休会期间宣布了一系列政策，这些政策现在将提交给国会议员，这将是他 16 年来首次在众议院发表讲话，这也是他就任总理六周以来的首次。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Prime Minister Andy Burnham is proposing to re-nationalize essential services as a strategy for economic growth and to restore hope amid the cost of living crisis. This echoes the ancient call for leaders to govern with justice and righteousness, ensuring the well-being of the populace. May leaders always seek wisdom to serve the common good, remembering...
reflection.zh: 首相安迪·伯纳姆提议将基本服务重新国有化，作为促进经济增长和在生活成本危机中重拾希望的战略。这呼应了古代对领导者要以公正和公义执政、确保民众福祉的呼吁。愿领导者们永远寻求智慧来服务于共同利益，牢记他们受托照顾人民的使命。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Andrew Griffith and Tom Tugendhat join Badenoch’s top team in Tory reshuffle
title.zh: 巴登诺赫在帕特尔和克利弗利辞职后重组影子内阁

summary.en: Tory leader expected to install Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary as Cleverly quits to run for London mayor Kemi Badenoch is to reshuffle her shadow cabinet on Monday, and is expected to install Tom Tugendhat as shadow foreign secretary to replace Priti Patel. Tugendhat, a former security minister, was a...
summary.zh: 保守党领袖预计将任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣，因克利弗利辞职竞选伦敦市长。凯米·巴登诺赫将于周一重组她的影子内阁，并预计将任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣，接替普里蒂·帕特尔。图根哈特曾任安全部长，是一名领导候选人，此前曾拒绝加入影子内阁。巴登诺赫还预计将接替影子社区大臣詹姆斯·克利弗利，后者已辞去影子内阁职务，竞...

body.en: Conservative leader sacks shadow chancellor Mel Stride and shadow foreign secretary Priti Patel Kemi Badenoch sacked her shadow chancellor, Mel Stride, and shadow foreign secretary, Priti Patel, in a sweeping Conservative reshuffle on Monday, replacing Stride with Andrew Griffith, and Patel with Tom Tugendhat. Stride, who had been shadow chancellor since Badenoch became leader, was widely seen among Tories as failing to make an impression at a time when Labour had been under pressure over the economy. Continue reading...
body.zh: 克莱弗利退出竞选伦敦市长，保守党领袖预计任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣凯米·巴德诺克将于周一改组影子内阁，并预计任命汤姆·图根哈特为影子外交大臣，以取代普里蒂·帕特尔。前安全部长图根哈特是领导候选人，此前曾拒绝加入影子内阁。巴德诺克还有望接替影子社区秘书詹姆斯·克莱弗利(James Cleverly)，后者已辞去影子内阁职务，竞选伦敦市长。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Political leadership often involves navigating shifts and changes, as seen with Kemi Badenoch's shadow cabinet reshuffling. The principle of righteous rule calls for integrity and justice in all governance, even in the internal workings of a party. May leaders seek wisdom to govern with fairness and serve the common good.
reflection.zh: 政治领导力常常需要应对变动和调整，正如凯米·巴登诺赫重组影子内阁一样。公义治理的原则要求在所有治理中都秉持正直和公正，即使是在政党内部运作中。愿领导者寻求智慧，以公平治理，服务共同利益。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Two dead and at least 15 missing after flash flood in Arizona’s Grand Canyon
title.zh: 亚利桑那州大峡谷发生山洪，两人死亡，至少15人失踪

summary.en: National Park Service officials confirmed a second death on Monday following a flash flood that swept through a section of the Grand Canyon over the weekend, carrying water and debris. Dozens of visitors were evacuated by helicopter during the deluge, which damaged trails and infrastructure. Fifteen people remain...
summary.zh: 国家公园管理局官员周一证实，周末发生的一场山洪冲毁了科罗拉多大峡谷的部分地区，造成两人死亡，并带走了泥石流。洪水期间，数十名游客被直升机疏散。目前仍有15人失踪或下落不明。天气预报显示，未来几天仍有强降雨和雷暴，可能引发更多的泥石流、山洪或落石。

body.en: National Park Service confirms second death from weekend flash flood as area braces for more storms A second death was confirmed by National Park Service officials on Monday after aflash flood sent a surge of water and debris through an area of the Grand Canyon over the weekend. Dozens of visitors had to be evacuated by helicopter during the deluge that consumed trails and infrastructure. Fifteen people are still missing or unaccounted for, as more heavy rain and thunderstorms in the forecasts threaten additional debris flows, flash floods or rockfalls , the NPS said in a statement. Continue reading...
body.zh: 国家公园管理局确认周末山洪爆发造成第二例死亡，该地区准备迎接更多风暴 国家公园管理局官员周一确认了第二例死亡，此前山洪爆发导致大峡谷地区出现大量水和碎片。洪水摧毁了步道和基础设施，数十名游客不得不乘坐直升机撤离。 NPS 在一份声明中表示，由于预计会有更多的大雨和雷暴，可能会引发更多的泥石流、山洪或落石，目前仍有 15 人失踪或下落不明。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The raw power of nature, as seen in the Grand Canyon flash flood, can be overwhelming and devastating. In moments of crisis and loss, like the two confirmed deaths and fifteen missing individuals, we are reminded of our vulnerability. Yet, Scripture calls us to remember that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a present help in times of trouble.
reflection.zh: 大峡谷山洪爆发所展现出的自然力量是巨大且毁灭性的。在危机和失落的时刻，如同这两名已确认死亡和十五名失踪者一样，我们被提醒自身的脆弱。然而，圣经教导我们，雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Congressional nominee Brad Lander heckled over Israel stance at New York protest
title.zh: 国会提名人布拉德·兰德因在纽约抗议中的以色列立场而受到嘘声

summary.en: Democratic congressional nominee Brad Lander was verbally abused by protesters over his stance on Israel while demonstrating against a Hindu nationalist rally outside Madison Square Garden in New York.
summary.zh: 民主党国会提名人布拉德·兰德在纽约麦迪逊广场花园外抗议印度教民族主义集会时，因其在以色列问题上的立场而遭到抗议者的辱骂。

body.en: Lander screamed at and verbally abused as he protested against Hindu nationalist rally in Madison Square Garden New York Democratic congressional nominee Brad Lander was screamed at and verbally abused by protesters over his stance on Israel as he protested a Hindu nationalist politician speaking outside Madison Square Garden. As Lander attended a demonstration on Saturday against the event, organized by the Hindu nationalist RSS movement and where Mohan Bhagwat, leader of Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh was speaking, he was confronted by several protesters demanding that he leave the rally. Continue reading...
body.zh: 兰德在麦迪逊广场花园抗议印度教民族主义集会时遭到尖叫和辱骂 纽约民主党国会候选人布拉德·兰德在麦迪逊广场花园外抗议一名印度教民族主义政客在麦迪逊广场花园外发表讲话时，因其对以色列的立场而遭到抗议者的尖叫和辱骂。周六，兰德参加了由印度教民族主义 RSS 运动组织的反对该活动的示威活动，印度人民志愿团领导人莫汉·巴格瓦特 (Mohan Bhagwat) 在会上发表讲话，当时兰德遇到了几名抗议者，要求他离开集会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In New York, a protest against a Hindu nationalist rally turned contentious when Democratic congressional nominee Brad Lander faced verbal abuse over his views on Israel. This situation underscores the deep divisions and passionate disagreements that can arise when political and social issues intersect. The call for justice to 'roll on like a river,...
reflection.zh: 在纽约，一场反对印度教民族主义集会的抗议活动变得充满争议，民主党国会提名人布拉德·兰德因其在以色列问题上的立场而遭到辱骂。这种情况凸显了当政治和社会问题交织在一起时，可能出现的深刻分歧和激烈争论。《阿摩司书》5:24 呼吁“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔”，这提醒我们，真正的进步不仅需要抗议，还需要对所有人的正义和公平做出持久、坚定不移的承诺。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Police appeal after unidentified woman’s body found in Liverpool park
title.zh: 利物浦公园发现身份不明女子遗体，警方呼吁提供线索

summary.en: The body of a woman, believed to be in her 70s, was discovered in a bin bag within the walled garden area of Stanley Park in Liverpool on Friday. Police are appealing for public assistance to identify the woman and gather information about the circumstances surrounding her death.
summary.zh: 周五，在利物浦斯坦利公园的一处围墙花园区域，发现了一具据信为70多岁女性的遗体，遗体被装在垃圾袋中。警方呼吁公众提供协助，以确认死者身份并了解其死亡情况。

body.en: Body of victim thought to be in her 70s found in bin bag in walled garden area of Stanley Park on Friday Police in Liverpool have urged members of the public to come forward with information after the body of an unknown woman believed to be in her 70s was found in a black bin bag in a popular park. Merseyside police were contacted by a passerby who had found the woman’s body in Stanley Park, in the Anfield area of Liverpool, at about 5.25pm on Friday 28 August. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周五，在斯坦利公园围墙花园区的垃圾袋中发现了一名 70 多岁的受害者尸体，利物浦警方敦促公众提供信息，此前在一个受欢迎的公园的黑色垃圾袋中发现了一名据信 70 多岁的身份不明的妇女尸体。 8 月 28 日星期五下午 5 点 25 分左右，一名路人联系了默西塞德警方，该路人在利物浦安菲尔德地区的斯坦利公园发现了这名女子的尸体。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery of an unknown woman's body in a public park is a somber reminder of lives that can become hidden or overlooked. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, urging us to defend the rights of the poor and needy. This incident calls for our community to be vigilant and to ensure that every person, especially...
reflection.zh: 在公园里发现一具身份不明的女性遗体，令人痛心，也提醒我们生命可能被忽视或隐藏。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为那些不能为自己说话的人开口，为穷乏人和一切困苦人伸冤。这起事件呼唤我们的社区保持警惕，确保每个人，特别是弱势老人，都能被看见和关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: US singer D4vd's celebrity lawyers withdraw from murder case
title.zh: 美国歌手D4vd的明星律师退出谋杀案辩护

summary.en: The celebrity lawyers hired to represent US musician D4vd in his upcoming murder trial have withdrawn from the case. The star, whose legal name is David Anthony Burke, has been appointed a public defender to mount his defense against the charge of murdering Celeste Rivas Hernandez, 14, whose remains were found in...
summary.zh: 为美国音乐人D4vd即将到来的谋杀案审判聘请的明星律师已退出该案。这位艺人，本名大卫·安东尼·伯克（David Anthony Burke），已被任命一名公设辩护人为其辩护，罪名是谋杀14岁的塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯（Celeste Rivas...

body.en:
The celebrity lawyers hired to represent US musician D4vd in his upcoming murder trial have withdrawn from the case.

The star, whose legal name is David Anthony Burke, has been appointed a public defender to mount his defence against the charge of murdering Celeste Rivas Hernandez, 14, whose remains were found in September 2025 in a Tesla registered to his address.

Burke, 21, pleaded not guilty to the murder charges in a Los Angeles court on Monday.

A judge determined last month that he will stand trial for murder . Prosecutors have alleged he stabbed the teen after years of sexual abuse before dismembering her body.

Lawyers Blair Berk, Marilyn Bednarski and Regina Peter said in a statement to the BBC that the court had granted their request to withdraw from the case and had appointed the Los Angeles County Public Defender's Office to represent the singer.

"We continue to support David and his defence against these serious charges," they said.

"We are grateful that the Los Angeles County Public Defender's Office has taken over the representation and that David has a highly capable and committed team of attorneys and investigators behind him."

Berk, who led the defence team, has previously represented US actor Mel Gibson and film mogul Harvey Weinstein, as well as singer Britney Spears and actress Lindsay Lohan.

Deputy public defender Walid Kandeel said in a statement that Burke was "entitled to a defence that takes his circumstances seriously and carefully examines the evidence".

Los Angeles County's top prosecutor, Nathan Hochman, said outside the courtroom on Monday that his office was "ready to proceed" with its case against Burke.

He also acknowledged that the singer's change in lawyers could delay proceedings, require additional time to review the evidence, or result in the filing of a motion to dismiss the case.

Burke had already entered a not guilty plea to charges of first-degree murder, mutilation of human remains and child sexual abuse.

He returned to court on Monday to have the charges against him formally read and re-entered the plea.

The murder charges include special circumstances linked to financial gain that could make Burke potentially liable for the death sentence.

Prosecutors allege Burke killed Hernandez because the teen had threatened to reveal his relationship with a minor and destroy his multi-million dollar music career.

Evidence read in Los Angeles court during the preliminary hearing showed threats she made against him on 22 April 2025, stemming from arguments about his friendship with another girl.

"I swear to GOD I will kill u," one expletive-laden text from Hernandez read, followed by a threat to strangle him and tell her dad lies about him. "i will end ur career and ur life I will damage anything," the...
body.zh: 在即将到来的谋杀案审判中，受聘代表美国音乐家 D4vd 的名人律师已退出此案。 这位明星的法定姓名是大卫·安东尼·伯克 (David Anthony Burke)，已被任命为公设辩护律师，针对谋杀 14 岁的塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯 (Celeste Rivas Hernandez) 的指控进行辩护。2025 年 9 月，人们在登记在他地址的一辆特斯拉汽车中发现了埃尔南德斯的遗体。 周一，21 岁的伯克在洛杉矶一家法院对谋杀指控表示无罪。 上个月，一名法官裁定他将以谋杀罪受审。检察官称，这名遭受多年性虐待的少女被他刺伤，然后肢解了她的尸体。 律师布莱尔·伯克 (Blair Berk)、玛丽莲·贝德纳尔斯基 (Marilyn Bednarski) 和雷吉娜·彼得 (Regina Peter) 在给 BBC 的一份声明中表示，法院已批准他们撤回此案的请求，并指定洛杉矶县公设辩护人办公室代表这位歌手。 他们说：“我们继续支持大卫和他对这些严重指控的辩护。” “我们很感激洛杉矶县公设辩护人办公室接管了代理权，并且大卫背后有一支非常有能力和忠诚的律师和调查人员团队。” 领导辩护团队的伯克此前曾代表美国演员梅尔·吉布森和电影大亨哈维·韦恩斯坦，以及歌手布兰妮·斯皮尔斯和女演员林赛·罗韩。 副公共辩护律师瓦利德·坎德尔在一份声明中表示，伯克“有权获得认真对待他的情况并仔细审查证据的辩护”。 洛杉矶县最高检察官内森·霍赫曼周一在法庭外表示，他的办公室“准备好继续”起诉伯克的案件。 他还承认，歌手更换律师可能会延误诉讼程序，需要更多时间审查证据，或导致提出驳回案件的动议。 伯克已经对一级谋杀、残害人体遗骸和儿童性虐待的指控提出无罪抗辩。 他于周一返回法庭，正式宣读对他的指控并重新提出抗辩。 谋杀指控包括与经济利益相关的特殊情况，可能使伯克可能被判处死刑。 检察官指控伯克杀死了埃尔南德斯，因为这名青少年威胁要揭露他与一名未成年人的关系，并毁掉他价值数百万美元的音乐事业。 洛杉矶法院在初步听证会上宣读的证据显示，她于 2025 年 4 月 22 日对他发出威胁，理由是他与另一名女孩的友谊发生争执。 埃尔南德斯发了一条充满咒骂的短信，写道：“我向上帝发誓，我会杀了你。”随后威胁要勒死他，并告诉她父亲关于他的谎言。 “我会结束你的职业生涯和你的生活，我会破坏任何东西，”...

reflection.en: The tragic discovery of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez's remains and the serious charges against the accused bring to mind the prophet Isaiah's call to action: "Learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression; bring relief to the oppressed, give the orphan their rights, plead for the widow." This verse reminds us of the profound need to advocate for...
reflection.zh: 14岁受害者塞莱斯特·里瓦斯·埃尔南德斯遗体的悲惨发现以及对被告的严重指控，令人想起先知以赛亚的呼吁：“你们当学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的，给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争理。”这节经文提醒我们，尤其要为最脆弱的群体发声，倡导受害者，并确保伸张正义。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Nepal rescuers blast hillside in search of hydropower workers as families wait anxiously
title.zh: 尼泊尔救援人员爆破山坡搜寻水电工人，家属焦急等待

summary.en: Rescuers are using explosives to try and reach workers trapped in tunnels in Nepal, as the death toll from recent floods has risen to 939. Families are anxiously awaiting news of over 600 missing workers.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔的救援人员正在使用炸药试图进入隧道搜寻被困工人，此前洪水灾害已造成939人死亡。家属们正焦急地等待超过600名失踪工人的消息。

body.en:
The families of more than 600 workers believed to be trapped in a vast network of mud-filled tunnels along Nepal's Trishuli River are clinging to hope their loved ones can be found alive.

Rescuers continued battling to reach them on Monday, using explosives to blast into the hillside before pumping air into the Trishuli-3A site - fearing a critical window to reach survivors is closing.

"I wish we could find him. I wish he would come home," Anushila Bhandari, wife of Aurus Bhandari, a 33-year-old engineer missing on a project site, told BBC Nepali.

It comes as the death toll from the flood disaster on the Nepal-Tibet border reached 939, according to the country's disaster management authority.

The agency also revised its estimate of the number of missing to 3,925, of whom 592 are foreign nationals.

Roughly one in seven missing people are believed to be workers at the hydropower plants. Nepalese Prime Minister Balendra Shah said on Monday that 279 people had been rescued from the sites.

The rescue operation is being spearheaded by an international team made up of Chinese and Nepalese military personnel, while experts from India, Korea and Australia are also involved.

"I still have a 50% hope that he is alive because there is an oxygen system inside," Sita Pandey, whose husband was working in the plant when the floods hit, told Nepalese daily Kantipur.

Nepal relies heavily on hydropower and has spent years developing the projects along its mountainous river systems. At least 11 projects either completed or under construction were damaged in the floods, authorities said.

Rescuers began pumping air into a tunnel over the weekend, but the families of those trapped say that should have been done earlier.

A team was able to get into a tunnel leading to one hydropower plant earlier on Monday, but withdrew after finding no one there.

"The longer it takes, the more our hope dies. This operation must move much faster because every second is meaningful to us," Jiban Khadka, whose relative is also trapped inside the plant, told Kantipur.

Nepalese leader Shah said rescue operations had been "intensified", noting that 11,379 people had been rescued so far.

Another family member anxiously awaiting news is Priya Kharel, whose brother Milan was working as an engineer in the Upper Trishuli-1 plant when the floods hit.

"Those who returned from the hydropower site said there were people inside the tunnel," she told BBC News Nepali. "So there is hope that if the army reaches them quickly, they can be saved."

Australian engineer Arnold Dix, who has been helping Nepalese authorities with the underground search operations remotely, said rescuers had been struggling to find the tunnels.

"The actual signature of them has gone - everything is just missing. It...
body.zh: 据信，600多名工人的家人被困在尼泊尔特里苏利河沿岸一个巨大的泥浆隧道中，他们的家人迫切希望能够找到他们的亲人。 周一，救援人员继续奋力救援，他们使用炸药炸毁山坡，然后向 Trishuli-3A 现场泵入空气，担心救援幸存者的关键窗口即将关闭。 “我希望我们能找到他。我希望他能回家，”在项目工地上失踪的 33 岁工程师 Aurus Bhandari 的妻子 Anushila Bhandari 告诉 BBC 尼泊尔语。 据尼泊尔灾害管理局称，尼泊尔和西藏边境的洪涝灾害造成的死亡人数已达939人。 该机构还将失踪人数估计数修正为 3,925 人，其中 592 人是外国人。 据信，大约七分之一的失踪人员是水力发电厂的工人。尼泊尔总理巴伦德拉·沙阿周一表示，已有 279 人从事故现场获救。 此次救援行动由中国和尼泊尔军事人员组成的国际救援队牵头，印度、韩国和澳大利亚的专家也参与其中。 西塔·潘迪（Sita Pandey）告诉尼泊尔日报《康提普尔》（Kantipur），洪水来袭时，他的丈夫正在工厂工作，“我仍有 50% 的希望，因为他还活着，因为里面有氧气系统。” 尼泊尔严重依赖水力发电，并花了数年时间开发沿山区河流系统的项目。当局表示，至少 11 个已竣工或在建项目在洪水中受损。 救援人员周末开始向隧道中泵入空气，但被困人员的家属表示，应该早点做。 周一早些时候，一支队伍进入了通往一座水电站的隧道，但在发现那里无人后撤退。 “时间越长，我们的希望就越破灭。这次行动必须加快速度，因为每一秒对我们来说都有意义，”吉班·卡德卡（Jiban Khadka）的亲戚也被困在工厂内，他告诉坎蒂普尔。 尼泊尔领导人沙阿表示救援行动已经“加强”，并指出迄今为止已有 11,379 人获救。 另一位焦急等待消息的家庭成员是 Priya Kharel，洪水来袭时，他的兄弟 Milan 正在 Upper Trishuli-1 核电站担任工程师。 “那些从水电站回来的人说隧道里有人，”她告诉英国广播公司尼泊尔新闻。 “因此，如果军队迅速赶到他们身边，他们就有可能获救。” 一直在远程帮助尼泊尔当局进行地下搜索行动的澳大利亚工程师阿诺德·迪克斯表示，救援人员一直在努力寻找隧道。 “他们的实际签名已经消失了——一切都不见了。它......

reflection.en: In the face of devastating floods in Nepal, rescuers are employing drastic measures to reach trapped workers, while families grapple with the agonizing wait. The sheer scale of loss, with the death toll at 939, speaks to a sustained crisis. Yet, even amidst such destruction, the faithful work of rescuers and the enduring hope of families echo the ancient...
reflection.zh: 面对尼泊尔的毁灭性洪水，救援人员正采取极端措施搜寻被困工人，而家属们则在痛苦的等待中挣扎。939人的死亡人数表明这是一场持续的危机。然而，即使在如此巨大的破坏中，救援人员的忠实工作和家属们持久的希望，也呼应了古老的真理：雅伟的慈爱每早更新，即使在看似压倒性的毁灭面前，祂的信实依然存在。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Two dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
title.zh: 大峡谷发生“可怕”的洪水，登山者失踪

summary.en: More than 20 people are thought to be unaccounted for after flash flooding on Saturday.
summary.zh: 周六，山洪暴发，据信有20多人失踪。

body.en:
Two people have died and 14 remain missing or unaccounted for after flash flooding swept through parts of the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service (NPS) has said.

The flood hit Bright Angel Canyon and the Phantom Ranch area on Saturday afternoon, wiping out footbridges and propelling boulders downstream.

The body of a 46-year-old man was found on Sunday evening near Crystal Rapids along the Colorado River, the park service told CBS News, the BBC's US partner. Sixty-two people have so far been airlifted out of the area.

"The whole thing was terrifying," said Nikki Baggs, 41, who was among those to be airlifted out of the bottom of the Grand Canyon with her two friends.

"It was a beautiful day and then people were screaming, running," she told the BBC.

Baggs said she and her friends had just dropped off their belongings at a cabin in Phantom Ranch - a remote lodge at the bottom of the Grand Canyon - when they decided to venture out to enjoy the nice day. Before they knew it, a flood of water was sweeping through the area.

As soon as the rain hit, Baggs and her friends headed toward higher ground, where they sat at a picnic table, before rangers yelled to them to run again to a different ledge, where they waited with others for hours before they were evacuated at around 21:30 local time (04:30 GMT).

Baggs said she and her two friends had been looking forward to a steak dinner at Phantom Ranch - but were now just grateful to be alive thanks to a swift response from park rangers.

"It was a really uniquely co-ordinated effort," she said. "That's what made us feel safe about all of it in an unsafe situation."

Baggs said she and her friends watched from higher ground as bridges were swept away.

The recent rains in the Grand Canyon area, and more widely in south-western parts of the US, are due to monsoonal showers.

A change in wind direction at this time of year pulls warm, moist air northward from the Gulf of California and the tropical Pacific, triggering storms over mountainous terrain.

The storms are difficult to pinpoint in forecasts and so can strike without warning. But because the ground is usually very dry, any heavy downpours lead to dangerous flash flooding and frequent lightning which increases the threat of wildfires.

Flood watches from the National Weather Service cover large parts of Arizona, as well as New Mexico, Utah and Colorado. There are lots of showers currently showing on the weather radar and these downpours will continue during Monday.

The threat of flooding is something that will remain for many more weeks. The North American monsoon season usually runs to the end of September.

The NPS initially said it was looking for information about 15 people who were thought to be missing or unaccounted for.

It reported that...
body.zh: 山洪席卷大峡谷部分地区后，据信有 20 多人失踪或下落不明。 据国家公园管理局 (NPS) 称，周六当地时间 14:30 左右（英国夏令时 22:30），袭击发生在光明天使峡谷和幻影牧场地区。 迄今为止，已有 62 人被空运出该地区，预计还会有更多人跟进。目前还没有人员受伤的报告。 “整件事太可怕了，”41 岁的尼基·巴格斯 (Nikki Baggs) 说，她是周六与她的两个朋友一起从大峡谷底部被空运出来的人之一。 “那是美好的一天，然后人们尖叫着、奔跑着，”她告诉英国广播公司。 巴格斯说，她和她的朋友们刚刚把行李放在幻影牧场（大峡谷底部的一个偏远小屋）的一间小屋里，然后决定出去享受美好的一天。在他们意识到之前，洪水席卷了整个地区。 雨一落下，巴格斯和她的朋友们就向地势较高的地方走去，她们坐在野餐桌旁，然后护林员向她们喊叫，让她们再次跑到另一个窗台上，她们和其他人在那里等了几个小时，然后在当地时间 21:30 左右被疏散。 巴格斯说，她和她的两个朋友一直期待着在幻影牧场吃牛排晚餐，但现在很庆幸自己还活着，多亏了公园管理员的迅速反应。 “这是一次真正独特的协调努力，”她说。 “这就是让我们在不安全的情况下感到安全的原因。” NPS 表示，洪水对一些地区造成了严重破坏，该地区的步道已关闭。巴格斯说，她和她的朋友们在地势较高的地方看着桥梁被冲走。 它要求任何认识周六在光明天使溪走廊沿线的内峡谷徒步旅行者或背包客的人与我们联系。 它还警告称，预计周日和周一将出现更多雷暴和强降雨，这可能导致“额外的山洪、泥石流、落石以及步道和河流状况的变化”。 大峡谷是美国最受欢迎的国家公园之一，每年约有 500 万人参观。光明天使步道是最受欢迎的徒步路线。

reflection.en: The Grand Canyon, a place of immense natural beauty, can also become a scene of terrifying power, as seen with the recent flash floods. In moments of overwhelming crisis, when the earth itself seems to tremble, we can find refuge and strength in Yahweh. He is our ever-present help in times of trouble, a steadfast anchor amidst the chaos.
reflection.zh: 大峡谷是一个自然美景极其壮丽的地方，但正如最近的洪水所示，它也可能变成一个充满可怕力量的场景。在压倒性的危机时刻，当地球本身似乎在颤抖时，我们可以在雅伟那里找到避难所和力量。祂是我们患难中随时的帮助，是混乱中的坚定锚。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: 'I haven't lost my hope' - the search for missing loved ones
title.zh: “我没有失去希望”——寻找失踪亲人的努力

summary.en: Relatives of those still missing in the fatal floods in Nepal hold onto hope that their loved ones have survived, despite the high death toll and number of unaccounted for.
summary.zh: 在尼泊尔致命洪水中失踪者的亲属们，尽管死亡人数众多且有许多人下落不明，但仍怀抱希望，相信他们的亲人能够幸存。

body.en:
Relatives of those still missing in the massive flash floods in Nepal on Wednesday hold onto hope that their loved ones have survived.

In total, 3,925 people are unaccounted for, with at least 939 known to have died.

Follow the latest developments on rescue efforts following the Nepal-Tibet floods .
body.zh: 周三尼泊尔大规模山洪爆发中失踪者的亲属仍希望亲人能够幸存。 共有 3,925 人下落不明，其中至少 939 人死亡。 关注尼泊尔-西藏洪涝灾害救援工作的最新进展。

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal have left thousands missing and many dead, a tragedy that evokes deep sorrow. In the face of such loss, the instinct to search and the flicker of hope are profoundly human. Jesus himself wept at the tomb of Lazarus, sharing in the grief of those who mourn, reminding us that even in despair, empathy and shared sorrow are vital.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水已导致数千人失踪，多人死亡，这一悲剧引发了深切的悲痛。面对如此巨大的损失，搜寻的本能和希望的微光是极其人性化的。耶稣在拉撒路的墓前也曾哭泣，与哀痛者一同悲伤，提醒我们即使在绝望中，同情心和共同的悲伤也是至关重要的。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Company offering reward for safe return of truckload of beer
title.zh: 啤酒公司悬赏寻回被盗啤酒车

summary.en: Police are seeking a thief who used fraudulent paperwork to drive away with a truckload of Pabst Blue Ribbon beer from a California distribution center. The brewing company is offering a reward for information leading to the recovery of the 40,000 lbs of beer, valued at $25,000.
summary.zh: 警方正在追捕一名窃贼，该窃贼使用伪造文件从加州的一个分销中心盗走了一整车百威蓝带啤酒。这家啤酒公司悬赏提供线索以追回这批重达4万磅、价值2.5万美元的啤酒。

body.en:
Pabst Brewing Company has turned to social media for help locating thousands of cans of its Blue Ribbon beer taken from a distribution centre in California.

"STOLEN," the company announced. "To the thief: we don't fault you for wanting to brag to your friends how much PBR you have, we just wish you obtained it the honourable way."

The alleged thief presented false documentation at an Anheuser-Busch distribution centre in Montclair, police said, and made off with a shipment worth $25,000 (£18,500) that had been destined for San Diego.

Pabst says it is being "deadly serious" about the "ridiculous" incident and is offering a reward for help finding the 40,000lbs (18,144kg) of beer.

It was the second theft on the same day from the same distribution centre, Montclair Police said in a statement. Police are investigating whether "they were committed as part of the same fraudulent cargo-theft operation".

In the first incident, a shipment worth $45,000 (£33,000) headed for Tucson, Arizona, was picked up on 17 August but had not arrived at its destination two weeks on.

An hour later, police say thieves used fraudulent documents to pick up the Pabst Blue Ribbon beer.

"Investigators identified similarities between the two incidents," police said. "Information provided regarding the trucking company, driver and vehicles involved contained discrepancies and is currently being investigated."

Although they are separate companies, Anheuser-Busch has a contract to brew Pabst Blue Ribbon beer. It is unclear if the Arizona-bound shipment also contained PBR beer.

"What we discovered was it was just a bad actor essentially who came in and pretended to be the person who was supposed to pick up the beer," a spokesperson told CBS News, the BBC's US partner.

"It wasn't the person who was supposed to pick up the beer and then they drove off with it."

The company sought to underscore the seriousness of the crime in its social media post.

"We realise how ridiculous that sounds, but it's the truth," it said. "This is real and we are deadly serious."

Pabst also had a message for the thief: "Pabst is officially starting the clock now - you have exactly 18 days and 44 minutes to return our truckload of beer, no questions asked." The number is a nod to the company's year of founding: 1844.

The company is also offering an unspecified reward for the return of the shipment.
body.zh: 帕布斯特啤酒公司 (Pabst Brewing Company) 向社交媒体寻求帮助，寻找从加州配送中心运来的数千罐蓝带啤酒。 “失窃”，该公司宣布。 “致小偷：我们不会责怪你想向你的朋友吹嘘你拥有多少 PBR，我们只是希望你以体面的方式获得它。” 警方称，这名窃贼在蒙特克莱尔的安海斯-布希配送中心出示了虚假文件，并偷走了一批原定运往圣地亚哥的价值 25,000 美元（18,500 英镑）的货物。 Pabst 表示，他们对这一“荒谬”事件“极其严肃”，并悬赏帮助找到 40,000 磅（18,144 公斤）啤酒的人。 蒙特克莱尔警方在一份声明中表示，这是同一天同一配送中心发生的第二起盗窃案。警方正在调查“他们是否是同一起欺诈性货物盗窃行动的一部分”。 在第一起事件中，一批价值 45,000 美元（33,000 英镑）运往亚利桑那州图森的货物于 8 月 17 日被接走，但两周后仍未抵达目的地。 一小时后，警方称窃贼使用欺诈性文件偷走了帕布斯特蓝带啤酒。 警方表示：“调查人员发现了这两起事件的相似之处。” “所提供的有关货运公司、司机和涉案车辆的信息存在差异，目前正在接受调查。” 尽管它们是独立的公司，但安海斯-布希公司签订了酿造帕布斯特蓝带啤酒的合同。目前尚不清楚运往亚利桑那州的货物中是否也含有 PBR 啤酒。 一位发言人告诉 BBC 美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻：“我们发现，这本质上是一个坏演员进来并假装是应该拿起啤酒的人。” “这不是那个应该拿起啤酒的人，然后他们就带着啤酒走了。” 该公司试图在社交媒体帖子中强调犯罪的严重性。 “我们意识到这听起来多么荒谬，但这是事实，”它说。 “这是真实的，我们是非常认真的。” 帕布斯特还向小偷传达了一条信息：“帕布斯特现在正式开始计时——你有 18 天零 44 分钟的时间归还我们一卡车的啤酒，没有任何问题。”这个数字是对公司成立年份的致敬：1844 年。 该公司还为退回货物提供未具体说明的奖励。

reflection.en: The theft of beer, while perhaps a minor crime, points to a deeper issue of dishonesty and a disregard for the property of others. The Bible calls us to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with Yahweh. This incident serves as a stark reminder that integrity in all dealings, even in the seemingly mundane, is a reflection of our commitment to these...
reflection.zh: 盗窃啤酒的行为，虽然可能是一桩小案子，却揭示了不诚实和漠视他人财产的深层问题。圣经呼吁我们要秉持公义，喜爱怜悯，并谦卑地与雅伟同行。这起事件提醒我们，在所有事务中保持诚信，即使是在看似平凡的交易中，也是我们对这些原则承诺的体现。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水画面

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场致命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后发生了数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则向各大平台输送了官方内容。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: When disaster strikes, the immediate aftermath is often a chaotic mix of raw human experience and carefully managed narratives. In Tibet, the visual evidence of a devastating flood was quickly suppressed, replaced by official accounts. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that the first voice in a dispute often sounds convincing, but true understanding requires...
reflection.zh: 当灾难发生时，紧随其后的往往是混乱的人类真实经历和精心管理的叙事。在西藏，一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据被迅速压制，取而代之的是官方的说法。箴言 18:17 提醒我们，争论中的第一个声音听起来往往令人信服，但真正的理解需要听到所有方面。对未经审查的影像的压制，让我们不禁想知道，在官方叙事之下，还有哪些真相被掩埋了。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Deceived and deployed: How young Cameroonians end up fighting in Russia's war in Ukraine
title.zh: 被欺骗和部署：喀麦隆青年如何卷入俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争

summary.en: Economic hardship and deceptive recruitment practices are drawing young Cameroonians into the Russian military, leading to severe consequences. The article questions the Cameroonian government's response to this crisis.
summary.zh: 经济困境和欺骗性的征兵行为正将喀麦隆青年卷入俄罗斯军队，并导致严重后果。文章质疑喀麦隆政府对此危机的应对。

body.en:
Analysts say economic desperation and fraudulent recruitment schemes are funneling Cameroonian youth into the Russian military — with deadly consequences. Does the Cameroonian government need to act more decisively?

Cameroon has emerged as one of the  leading sources of African recruits for the Russian military , with young men lured by false promises of jobs and fast-tracked Russian citizenship, only to find themselves on the front lines of the war in Ukraine.

Ukrainian officials say that nearly 3,000 citizens from various African countries are known to have fought — or were still fighting — for Russia as of May this year; Cameroon, Ghana, Egypt, Kenya and Uganda were identified as major source countries.

In April, the Cameroonian government confirmed that Russia had reported the deaths of 16 Cameroonian nationals, seven of whom died in military action in Ukraine.

The actual death toll is likely higher, according to DW correspondent Dorcas Ekupe, reporting from Bamenda in northwestern Cameroon.

"When you look at other publications and see what is happening — even seeing families who are grieving their loved ones — the number is really much higher than what the government had earlier said," Ekupe told DW's AfricaLink program.

She described two forces causing this worrying phenomenon: economic desperation and deliberate deception.

Many recruits, she said, travel to Russia believing they have secured jobs in construction or as security guards, or that they are participating in study programs.

Banjo Herman, a lecturer and political analyst at the University of Bamenda, pointed to the key role of the the Russian paramilitary Wagner Group as well as its successor, the Africa Corps, as Moscow's primary instrument for expanding its presence and reputation across Africa.

He also cited Russian government programs such as the "African Initiative" and "Alabuga," which present themselves as cultural or educational exchange schemes but have been linked to military recruitment.

"On the surface, sometimes it looks like cultural outreach," Banjo said. "Sometimes Cameroonians are lured thinking it is for work, not necessarily knowing what is beneath the surface," adding that offers of Russian nationality within six months are also a particularly powerful draw.

France has previously described the African Initiative as a front administered by Russian intelligence services, designed to spread propaganda.

Banjo stresses, however, that the  economic situation of the recruits is typically the main motivator .

"Imagine that you are a carpenter in Cameroon who cannot even earn 100,000 CFA  francs (€150; $175) a month, but somebody is promising you 3 million CFA francs to come and work," he explains. "It is...
body.zh: 分析人士表示，经济绝望和欺诈性招募计划正在将喀麦隆年轻人输送到俄罗斯军队，并带来致命的后果。喀麦隆政府是否需要采取更加果断的行动？ 喀麦隆已成为俄罗斯军队非洲新兵的主要来源之一，年轻人被虚假的就业承诺和快速获得俄罗斯公民身份的诱惑所吸引，却发现自己身处乌克兰战争的前线。 乌克兰官员表示，截至今年 5 月，已知有近 3,000 名来自非洲各国的公民曾经或仍在为俄罗斯而战；喀麦隆、加纳、埃及、肯尼亚和乌干达被确定为主要来源国。 4月，喀麦隆政府证实俄罗斯已报告16名喀麦隆国民死亡，其中7人在乌克兰的军事行动中丧生。 德国之声通讯员多卡斯·埃库佩 (Dorcas Ekupe) 在喀麦隆西北部巴门达报道称，实际死亡人数可能更高。 埃库佩告诉德国之声非洲联播节目：“当你看其他出版物，看看正在发生的事情，甚至看到那些正在哀悼亲人的家庭时，这个数字确实比政府早些时候所说的要高得多。” 她描述了造成这种令人担忧的现象的两种力量：经济绝望和故意欺骗。 她说，许多新兵前往俄罗斯时相信自己已经找到了建筑业或保安的工作，或者正在参加学习项目。 巴门达大学讲师兼政治分析家班乔·赫尔曼指出，俄罗斯准军事瓦格纳集团及其继任者非洲军团发挥着关键作用，是莫斯科在非洲扩大其影响力和声誉的主要工具。 他还引用了俄罗斯政府的“非洲倡议”和“阿拉布加”等计划，这些计划自称是文化或教育交流计划，但与征兵有关。 “从表面上看，有时这看起来像是文化外展，”班卓说。 “有时喀麦隆人会被吸引，认为这是为了工作，不一定知道表面之下是什么，”他补充说，六个月内获得俄罗斯国籍也是一个特别强大的吸引力。 法国此前曾将非洲倡议描述为俄罗斯情报部门管理的一个阵线，旨在传播宣传。 然而，班卓强调，新兵的经济状况通常是主要动机。 “想象一下，您是喀麦隆的一名木匠，每月甚至无法赚取 10 万非洲法郎（150 欧元；175 美元），但有人承诺给您 300 万非洲法郎来工作，”他解释道。 “这是...

reflection.en: Young Cameroonians, driven by economic desperation, are being ensnared by fraudulent recruitment schemes, leading them to the front lines of a brutal war. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak up for those who cannot defend themselves and to ensure justice for the poor and the vulnerable, a principle desperately needed in this situation.
reflection.zh: 出于经济绝望的喀麦隆青年，正落入欺诈性征兵计划的陷阱，将他们带到残酷战争的前线。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为那些无法自卫的人发声，并为穷人和弱势群体伸张正义，这一原则在此情境下尤为迫切需要。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Tariffs spat: Carney bets Canada can defy Trump
title.zh: 关税之争：卡尼押注加拿大能抵制特朗普

summary.en: Canada faces new US import penalties after Prime Minister Mark Carney refused to match US tariffs on China. Other countries are watching as the Trump trade clash turns into a fight over economic sovereignty.
summary.zh: 在总理马克·卡尼拒绝匹配中国对美关税后，加拿大正面临新的美国进口处罚。其他国家正密切关注这场特朗普贸易冲突如何演变成一场争夺经济主权的斗争。

body.en:
Canada is facing new US import penalties after Prime Minister Mark Carney refused to match US tariffs on China. Other countries are watching as the Trump trade clash turns into a fight over economic sovereignty.

Canada has been quietly praised for refusing to fold under pressure from US President Donald Trump in the long-running fight over trade tariffs .

The latest talks between the North American neighbors collapsed on August 21. Until the 11th hour, both sides were talking as if a deal was within reach.

The United States then put 50% tariffs on about $20 billion (€17.2 billion) worth of Canadian goods, while Ottawa pledged to match those duties on US imports.

Until the talks folded, Canada's approach was to cut a deal that would reduce the tariffs and keep cross-border supply chains functioning, particularly in the automotive  and steel sectors.

US negotiators were, however, accused of changing the terms at the last minute, which the Canadian side said would have forced them to match US tariffs on China .

According to Ottawa, Washington wanted a say on future trade deals with other nations and to prevent Chinese goods being routed through Canada to evade US duties.

Dan Ciuriak, a senior fellow at the Waterloo, Canada-based Center for International Governance Innovation, described Trump's tariff-matching plan as "fortress North America," which he said was now a sovereignty issue for Ottawa.

"Canada is a trading nation," Ciuriak told DW. "If we align perfectly with the Americans — primarily about China — we then end up sacrificing our trade policy."

There is a recent precedent. When the US imposed 100% tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles last year, Canada followed suit. Beijing retaliated with 100% tariffs against one of Canada's biggest exports — canola.

Canada's $4.9 billion exports of canola oil, meal and seed to China were cut in half last year, according to data from the Canada China Business Council.

"The smaller country is the one that bears the brunt in this kind of game. So that's one very good reason for Canada to have an independent trade policy," said Ciuriak.

As the US-Canada talks collapsed, Ottawa also complained that Washington had sought relief from rules on French-language movies and shows. Canada said this amounted to interference in its language and culture.

Despite the uncertainty and higher cost to business from walking away, the Canadian prime minister's approach to negotiations with the US has broad public support.

A survey conducted by the Angus Reid Institute found that three-in-four Canadians backed the more hard-line move, despite concerns over the impact on the domestic...
body.zh: 在加拿大总理马克·卡尼拒绝追随美国对中国征收的关税后，加拿大面临美国新的进口处罚。其他国家正在关注特朗普的贸易冲突演变成一场经济主权之争。 加拿大因在长期的贸易关税斗争中拒绝在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的压力下屈服而受到悄悄赞扬。 这两个北美邻国之间的最新谈判于 8 月 21 日破裂。直到 11 小时，双方都在谈论仿佛达成协议已触手可及。 随后，美国对价值约 200 亿美元（172 亿欧元）的加拿大商品征收 50% 的关税，而渥太华则承诺对美国进口商品征收同样的关税。 在谈判破裂之前，加拿大的做法是达成一项降低关税并保持跨境供应链正常运转的协议，特别是在汽车和钢铁行业。 然而，美国谈判代表被指控在最后一刻改变条款，加拿大方面表示，这将迫使他们与美国对中国征收的关税相匹配。 据渥太华称，华盛顿希望对未来与其他国家的贸易协议拥有发言权，并防止中国商品通过加拿大转运以逃避美国关税。 加拿大滑铁卢国际治理创新中心高级研究员丹·丘里亚克 (Dan Ciuriak) 将特朗普的关税匹配计划描述为“北美堡垒”，他表示这现在是渥太华的主权问题。 “加拿大是一个贸易国家，”Ciuriak 告诉德国之声。 “如果我们与美国人完全一致——主要是在中国问题上——那么我们最终会牺牲我们的贸易政策。” 最近就有先例。去年，当美国对中国电动汽车征收 100% 关税时，加拿大也紧随其后。 北京方面对加拿大最大的出口产品之一——油菜籽征收 100% 的关税进行报复。 加中贸易理事会的数据显示，去年加拿大对中国的芥花籽油、菜粕和种子出口额减少了一半，价值 49 亿美元。 “在这种游戏中，较小的国家首当其冲。因此，这是加拿大实行独立贸易政策的一个很好的理由，”Ciuriak 说。 随着美加谈判破裂，渥太华还抱怨华盛顿寻求放松对法语电影和节目的规定。加拿大表示，这相当于对其语言和文化的干扰。 尽管存在不确定性并且退出会给企业带来更高的成本，但加拿大总理与美国谈判的方法得到了广泛的公众支持。 安格斯·里德研究所进行的一项调查发现，四分之三的加拿大人支持这一更为强硬的举措，尽管担心这对国内经济的影响......

reflection.en: In the face of escalating trade disputes, Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney has chosen not to mirror the US tariffs. This decision, while potentially costly, reflects a commitment to de-escalation rather than further retaliation. The situation highlights the delicate balance leaders must strike between national interest and the pursuit of peaceful...
reflection.zh: 面对不断升级的贸易争端，加拿大总理马克·卡尼选择不效仿美国的关税措施。这一决定虽然可能付出代价，但体现了致力于缓和局势而非进一步报复的承诺。这一局面凸显了领导人在国家利益与追求和平经济关系之间必须谨慎权衡的难题。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Putin-Modi meeting at SCO: Can Russia-India ties hold?
title.zh: 普京-莫迪在上海合作组织会晤：俄印关系能否维系？

summary.en: Indian Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are attending the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan amidst growing tensions with Washington for both Moscow and New Delhi.
summary.zh: 印度总理莫迪和俄罗斯总统普京正在吉尔吉斯斯坦举行的上海合作组织（SCO）峰会上会晤，此时莫斯科和新德里都面临着与华盛顿日益紧张的关系。

body.en:
Indian Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Kyrgyzstan as Moscow and New Delhi face rising tensions with Washington.

Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi  and Russian President Vladimir Putin  are set to meet in Kyrgyzstan's capital, Bishkek, on Monday on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) summit — a bloc often seen as a counterweight to US influence.

The meeting comes against the backdrop of the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran , which has disrupted global energy markets, and Russia's war in Ukraine , now in its fifth year.

India has remained engaged with the SCO while resisting efforts to turn it into an anti-Western bloc. Its position reflects a broader effort to maintain relationships with competing powers.

That approach is under greater pressure. Russia  remains under Western sanctions over the war in Ukraine. Meanwhile, India has faced US pressure over its purchases of Russian oil, alongside wider trade tensions.

A former Indian ambassador to the US, Meera Shankar, told DW that India's relationship with Russia should not be seen as directed against the US.

"India has a long-standing strategic relationship with Russia. This is not directed against any country but intended to help India meet its national goals," said Shankar. 

Energy has become the most visible change in the India-Russia relationship . 

Before 2022, when Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, it supplied only a small share of India's crude imports. Discounted Russian oil rapidly changed that, making Moscow one of India's biggest suppliers.

It has also become the most contentious part of India's relationship with the US, which has pressed New Delhi to reduce its purchases from Russia . India maintains that securing affordable and reliable energy is a national interest.

The disruption to traditional energy supplies has made that calculation more complicated. This year's US-Israel war on Iran and disruption of traffic through the Strait of Hormuz have affected India's purchases from the Gulf and pushed up prices.

Shankar said India is responding by diversifying its sources of supply, including both Russia and the US.

"In the long run, a transition to a non-fossil fuel economy would strengthen India's energy independence. But this will not happen overnight," she added.

Until then, Shankar said, India will take steps it considers necessary to stabilize supplies and protect its people. 

Defense remains the other major pillar, but here the direction of travel is clearer: India's dependence on Russian equipment has been declining.

The Ukraine war has raised questions over Russia's production capacity, delivery...
body.zh: 印度总理莫迪和俄罗斯总统普京出席在吉尔吉斯斯坦举行的上海合作组织（SCO）峰会，莫斯科和新德里与华盛顿的紧张关系日益加剧。 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将于周一在上海合作组织 (SCO) 峰会期间在吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克会面，该组织通常被视为抗衡美国影响力的组织。 此次会议召开的背景是美以对伊朗的战争扰乱了全球能源市场，而俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争现已进入第五个年头。 印度一直与上合组织保持接触，同时抵制将其变成反西方集团的努力。它的立场反映了维持与竞争大国关系的更广泛努力。 这种做法面临着更大的压力。俄罗斯仍因乌克兰战争而受到西方制裁。与此同时，印度因购买俄罗斯石油而面临美国的压力，而且贸易紧张局势更广泛。 印度前驻美大使梅拉·香卡 (Meera Shankar) 向德国之声表示，印度与俄罗斯的关系不应被视为针对美国。 香卡表示：“印度与俄罗斯有着长期的战略关系。这不是针对任何国家，而是为了帮助印度实现其国家目标。” 能源成为印俄关系中最明显的变化。 在2022年俄罗斯对乌克兰发动全面入侵之前，它只供应了印度原油进口的一小部分。俄罗斯石油打折迅速改变了这一状况，使莫斯科成为印度最大的供应国之一。 这也成为印度与美国关系中最具争议的部分，迫使新德里减少从俄罗斯的采购。 印度认为，获得负担得起且可靠的能源符合国家利益。 传统能源供应的中断使计算变得更加复杂。今年的美以对伊朗的战争以及霍尔木兹海峡的交通中断影响了印度从海湾地区的采购并推高了价格。 尚卡表示，印度的应对措施是实现供应来源多元化，其中包括俄罗斯和美国。 “从长远来看，向非化石燃料经济转型将加强印度的能源独立性。但这不会在一夜之间发生，”她补充道。 尚卡表示，在此之前，印度将采取其认为必要的措施来稳定供应并保护其人民。 国防仍然是另一个主要支柱，但这里的发展方向更加明确：印度对俄罗斯装备的依赖一直在下降。 乌克兰战争引发了对俄罗斯生产能力、交付能力的质疑……

reflection.en: As leaders gather at the SCO summit, the complexities of international relations are on full display. The meeting between Prime Minister Modi and President Putin occurs against a backdrop of geopolitical shifts, where maintaining diplomatic ties requires careful navigation. The call to 'live peaceably with all' reminds us to seek understanding and...
reflection.zh: 随着各国领导人在上海合作组织峰会上齐聚一堂，国际关系的复杂性展露无遗。莫迪总理和普京总统的会晤发生在地缘政治变动的背景下，维持外交关系需要谨慎的导航。《罗马书》12章18节提醒我们，即使在全球紧张局势中，也要寻求理解与合作，‘务要随众和睦’。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

title.en: Grand Canyon flash flood leaves one dead, about 15 missing
title.zh: 大峡谷山洪暴发致一人死亡，约15人失踪

summary.en: A major flash flood at the Grand Canyon has led to evacuations from the popular tourist site, with at least one person confirmed dead and approximately 15 others missing.
summary.zh: 美国大峡谷发生重大山洪暴发，迫使游客撤离。目前已确认一人死亡，约15人失踪。

body.en:
At least one person was killed and around 15 others are missing after a flash flood at the Grand Canyon, one of the most popular tourist sites in the United States, the National Park Service said.

The floods hit the Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area on Sunday AEST, forcing dozens of people to evacuate and damaging the park's sole water pipeline.

The body of a 46-year-old man was recovered on Monday near Crystal Rapids along the Colorado River in northern Arizona, the park service said.

Video footage taken by hikers showed a torrent of muddy water rushing by trails and under footbridges, along with logs and other debris floating down swollen rivers, accompanied by a rumbling roar.

The park service said it was working with Arizona authorities to evacuate people and account for missing individuals.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As of Monday, 62 people had been evacuated, with others scheduled for later, it said.

It said around 15 people were thought to be missing, revising an earlier figure of more than 20.

The flooding damaged the Transcanyon Waterline, a key water pipeline into Grand Canyon National Park, the park service said, announcing water restrictions in its most visited area and a ban on wood and charcoal fires.

The 20-kilometre pipeline runs from the Roaring Springs source on the North Rim to the South Rim, providing drinking water and fire suppression, according to the park's website.

The flooding also resulted in "significant impacts to infrastructure," destroying footbridges and blocking hikers from crossing Bright Angel Creek, the park service said.

"These measures are crucial for ensuring the safety and sustainability of water resources," the park service said.

The flash flood, which began about 7:30 am on Sunday, was caused by rain on the Kaibab Plateau, it said.

More thunderstorms and heavy rainfall were possible through Monday, possibly leading to "additional flash flooding, debris flows, rockfall and changing trail and river conditions," the park service warned.

Flash floods are common in Northern Arizona because the arid, sparsely vegetated environments found in the area have little capacity to absorb rain, the park's website said, urging visitors to be especially cautious from July to mid-September.

The Grand Canyon — considered one of the greatest wonders of the natural world — is the result of the Colorado River eating away at layers of red sandstone and other rock for millions of years, leaving a chasm up to 18 miles wide and more than a mile deep.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 美国最受欢迎的旅游景点之一大峡谷发生山洪，造成至少 1 人死亡、约 15 人失踪，国家公园管理局表示。 澳大利亚东部标准时间周日，洪水袭击了光明天使峡谷和幻影牧场地区，迫使数十人撤离，并损坏了公园唯一的输水管道。 公园管理局称，周一在亚利桑那州北部科罗拉多河沿岸的水晶急流附近发现了一具 46 岁男子的尸体。 徒步旅行者拍摄的视频显示，泥水从小径和人行天桥下奔流而下，原木和其他碎片沿着汹涌的河流漂流，伴随着隆隆的轰鸣声。 公园管理局表示，正在与亚利桑那州当局合作疏散人员并查明失踪人员的下落。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 据称，截至周一，已有 62 人被疏散，其他人也计划稍后疏散。 据称大约有 15 人失踪，此前的数字为 20 多人。 公园管理局表示，洪水损坏了跨峡谷水线，这是通往大峡谷国家公园的一条重要输水管道，并宣布在游客最多的地区实施用水限制，并禁止燃木和木炭。 据公园网站称，这条长达 20 公里的管道从北缘的咆哮泉源头一直延伸到南缘，提供饮用水和灭火服务。 公园管理局表示，洪水还对基础设施造成了“重大影响”，摧毁了人行天桥，并阻止徒步旅行者穿越光明天使溪。 公园管理局表示：“这些措施对于确保水资源的安全和可持续性至关重要。” 据称，周日上午 7 点 30 分左右开始的山洪是由凯巴布高原的降雨引起的。 公园管理局警告称，周一可能会出现更多雷暴和强降雨，可能导致“额外的山洪、泥石流、落石以及步道和河流状况的变化”。 公园网站称，山洪在亚利桑那州北部很常见，因为该地区干旱、植被稀疏的环境几乎没有能力吸收雨水，并敦促游客在七月至九月中旬期间特别小心。 大峡谷被认为是自然界最伟大的奇观之一，是科罗拉多河数百万年来侵蚀红砂岩和其他岩石层的结果，留下了宽达 18 英里、深超过 1 英里的峡谷。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The raw power of nature can bring sudden tragedy, as seen in the Grand Canyon flash flood. In moments of profound loss, we are reminded of the deep human longing for a world free from such suffering. The biblical vision offers hope for a future where 'death shall be no more, neither shall there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain anymore.'
reflection.zh: 自然的巨大力量有时会带来突如其来的悲剧，大峡谷的山洪暴发便是如此。在深切的失落时刻，我们被提醒人类内心深处渴望一个不再有痛苦的世界。圣经的启示带来了盼望，预言未来‘不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭嚎、疼痛。’

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Where are the thousands missing in Nepal's floods from?
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水失踪的数千人来自何处？

summary.en: People from dozens of countries are unaccounted for after the disaster.
summary.zh: 灾难过后，数十个国家的人员下落不明。

body.en:
At least 4,793 people were listed as missing on Monday, with a further 919 confirmed dead, after the flash floods and landslides that hit the Nepal-Tibet border.

The figures are likely to change, which is not uncommon in the chaos after a major disaster.

Nepal's disaster agency increased the total number of people missing on its side of the border to 4,247 on Monday, saying there were also 903 confirmed deaths.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The number of missing in Tibet is 546, with 16 others dead, China's state broadcaster CCTV reported on Sunday.

Nepal's disaster agency said Monday that 592 foreigners were unaccounted for, without listing them by nationality.

Chinese officials said Sunday at least 261 foreign nationals were among those unaccounted for there.

In India, authorities said they had recovered seven bodies from rivers flowing from Nepal, believed to be flood victims. However, at this time they are not included in the toll.

Among the missing are 933 people working on hydropower projects, 45 Nepali Army soldiers, 38 police and armed police officers and 18 customs and immigration officers.

China's foreign ministry said on Thursday that nearly 100 Chinese nationals were among the missing in Nepal.

The Nepal Tourism Board said eight Chinese were unaccounted for but that 16 had been rescued.

India's foreign ministry said on Saturday that 275 citizens were missing, and an additional 128 persons of Indian origin. Around 900 Indian nationals are still on the Chinese side but are safe and contactable.

Chinese state media said on Sunday that 49 Indian nationals were missing in Tibet.

About 85 US citizens were missing, the State Department said on Sunday, adding that nine had been rescued. It said it was not aware of any US fatalities.

The Nepal Tourism Board put the figure at 65 missing on Friday, and two rescued.

Eighteen US citizens were still missing in Tibet, Chinese state media said on Sunday.

The Nepal Tourism Board put the number of Ukrainians still missing on Friday at 61.

Ukraine's embassy in Nepal said on Friday it was aware of 62 of its citizens with whom contact had been lost, revising its earlier numbers upwards by six.

Thirty-three people from the United Kingdom were missing, the Nepal Tourism Board figures showed on Friday.

In Tibet, 15 people from the United Kingdom were missing, Chinese state media said.

The Nepal Tourism Board said 25 Canadians were among the missing on Friday. Canada's foreign ministry put the figure at 30 in both Nepal and Tibet.

The Nepal Tourism Board said on Friday that nine South Korean tourists were missing.

In such moments of chaos and loss, the call to advocate for the vulnerable, to seek out the lost, and to offer comfort to those left behind resonates deeply. We are reminded to be a voice...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔发生的这场灾难规模巨大，全球数千人失踪，这凸显了生命的脆弱以及我们世界的相互关联。在如此混乱和失落的时刻，为弱者发声、寻找失踪者、安慰幸存者的呼吁显得尤为重要。我们被提醒要为那些被悲剧剥夺声音的人们发出声音。

title.en: Why China is censoring footage of the Nepal-Tibet disaster
title.zh: 中国为何审查尼泊尔-西藏灾难的视频

summary.en: A catastrophic flood in Tibet, bordering Nepal, has brought attention to China's strict controls on information from the region. While videos of the disaster circulated internationally, they were notably absent from Chinese media, underscoring the sensitivity and tight regulation surrounding Tibet.
summary.zh: 一场发生在尼泊尔边境的西藏的灾难性洪水事件，引起了人们对中国对该地区信息传播的严格控制的关注。尽管灾难视频在国际上广泛传播，但在中国媒体上却鲜有报道，这凸显了西藏问题的敏感性和严格的监管。

body.en:
A natural disaster may not seem inherently political. But in Tibet, even footage of a flood can be sensitive.

As videos circulated widely on social media and in news reports last week, showing a devastating torrent of mud, water and debris tearing through a border post between Tibet and Nepal, correspondents in Beijing began to point out a striking absence: in China, the footage was nowhere to be seen.

The apparent censorship highlights the extraordinary sensitivity surrounding Tibet, one of the most tightly controlled regions under Chinese control, and the long and highly contested history stretching back hundreds of years.

Tsering Yangzom, a member of the Tibetan community in Newcastle, NSW, told SBS News her uncle works in the flood-affected region of Tibet, but she's been unable to contact him since the disaster and appears to have been blocked.

She suspects he may be concerned their communications are being monitored, but she's also "really, really worried" about whether he was affected by the deadly floods.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Normally, she says they speak briefly and intermittently on the Chinese messaging app WeChat, sometimes using coded language to protect her uncle.

"If he says the weather is good, then we can talk a little bit more about the normal life," she said. "But if he says the weather is not good and rainy or something ... that means that I can't talk much."

Human Rights Watch's Australia director, Daniela Gavshon, told SBS News censorship and self-censorship are pervasive in Tibetan areas.

"These information controls make it even harder to get accurate information, for families to locate loved ones, or to develop a good understanding of the disaster, its scale, its impact, and the response."

Tibet, isolated both geographically and diplomatically, sits atop a vast area of mountains and plateaus and is often referred to as the "roof of the world".

For centuries, it has had a complicated relationship with China. Beijing maintains that Tibet has been part of China since ancient times, while Tibetans say it had long been independent with its own unique culture, religion and language.

In 1950, troops from China's newly established communist government invaded Tibet and defeated Tibetan forces, in a move the Chinese government described as part of the "peaceful liberation" of the region.

The following year, Tibetan representatives signed an agreement recognising Chinese sovereignty over Tibet, while promising the region autonomy. Tibetan leaders say they were forced into this agreement.

Tensions over Chinese rule grew in the following years, leading to an uprising in 1959 in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa....
body.zh: 自然灾害似乎本质上并不具有政治性。但在西藏，即使是洪水的镜头也可能很敏感。 上周，视频在社交媒体和新闻报道中广泛传播，视频显示泥浆、水和碎片席卷了西藏和尼泊尔之间的边境哨所，造成毁灭性的洪流，北京的记者开始指出一个惊人的缺席：在中国，这段视频无处可见。 明显的审查制度突显了西藏的非凡敏感性，西藏是中国控制下控制最严格的地区之一，而且其历史可以追溯到数百年前，历史悠久且充满争议。 新南威尔士州纽卡斯尔藏族社区成员次仁央宗 (Tsering Yangzom) 告诉 SBS 新闻，她的叔叔在西藏受洪水影响的地区工作，但自灾难发生以来，她一直无法联系到他，而且似乎已被封锁。 她怀疑他可能担心他们的通讯受到监控，但她也“非常非常担心”他是否受到致命洪水的影响。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 她说，通常情况下，他们会在中国通讯应用微信上断断续续地简短交谈，有时会使用密码语言来保护她的叔叔。 “如果他说天气好，那么我们就可以多谈谈正常的生活，”她说。 “但如果他说天气不好，下雨什么的……那就意味着我不能说太多。” 人权观察组织澳大利亚主任丹妮拉·加夫尚 (Daniela Gavshon) 告诉 SBS 新闻，审查和自我审查在藏族地区十分普遍。 “这些信息控制使得家人更难获得准确的信息、找到亲人，或更好地了解灾难、其规模、影响和应对措施。” 西藏地处广阔的山脉和高原之上，在地理和外交上与世隔绝，通常被称为“世界屋脊”。 几个世纪以来，它与中国有着复杂的关系。北京坚称西藏自古以来就是中国的一部分，而藏人则表示西藏早已独立，拥有自己独特的文化、宗教和语言。 1950年，中国新成立的共产党政府的军队入侵西藏并击败了西藏军队，中国政府称此举是该地区“和平解放”的一部分。 次年，西藏代表签署了一项协议，承认中国对西藏拥有主权，同时承诺实行区域自治。西藏领导人表示，他们是被迫签署这项协议的。 接下来的几年里，围绕中国统治的紧张局势加剧，导致 1959 年西藏首府拉萨发生起义。

reflection.en: The news from Tibet reveals how even natural disasters can become entangled with political sensitivities, leading to censorship. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that when rulers suppress information and ignore the people's cries, the nation suffers. May leaders learn to govern with justice and transparency, allowing truth to flow freely, even in times of crisis.
reflection.zh: 来自西藏的新闻揭示了即使是自然灾害也可能因政治敏感性而受到审查。箴言29:2提醒我们，当统治者压制信息并忽视人民的呼声时，国家就会遭受苦难。愿领导者学会以公正和透明的方式执政，让真理自由流淌，即使在危机时刻。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Number of missing Australians in Nepal rises, as China links disaster to climate change
title.zh: 澳大利亚人在尼泊尔失踪人数增加，中国将灾难归咎于气候变化

summary.en: Australians are raising millions for Nepal disaster survivors as the death toll rises and thousands remain missing.
summary.zh: 随着死亡人数的增加和数千人失踪，澳大利亚人正在为尼泊尔灾难幸存者筹集数百万美元的援助。

body.en:
Australians have raised millions of dollars to assist survivors of the Nepal disaster, with many forced into temporary shelters amid mud and chaos.

Authorities said the death toll rose to nearly 800 on Sunday, with more than 3,000 people missing on both sides of the Nepal-China border after a torrent of ice, rock, mud and debris swept through mountain valleys and rivers on Wednesday, causing widespread devastation.

The federal government has announced a further $3 million in humanitarian support for Nepal, including supplies transported by the Australian Defence Force. It brings Australia's total assistance to $8 million.

The survivors remain in desperate need of basic amenities like clean drinking water and medical supplies.

Among them, Rabindra Hamal told the Australian Associated Press (AAP) news agency he and his colleagues working at a dam site were told to flee just minutes before the flood hit their area on Wednesday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They made their escape by car, but as they later tried to reach higher ground by foot, two of the group were swept away.

The group continued to scramble to safety but were forced to wait until the following day to be rescued.

They were flown by helicopter to a nearby army barracks and then evacuated to Kathmandu.

Hamal said that of the several thousand people working on the hydro project, about 500 were still missing.

As of Sunday evening, the number of missing Australians rose to 43, with the federal government continuing to do everything possible to confirm their welfare.

A public candlelight vigil will be held at Melbourne's Federation Square on Monday evening, in memory of those lost in the disaster.

A joint call for aid from the Emergency Action Alliance (EAA), made up of 15 prominent charities, has raised more than $3.5 million, including $2 million in contributions from the federal government.

The funding is going towards providing much-needed emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, healthcare, hygiene and sanitation services, and supporting longer-term recovery assistance.

Save the Children is one of the organisations participating in the alliance, with the group's global media manager Amy Lefevre, visiting the affected Nuwakot district on Saturday.

"It's just mud everywhere, there's also a lot of confusion and chaos," she told AAP.

"It's just incredibly sad when you look around and you see someone's shoes stuck in the mud, or people's belongings strewn everywhere.

"It's very much still a rescue operation but of course, today is day five, and I think the chance of finding people alive is slowly dimming."

For those who did survive, many families have been ripped...
body.zh: 澳大利亚人筹集了数百万美元来援助尼泊尔灾难的幸存者，许多人在泥泞和混乱中被迫进入临时避难所。 当局表示，周三冰块、岩石、泥浆和碎片席卷山谷和河流，造成大范围破坏，周日死亡人数上升至近800人，中尼边境两侧有3000多人失踪。 联邦政府宣布向尼泊尔再提供300万美元的人道主义支持，其中包括澳大利亚国防军运送的物资。这使得澳大利亚的援助总额达到 800 万美元。 幸存者仍然迫切需要清洁饮用水和医疗用品等基本设施。 其中，拉宾德拉·哈马尔 (Rabindra Hamal) 告诉澳大利亚美联社 (AAP)，周三洪水袭击他们所在地区的几分钟前，他和在水坝工地工作的同事被告知逃离。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们乘汽车逃跑，但当他们后来试图步行到达更高的地方时，其中两人被卷走了。 这群人继续爬向安全地带，但被迫等到第二天才获救。 他们乘坐直升机飞往附近的军营，然后疏散到加德满都。 哈马尔表示，在水电项目上工作的数千人中，仍有约 500 人失踪。 截至周日晚上，失踪的澳大利亚人人数上升至43人，联邦政府继续尽一切可能确认他们的福利。 周一晚上，墨尔本联邦广场将举行公众烛光守夜活动，以纪念在灾难中丧生的人们。 由 15 个知名慈善机构组成的紧急行动联盟 (EAA) 联合呼吁提供援助，已筹集了超过 350 万美元，其中包括联邦政府的 200 万美元捐款。 这笔资金将用于提供急需的紧急住所、食品、安全饮用水、医疗保健、卫生和环境卫生服务，并支持长期恢复援助。 救助儿童会是参与该联盟的组织之一，该组织的全球媒体经理 Amy Lefevre 于周六访问了受影响的努瓦科特地区。 她告诉澳联社：“到处都是泥巴，还有很多混乱和混乱。” “当你环顾四周，看到有人的鞋子陷在泥里，或者人们的财物散落各处时，真是令人难以置信的悲伤。 “这仍然是一次救援行动，但当然，今天已经是第五天了，我认为找到生还者的机会正在慢慢变小。” 对于那些幸存下来的人来说，许多家庭都被撕裂了……

title.en: How China buried Tibet flood images after Nepal disaster
title.zh: 中国如何掩埋了尼泊尔灾难后的西藏洪水画面

summary.en: In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.
summary.zh: 在西藏，一场夺走生命的洪水摧毁了中国和尼泊尔边境的社区，随后紧随而来的是一场数字审查。审查人员删除了病毒式传播的画面，而中国官方媒体则用官方内容充斥了各大平台。

body.en:
In Tibet, a digital crackdown followed the deadly flood that has devastated communities along the China-Nepal border. Censors erased viral footage while Chinese state media flooded platforms with official content.

When a catastrophic flash flood swept through the rugged China-Nepal border on August 26, the physical devastation was immediate.

In Nepal , a black torrent of mud and rock tore through communities, leaving hundreds dead and thousands more missing along the borderlands.

But across the frontier in Tibet, an autonomous region of China , the physical disaster was almost instantly followed by a digital one: the rapid, high-tech erasure of the catastrophe's visual evidence.

As survivors tried to upload raw footage of the deluge, China's state-backed information control apparatus swung into action, executing a sophisticated, precision operation to shape the public narrative and bury inconvenient truths.

The contrasting realities — a tragic humanitarian crisis in Nepal and a tightly sanitized, triumphant rescue narrative in China — reveal the evolving mechanics of Beijing's modern censorship machine.

Rather than imposing a blunt, blanket blackout, authorities deployed advanced image-recognition technology and "saturated information" tactics to drown out domestic scrutiny while deflecting diplomatic friction abroad.

In the immediate aftermath of the flood-triggered mudslide, local residents captured dramatic footage of the torrent engulfing Gyirong Port, a critical overland trade hub between China and Nepal.

The most striking video showed a black wall of water and debris crashing into and destroying the "national" border gate.

In an article titled "An Unrecorded Mudslide Rushes into Gyirong Port" on China's WeChat, a universal app that combines messaging with payment options and social media functions, local blogger "Matou Qingnian" described the chaotic scene.

"The most terrifying moment happened at the Gyirong Port," the author wrote, describing video footage of crowds, including children, fleeing in panic before a pitch-black torrent swallowed the camera's view.

Within hours, both the article and the raw video footage had vanished from Chinese social media .

According to  China Digital Times (CDT) , an independent watchdog that tracks Chinese internet censorship , the video of the collapsing border gate was systematically blocked from being shared on WeChat, even in private messages.

"The footage itself contained no graphic violence, no protests, and no political slogans," explained Mira, a CDT editor who specializes in tracking sensitive keywords and media. "The target of the censorship was the symbol itself: the National Gate."

Digital analysts note that this censorship highlights a significant upgrade...
body.zh: 在西藏，致命的洪水摧毁了中尼边境沿线的社区，随后进行了数字镇压。审查机构删除了病毒式传播的视频，而中国官方媒体则在平台上充斥着官方内容。 8 月 26 日，一场灾难性的山洪席卷崎岖的中尼边境，造成了立即的破坏。 在尼泊尔，一股黑色泥浆和岩石洪流席卷了边境地区的社区，造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪。 但在中国西藏自治区的边境地区，这场物理灾难几乎立刻就发生了一场数字灾难：灾难的视觉证据被迅速、高科技删除。 当幸存者试图上传洪水的原始镜头时，中国国家支持的信息控制机构立即采取行动，执行复杂而精确的操作，以塑造公众叙事并掩盖难以忽视的真相。 对比鲜明的现实——尼泊尔悲惨的人道主义危机和中国严密消毒、胜利的救援故事——揭示了北京现代审查机制不断演变的机制。 当局没有实施生硬、全面的封锁，而是采用了先进的图像识别技术和“饱和信息”策略来淹没国内审查，同时转移国外的外交摩擦。 洪水引发的泥石流发生后，当地居民拍下了洪流吞没吉隆港的戏剧性镜头，吉隆港是中国和尼泊尔之间重要的陆路贸易枢纽。 最引人注目的视频显示，黑色的水墙和碎片冲撞并摧毁了“国家”边境大门。 当地博主“马头青年”在中国微信（一款将消息传递、支付选项和社交媒体功能结合在一起的通用应用程序）上发表了一篇题为“一场未记录的泥石流冲进吉隆口岸”的文章，描述了当时的混乱场面。 “最可怕的时刻发生在吉隆口岸，”作者写道，并描述了包括儿童在内的人群在漆黑的洪流吞没摄像机视野之前惊慌失措的画面。 几个小时内，这篇文章和原始视频片段就从中国社交媒体上消失了。 据追踪中国互联网审查制度的独立监管机构中国数字时代（CDT）称，倒塌边境大门的视频被系统性地禁止在微信上分享，甚至在私人信息中也是如此。 专门跟踪敏感关键词和媒体的 CDT 编辑米拉解释说：“视频本身不包含暴力画面、抗议活动和政治口号。” “审查的目标是标志本身：国门。” 数字分析师指出，这次审查凸显了重大升级......

reflection.en: The story highlights how visual evidence of a devastating flood in Tibet was quickly erased by censors, silencing the suffering of affected communities. This act of suppression leaves the voiceless unheard, a stark contrast to the biblical call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves and to ensure their suffering is not ignored.
reflection.zh: 这篇报道揭示了西藏一场毁灭性洪水的视觉证据如何被审查人员迅速抹去，从而压制了受灾社区的苦难之声。这种压制行为使得无声者无法被听见，与圣经中呼吁为不能言语者说话、确保他们的苦难不被忽视的教导形成了鲜明对比。

title.en: Why China is censoring footage of the Nepal-Tibet disaster
title.zh: 中国为何审查尼泊尔-西藏灾难的视频

summary.en: A catastrophic flood in Tibet, bordering Nepal, has brought attention to China's strict controls on information from the region. While videos of the disaster circulated internationally, they were notably absent from Chinese media, underscoring the sensitivity and tight regulation surrounding Tibet.
summary.zh: 一场发生在尼泊尔边境的西藏的灾难性洪水事件，引起了人们对中国对该地区信息传播的严格控制的关注。尽管灾难视频在国际上广泛传播，但在中国媒体上却鲜有报道，这凸显了西藏问题的敏感性和严格的监管。

body.en:
A natural disaster may not seem inherently political. But in Tibet, even footage of a flood can be sensitive.

As videos circulated widely on social media and in news reports last week, showing a devastating torrent of mud, water and debris tearing through a border post between Tibet and Nepal, correspondents in Beijing began to point out a striking absence: in China, the footage was nowhere to be seen.

The apparent censorship highlights the extraordinary sensitivity surrounding Tibet, one of the most tightly controlled regions under Chinese control, and the long and highly contested history stretching back hundreds of years.

Tsering Yangzom, a member of the Tibetan community in Newcastle, NSW, told SBS News her uncle works in the flood-affected region of Tibet, but she's been unable to contact him since the disaster and appears to have been blocked.

She suspects he may be concerned their communications are being monitored, but she's also "really, really worried" about whether he was affected by the deadly floods.
