Normally, she says they speak briefly and intermittently on the Chinese messaging app WeChat, sometimes using coded language to protect her uncle.

"If he says the weather is good, then we can talk a little bit more about the normal life," she said. "But if he says the weather is not good and rainy or something ... that means that I can't talk much."

Human Rights Watch's Australia director, Daniela Gavshon, told SBS News censorship and self-censorship are pervasive in Tibetan areas.

"These information controls make it even harder to get accurate information, for families to locate loved ones, or to develop a good understanding of the disaster, its scale, its impact, and the response."

Tibet, isolated both geographically and diplomatically, sits atop a vast area of mountains and plateaus and is often referred to as the "roof of the world".

For centuries, it has had a complicated relationship with China. Beijing maintains that Tibet has been part of China since ancient times, while Tibetans say it had long been independent with its own unique culture, religion and language.

In 1950, troops from China's newly established communist government invaded Tibet and defeated Tibetan forces, in a move the Chinese government described as part of the "peaceful liberation" of the region.

The following year, Tibetan representatives signed an agreement recognising Chinese sovereignty over Tibet, while promising the region autonomy. Tibetan leaders say they were forced into this agreement.

Tensions over Chinese rule grew in the following years, leading to an uprising in 1959 in the Tibetan capital, Lhasa....
body.zh: 自然灾害似乎本质上并不具有政治性。但在西藏，即使是洪水的镜头也可能很敏感。 上周，视频在社交媒体和新闻报道中广泛传播，视频显示泥浆、水和碎片席卷了西藏和尼泊尔之间的边境哨所，造成毁灭性的洪流，北京的记者开始指出一个惊人的缺席：在中国，这段视频无处可见。 明显的审查制度突显了西藏的非凡敏感性，西藏是中国控制下控制最严格的地区之一，而且其历史可以追溯到数百年前，历史悠久且充满争议。 新南威尔士州纽卡斯尔藏族社区成员次仁央宗 (Tsering Yangzom) 告诉 SBS 新闻，她的叔叔在西藏受洪水影响的地区工作，但自灾难发生以来，她一直无法联系到他，而且似乎已被封锁。 她怀疑他可能担心他们的通讯受到监控，但她也“非常非常担心”他是否受到致命洪水的影响。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 她说，通常情况下，他们会在中国通讯应用微信上断断续续地简短交谈，有时会使用密码语言来保护她的叔叔。 “如果他说天气好，那么我们就可以多谈谈正常的生活，”她说。 “但如果他说天气不好，下雨什么的……那就意味着我不能说太多。” 人权观察组织澳大利亚主任丹妮拉·加夫尚 (Daniela Gavshon) 告诉 SBS 新闻，审查和自我审查在藏族地区十分普遍。 “这些信息控制使得家人更难获得准确的信息、找到亲人，或更好地了解灾难、其规模、影响和应对措施。” 西藏地处广阔的山脉和高原之上，在地理和外交上与世隔绝，通常被称为“世界屋脊”。 几个世纪以来，它与中国有着复杂的关系。北京坚称西藏自古以来就是中国的一部分，而藏人则表示西藏早已独立，拥有自己独特的文化、宗教和语言。 1950年，中国新成立的共产党政府的军队入侵西藏并击败了西藏军队，中国政府称此举是该地区“和平解放”的一部分。 次年，西藏代表签署了一项协议，承认中国对西藏拥有主权，同时承诺实行区域自治。西藏领导人表示，他们是被迫签署这项协议的。 接下来的几年里，围绕中国统治的紧张局势加剧，导致 1959 年西藏首府拉萨发生起义。

reflection.en: The news from Tibet reveals how even natural disasters can become entangled with political sensitivities, leading to censorship. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that when rulers suppress information and ignore the people's cries, the nation suffers. May leaders learn to govern with justice and transparency, allowing truth to flow freely, even in times of crisis.
reflection.zh: 来自西藏的新闻揭示了即使是自然灾害也可能因政治敏感性而受到审查。箴言29:2提醒我们，当统治者压制信息并忽视人民的呼声时，国家就会遭受苦难。愿领导者学会以公正和透明的方式执政，让真理自由流淌，即使在危机时刻。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Number of missing Australians in Nepal rises, as China links disaster to climate change
title.zh: 澳大利亚人在尼泊尔失踪人数增加，中国将灾难归咎于气候变化

summary.en: Australians are raising millions for Nepal disaster survivors as the death toll rises and thousands remain missing.
summary.zh: 随着死亡人数的增加和数千人失踪，澳大利亚人正在为尼泊尔灾难幸存者筹集数百万美元的援助。

body.en:
Australians have raised millions of dollars to assist survivors of the Nepal disaster, with many forced into temporary shelters amid mud and chaos.

Authorities said the death toll rose to nearly 800 on Sunday, with more than 3,000 people missing on both sides of the Nepal-China border after a torrent of ice, rock, mud and debris swept through mountain valleys and rivers on Wednesday, causing widespread devastation.

The federal government has announced a further $3 million in humanitarian support for Nepal, including supplies transported by the Australian Defence Force. It brings Australia's total assistance to $8 million.

The survivors remain in desperate need of basic amenities like clean drinking water and medical supplies.

Among them, Rabindra Hamal told the Australian Associated Press (AAP) news agency he and his colleagues working at a dam site were told to flee just minutes before the flood hit their area on Wednesday.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They made their escape by car, but as they later tried to reach higher ground by foot, two of the group were swept away.

The group continued to scramble to safety but were forced to wait until the following day to be rescued.

They were flown by helicopter to a nearby army barracks and then evacuated to Kathmandu.

Hamal said that of the several thousand people working on the hydro project, about 500 were still missing.

As of Sunday evening, the number of missing Australians rose to 43, with the federal government continuing to do everything possible to confirm their welfare.

A public candlelight vigil will be held at Melbourne's Federation Square on Monday evening, in memory of those lost in the disaster.

A joint call for aid from the Emergency Action Alliance (EAA), made up of 15 prominent charities, has raised more than $3.5 million, including $2 million in contributions from the federal government.

The funding is going towards providing much-needed emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, healthcare, hygiene and sanitation services, and supporting longer-term recovery assistance.

Save the Children is one of the organisations participating in the alliance, with the group's global media manager Amy Lefevre, visiting the affected Nuwakot district on Saturday.

"It's just mud everywhere, there's also a lot of confusion and chaos," she told AAP.

"It's just incredibly sad when you look around and you see someone's shoes stuck in the mud, or people's belongings strewn everywhere.

"It's very much still a rescue operation but of course, today is day five, and I think the chance of finding people alive is slowly dimming."

For those who did survive, many families have been ripped...
body.zh: 澳大利亚人筹集了数百万美元来援助尼泊尔灾难的幸存者，许多人在泥泞和混乱中被迫进入临时避难所。 当局表示，周三冰块、岩石、泥浆和碎片席卷山谷和河流，造成大范围破坏，周日死亡人数上升至近800人，中尼边境两侧有3000多人失踪。 联邦政府宣布向尼泊尔再提供300万美元的人道主义支持，其中包括澳大利亚国防军运送的物资。这使得澳大利亚的援助总额达到 800 万美元。 幸存者仍然迫切需要清洁饮用水和医疗用品等基本设施。 其中，拉宾德拉·哈马尔 (Rabindra Hamal) 告诉澳大利亚美联社 (AAP)，周三洪水袭击他们所在地区的几分钟前，他和在水坝工地工作的同事被告知逃离。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 他们乘汽车逃跑，但当他们后来试图步行到达更高的地方时，其中两人被卷走了。 这群人继续爬向安全地带，但被迫等到第二天才获救。 他们乘坐直升机飞往附近的军营，然后疏散到加德满都。 哈马尔表示，在水电项目上工作的数千人中，仍有约 500 人失踪。 截至周日晚上，失踪的澳大利亚人人数上升至43人，联邦政府继续尽一切可能确认他们的福利。 周一晚上，墨尔本联邦广场将举行公众烛光守夜活动，以纪念在灾难中丧生的人们。 由 15 个知名慈善机构组成的紧急行动联盟 (EAA) 联合呼吁提供援助，已筹集了超过 350 万美元，其中包括联邦政府的 200 万美元捐款。 这笔资金将用于提供急需的紧急住所、食品、安全饮用水、医疗保健、卫生和环境卫生服务，并支持长期恢复援助。 救助儿童会是参与该联盟的组织之一，该组织的全球媒体经理 Amy Lefevre 于周六访问了受影响的努瓦科特地区。 她告诉澳联社：“到处都是泥巴，还有很多混乱和混乱。” “当你环顾四周，看到有人的鞋子陷在泥里，或者人们的财物散落各处时，真是令人难以置信的悲伤。 “这仍然是一次救援行动，但当然，今天已经是第五天了，我认为找到生还者的机会正在慢慢变小。” 对于那些幸存下来的人来说，许多家庭都被撕裂了……

reflection.en: In the wake of the devastating Nepal disaster, Australians have rallied, raising millions to aid survivors. This outpouring of generosity, particularly towards those displaced and suffering, echoes Jesus' teaching to care for the least among us. It is a powerful reminder that even in the face of immense tragedy, human kindness and solidarity can shine...
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔发生毁灭性灾难之后，澳大利亚人团结起来，筹集了数百万美元援助幸存者。这种慷慨的涌现，特别是对那些流离失所和遭受苦难的人们，呼应了耶稣关于要照顾我们中间最小之人的教导。这有力地提醒我们，即使面对巨大的悲剧，人性的善良和团结也能闪耀。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Nepal flood relief vehicles trapped as heavy rain turns roads to mud
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪灾救援车辆被困，暴雨将道路变成泥泞

summary.en: Heavy rain has hampered relief efforts in Nepal where thousands remain missing after flash floods hit its border with Tibet.
summary.zh: 暴雨阻碍了尼泊尔的救援工作，此前洪水袭击了其与西藏的边境，导致数千人失踪。

reflection.en: The devastating flash floods in Nepal have created a dire situation, with thousands missing and relief efforts severely hindered by the relentless rain turning roads into impassable mud. In moments of such overwhelming natural disaster, when human efforts are stalled and despair can easily set in, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的山洪暴发造成了严峻的局面，数千人失踪，而连绵的暴雨将道路变成泥泞，严重阻碍了救援工作。在如此压倒性的自然灾害面前，当人类的努力受阻，绝望很容易滋生时，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是患难中随时的帮助。愿受影响的人们找到安慰和力量，愿援助能迅速抵达。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

title.zh: 尼泊尔-西藏洪水：逾3000人失踪；向被困大量人员的隧道插入空气管道——持续更新

In moments of such profound loss, the shortest verse in the Bible reminds us that Yahweh, too, feels the weight of human suffering. As rescuers race against time to free those trapped...

title.en: In Nepal's flood-ravaged towns, excavators drown out the sound of grief
title.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏近3000人失踪搜救重启；悉尼女子安全获救

summary.en: Nepal has requested specialized foreign assistance as the search for survivors resumes following devastating flash floods that killed hundreds and left thousands missing in a region bordering Tibet. Amidst the disaster, a missing Sydney woman, Cara Severino, was safely located after contacting her parents.
summary.zh: 在造成数百人死亡、数千人失踪的毁灭性洪水过后，尼泊尔已请求外国援助，搜救幸存者。在灾难中，一名失踪的悉尼女子卡拉·塞韦里诺在与父母取得联系后被安全找到。

body.en:
In Bidur, Nepal, the sound of people crying is drowned out by the constant hum of excavators.

This town sits more than 45 kilometres from the site of Wednesday's glacial collapse, which triggered mudslides and flash flooding, killing nearly 700 people.

More than 3,000 remain missing, including 42 Australians in Nepal. Chinese state media on Sunday reported six Australians were also missing on the Tibetan side of the border.

In Bidur, the torrent of water was so powerful that it destroyed the winding road that once ran through it, as well as most of the buildings lining it.

Sticking out of the mud are the ruins of what were once homes and businesses; now nothing more than concrete shells covered in brown sludge.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Menuka Manandhar struggles down a ladder leaning against one of the buildings after searching the ruins of her home.

The layers of mud surrounding it are so thick, two men have to help lift her back to safety.

"All my things were inside the house. I could only take some important documents.

"I was here when the disaster struck, we escaped it by only a minute. We had barely crossed the road when it hit."

Other families emerge with a few small bags of belongings they were able to salvage from the higher floors of their buildings.

"Five people in our family were downstairs at the time of the flood," Ramji Lamsa, who was sheltering in a nearby school, said.

"I had a shop, a storehouse, and some vehicles. Everything was swept away. We don't have any resources to rebuild. We don’t know how the authorities are going to handle this."

Everything north of Bidur remains cut off by land. Nepali rescue crews are sending helicopters back and forth throughout the day, bringing back the injured and the dead they find on the other side.

Gaurav Thapa Magar was working in his bank at Timure, just three kilometres from the Tibetan border, when everything around him started shaking.

"In that moment, I just ran with everyone. And after I had taken five or six steps, I saw a big wall of water, almost three of four storeys of water, coming right after me.

"I felt like I was dead, to be honest. I was panicking, everyone was panicking, but I was really thinking 'I’m gone, I have to run, I’m gone'.

Gaurav spent most of the day waiting at the top of the hill he had climbed to, looking down on the wasteland that once was his town, until a helicopter arrived and evacuated him.

"When I looked down the whole village were swept away. And people were saying: 'There’s a body, there's a body'.

"There were so many people crying, who had lost their families. And there were so many people who were...
body.zh: 尼泊尔当局在因天气原因短暂暂停后恢复搜救工作，在一场造成数百人死亡并席卷西藏边境地区的毁灭性洪水之后，寻找近 3,000 名失踪人员。 周六，一名下落不明的悉尼女子，26 岁的卡拉·塞维里诺 (Cara Severino) 与她的父母取得了联系，随后澳大利亚领事官员安全找到了她。 外交部长黄英贤表示，这是“在一场带来巨大损失和不确定性的灾难中罕见的积极消息”。 “我对那些仍然失踪的人的家人感到同情——我知道我的家人和朋友经历了多少，”她说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “我很幸运来自澳大利亚，并得到大使馆和澳大利亚政府的大力支持。” 周三，冰川崩塌引发岩石、冰块、泥浆和碎片涌入山区河流系统，造成尼泊尔至少 669 人死亡、中国西藏至少 7 人死亡，造成 41 名澳大利亚人下落不明。 目前仍有近3000人失踪，其中尼泊尔约2426人，西藏吉隆县约554人，其中至少有540名外国人，其中许多是来自印度的印度教朝圣者。 尼泊尔已呼吁提供专门的外国援助，其财政部长表示，重建需要高达 50 亿美元（70 亿美元）的资金。 受灾严重的拉苏瓦地区一名警官表示，搜救行动因雨和雾而暂时停止，并于周日下午恢复。 “直升机正在飞行，天气有所好转后，行动也恢复了，”他不愿透露姓名，因为他无权接受媒体采访。 周五，洪水发生后，尼泊尔和中国边境形成的一个湖泊开始溢出，流入尼泊尔的伦德科拉河和特里苏利河，当局还暂停了救援工作。 中国当局和中央电视台表示，到周六，风险已经缓解，部分湖床清晰可见。据中央电视台报道，卫星图像显示湖水正在慢慢流失，湖面逐渐缩小。 该湖是尼泊尔正在监测的洪水区上游的两个湖之一。一位官员警告说，在两者完全排干之前，洪水风险将持续存在。 灾难发生三天后，当局表示，一些被打捞出来的尸体已经腐烂得面目全非。由于健康风险和对疾病爆发的恐惧，他们将在办理法律手续后被埋葬。 奇特旺地区政府在一份通知中表示，“将收集 DNA 样本，并将尸体埋在露天场所。” 失踪澳大利亚人的几名家人和朋友已飞往尼泊尔......

reflection.en: In the midst of devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, the news of Cara Severino's safe return offers a glimmer of hope. This story reminds us of the profound uncertainty faced by families during disasters, and the importance of advocating for the vulnerable, ensuring no one is forgotten in the chaos.
reflection.zh: 在尼泊尔和西藏毁灭性洪水肆虐之际，卡拉·塞韦里诺安全获救的消息带来了一线希望。这个故事提醒我们，在灾难中，家属们面临着巨大的不确定性，以及为弱势群体发声、确保混乱中无人被遗忘的重要性。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: How Australians can help those impacted by devastating Nepal floods
title.zh: 澳大利亚人如何帮助受尼泊尔毁灭性洪水影响的人们

summary.en: Australian charities have launched a joint appeal to aid communities devastated by floods and landslides along the Nepal-China border. Thousands are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean water, and medical care after their homes and infrastructure were destroyed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚慈善机构已发起联合募捐，以援助尼泊尔-中国边境受洪水和山体滑坡摧毁的社区。在房屋和基础设施被毁后，成千上万的人迫切需要住所、食物、清洁饮用水和医疗援助。

body.en:
Entire communities have been devastated by severe flooding and landslides along the Nepal-Tibet border, with homes, roads, bridges and critical infrastructure destroyed.

Search and rescue operations remain underway, while thousands of people are in urgent need of shelter, food, clean drinking water and medical assistance.

In response, 14 Australian charities have joined forces to launch a national appeal.

The Emergency Action Alliance (EAA) has launched the Nepal Flood Disaster Appeal, bringing together a variety of charities to support communities affected by the disaster.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The alliance says donations will help provide immediate humanitarian assistance, including emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water, hygiene supplies and medical care.

Access to some affected communities remains difficult, with damaged roads and ongoing weather conditions hampering efforts to reach people in need.

Australians are encouraged to donate through the EAA website or by calling 1300 939 000.

The charities participating in the appeal are Save the Children Australia, Plan International Australia, Oxfam Australia, Australia for UNHCR, ActionAid Australia, CARE Australia, Caritas Australia, ADRA, Act for Peace, Anglican Overseas Aid, Australian Lutheran World Service, Baptist World Aid Australia, CBM Australia and Tearfund Australia.

EAA executive director Kerren Morris said the appeal provided Australians with a trusted way to support people affected by the disaster.

"Emergency shelter, food, safe drinking water and medical support are urgently needed now, while longer-term recovery efforts will continue for many months," she said in a statement.

The charities involved bring different areas of humanitarian expertise to the response, with organisations and their local partners working to provide immediate assistance to affected communities.

Save the Children is focusing on supporting children and families affected by humanitarian emergencies.

Oxfam Australia's humanitarian work includes support for essential services such as clean water, sanitation and emergency assistance.

Australia for UNHCR is the UN refugee agency's national partner in Australia, and is supporting humanitarian assistance through the UNHCR network.

The charities involved are continuing to assess the scale of the disaster and humanitarian needs in affected communities.

The EAA says its members are working to determine where support is most urgently needed as search and rescue operations continue.

The appeal has been endorsed by the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID), the peak body for Australian non-government organisations...

reflection.en: The devastating floods in Nepal have left entire communities in urgent need of basic necessities. This situation calls us to action, reminding us of our responsibility to advocate for the vulnerable and provide tangible support to those facing such immense hardship. Proverbs 31:8-9 urges us to 'Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水使整个社区迫切需要基本生活必需品。这种情况呼唤我们采取行动，提醒我们有责任为弱势群体发声，并为那些面临巨大困难的人提供切实的支持。《箴言》31:8-9 敦促我们：“你们要为不能说话的辩护，为所有孤苦者伸张正义。你们要开口说话，公正地审判，为困苦和贫穷的人伸张正义。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

title.en: A new proposal to limit our scrolling has a precedent. But would it work?
title.zh: 一项限制我们滚动的新提案有先例。但它会奏效吗？

summary.en: Australia is considering copying Europe's playbook on limiting addictive social media feeds, but the results are mixed.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚正在考虑效仿欧洲限制成瘾性社交媒体推送内容的做法，但效果好坏参半。

body.en:
For years, social media companies have relied on powerful algorithms to decide what Australians see in their feeds, using their personal data and behaviour to keep them scrolling.

The federal government is drafting "digital duty of care" legislation that would require social media companies to identify risks and take steps to reduce online harm.

Among the proposals is a push to "Fix Our Feeds", which would give Australians greater control over whether algorithms personalise the content they see.

But Australia would not be the first jurisdiction to try to rein in the algorithms that determine what users see.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The European Union has already introduced rules requiring the largest social media platforms to give users an alternative to personalised recommendations.

The experience offers a warning for Australia: giving people more control over their feeds does not necessarily mean they will use it.

The EU's Digital Services Act, which began applying to the largest online platforms in 2023, was designed to strengthen users' rights and give them greater control over their online experiences.

"Europe is now effectively the first jurisdiction in the world where online platforms no longer benefit from a 'free pass' and set their own rules," then EU commissioner Thierry Breton said in 2023.

Under the rules, the largest platforms — those with more than 45 million monthly users in the EU — must offer at least one recommendation option that is not based on users' personal profiling.

Instagram and Facebook users now have feeds that show content in the order it was posted and more closely resemble how social media worked before personalised feeds became central to the platforms.

Proponents argue chronological feeds may be less addictive because users can feel they have "caught up", rather than being drawn into endless scrolling.

But Patrik Wikström, a professor of computational communication at Queensland University of Technology, said the European regulations had shortcomings.

"Even if we say 'We don't want the platforms to know an awful lot about us, we don't want this to be personalised, and we don't want these rabbit holes and echo chambers', at the end of the day, when we're sitting there and scrolling, we like it," he told SBS News.

"People still stick to the personalised platform because it is there for a reason. It's tuned perfectly to our brains and to make us stay as long as possible on the platform, and it's hard to escape."

Research cited by Australia's eSafety Commissioner found users often found chronological feeds less engaging and switched back to personalised algorithms, raising...

title.en: Should smart glasses blur your face by default? Australia's tech watchdog thinks so
title.zh: 智能眼镜是否应该默认模糊你的脸？澳大利亚科技监管机构认为应该

summary.en: Australia's eSafety Commissioner has recommended that smart glasses should automatically blur the faces of people being filmed unless consent is given, as part of broader privacy reforms concerning AI and social media.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的电子安全专员建议，作为围绕人工智能和社交媒体的更广泛隐私改革的一部分，智能眼镜拍摄的对象的面部应在未经同意的情况下自动模糊。

body.en:
People's faces should automatically be blurred when being filmed by smart glasses as part of greater privacy measures, the online safety watchdog has urged.

In advice to industry, the eSafety Commissioner has called for extra protections to be put in place for smart glasses, or glasses with cameras attached to them.

The growing uptake of the technology, prompted by cheap versions of the products being sold in outlets such as Kmart, has increased concerns about privacy and people being filmed without their consent.

The commissioner said faces of people being filmed should be blurred by default if they have not given consent, with clearer indicators being given for when the glasses are recording video.

"Companies selling smart glasses must balance the benefits of the technology with the need to protect users and the public," the commissioner said.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"As smart glasses become more common, they may create new ways to perpetrate harms."

The eSafety Commissioner said the rapid evolution of the technology meant there was still a chance for extra safety features to be baked into the products before harms became more widespread.

"They may become increasingly interconnected with and create new ways to perpetrate different types of harms, such as image-based abuse, adult cyber abuse, cyberbullying of children, or the livestreaming of violent or other harmful content," the advice said.

"The harms linked to covert recording are not hypothetical. They are real and already occurring."

Among the concerns listed by the commissioner was how the glasses could be used by "pick-up artists" who use the glasses to film women without their knowledge.

"Most of the women do not realise they are being filmed. These posts often attract misogynistic comments, compounding the harm," the commissioner said.

"Used in this way, smart glasses can reinforce and normalise watching, recording and controlling women in public without their knowledge."

The commissioner has also called for livestreaming from the glasses to operate on a delay, as well as for recording to be disabled when the glasses are not being worn.

Attorney-General Michelle Rowland wrote to the privacy commission earlier this month to investigate whether extra regulations for smart glasses were needed.

Under changes the minor party will bring to parliament, the filming, storing or sharing of footage from the glasses without consent would be a breach of privacy laws.

Rowland is also set to outline further changes to privacy laws, including the right to erasure, on Monday.

The policy would mean social media users can ask tech companies to delete their personal information...
body.zh: 在线安全监管机构敦促，作为更严格隐私措施的一部分，智能眼镜拍摄时人脸应该自动模糊。 在给行业的建议中，电子安全专员呼吁对智能眼镜或带有摄像头的眼镜采取额外的保护措施。 由于凯马特等商店销售的廉价产品推动了这项技术的日益普及，这增加了人们对隐私和未经同意就被拍摄的担忧。 该专员表示，如果未经同意，被拍摄者的脸部默认应被模糊化，并在眼镜录制视频时给出更清晰的指示。 “销售智能眼镜的公司必须平衡技术的好处与保护用户和公众的需要，”专员说。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 “随着智能眼镜变得越来越普遍，它们可能会创造新的危害方式。” 电子安全专员表示，技术的快速发展意味着在危害变得更加普遍之前，仍有机会将额外的安全功能融入到产品中。 该建议称：“他们可能会越来越多地相互联系，并创造新的方式来实施不同类型的伤害，例如基于图像的虐待、成人网络虐待、儿童网络欺凌或暴力或其他有害内容的直播。” “与秘密录音相关的危害不是假设的。它们是真实的并且已经发生。” 该专员列出的担忧之一是，这些眼镜如何被“把妹达人”使用，他们在女性不知情的情况下使用该眼镜拍摄女性。 “大多数女性并没有意识到她们正在被拍摄。这些帖子常常会引起厌恶女性的评论，从而加剧伤害，”专员说。 “通过这种方式使用，智能眼镜可以在女性不知情的情况下加强和规范对公共场所的观察、记录和控制。” 该专员还呼吁通过眼镜进行直播时延迟运行，并在不佩戴眼镜时禁用录制。 司法部长米歇尔·罗兰本月早些时候写信给隐私委员会，调查是否需要对智能眼镜制定额外的法规。 根据小党将向议会提出的修改，未经同意拍摄、存储或分享眼镜中的镜头将违反隐私法。 罗兰还将于周一概述隐私法的进一步修改，包括删除权。 该政策意味着社交媒体用户可以要求科技公司删除他们的个人信息......

title.en: Australian boxing great Tony Mundine dies aged 75
title.zh: 澳大利亚拳击传奇人物托尼·蒙迪内去世，享年75岁

summary.en: Tony Mundine, a prominent Australian boxer and father of former boxer Anthony Mundine, passed away on Sunday at the age of 75 due to a heart attack. He was the first Australian to compete in four weight divisions and challenged for a world middleweight title in 1974. His son Anthony became a world champion, and his...
summary.zh: 澳大利亚著名拳击手、前拳击手安东尼·蒙迪内（Anthony Mundine）的父亲托尼·蒙迪内（Tony Mundine）于周日因心脏病去世，享年75岁。他是第一位参加四个级别比赛的澳大利亚拳击手，并曾于1974年挑战世界中量级拳王。他的儿子安东尼曾是世界拳王，孙子拉希姆（Rahim）也是一名职业拳击手。

body.en:
The father of former boxer and NRL star Anthony Mundine succumbed to a heart attack on Sunday.

Born in Baryulgil, near Grafton in northern NSW, Tony Mundine was the first Australian to fight in four different weight divisions, challenging for the world middleweight title against Argentina's Carlos Monzon in 1974, in a bout stopped in the seventh round.

Mundine leaves a significant boxing legacy. Anthony was an IBO middleweight and WBA super-middleweight world champion, whose son Rahim won his fourth career fight from as many professional bouts on the Gold Coast only last week.

Anthony Mundine posted a tribute to his father on social media, saying he was returning home for his funeral after travelling to Saudi Arabia.

"Thanks for doing all you did for me and supporting me in every moment, showing love and strength gonna miss you Tonza, there's only one Tony Mundine."

Through a career in the middleweight, light-heavyweight, cruiserweight and heavyweight divisions, Tony Mundine recorded 80 wins — 64 from knockouts, 15 losses, and one draw.

title.en: What a man with psychopathic traits wants people to understand about empathy
title.zh: 有精神病态特征的男人希望人们理解共情

summary.en: While some individuals may be predisposed to or develop certain traits, experts suggest this does not inevitably lead to harmful behavior. The story features a man diagnosed with psychopathic traits who describes viewing people as 'rocks' and having difficulty understanding emotions from a young age, contrasting with...
summary.zh: 虽然有些人可能天生具有或后天发展出某些特征，但专家表示这并不意味着他们注定会做出有害行为。故事讲述了一名被诊断出具有精神病态特征的男子，他形容自己从小就将人视为“石头”，并且难以理解他人的情绪，这与有害行为并非命中注定的观点形成对比。

body.en:

A man diagnosed with psychopathic traits, parents concerned about their children's violent behaviour, and guests who grew up believing they were bad. Are some of us born bad, or is harmful behaviour shaped by experience? How do nature and nurture influence our choices and morals? Watch Insight episode Born Bad? at 8.30PM Tuesday 1 September on SBS or SBS On Demand.

Loïc De Marie says he views a human as "a rock" and has struggled to understand other people's emotions from a young age.

"A little classmate died in a dramatic car accident when I was six years old … everybody was crying," the 26-year-old told Insight.

"This [was] the first time I understood that emotions are different with me [because] the look that the teacher gave me was, 'Why is this kid not crying?'"

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Growing up in Belgium, in that same year, Loïc and his little sister were playing near their backyard pool when she fell in.

"She was drowning, and I looked at her, and that was kind of troubling," he said.

He then saved her by holding out a plastic golf club for her to grab as he dragged her back to the ladder.

As he grew older, Loïc became increasingly involved in fights and would have angry outbursts.

"A guy was looking me in the eyes, some rivalry between men… and one day, I came to school with a baseball bat," he said.

Loïc says the police arrested him on the school grounds over the incident but says he never faced serious legal consequences.

Three years ago, Loïc began seeing a new psychologist — having grown tired of masking his thought processes.

The psychologist diagnosed him with antisocial personality disorder (ASPD) and documented traits associated with psychopathy — including manipulation and lying, a reckless disregard for other people's safety, and a lack of remorse and empathy.

"Everybody in the room can understand the words of the music and the melody ... I don't hear the melody — I don't understand it."

Loïc's father, Philippe, says he used to worry his son would go down the wrong path, but receiving a diagnosis was helpful.

"It [was] good to put a name on a disorder, and then you understand a lot of things.

"We try to ... do the best we can to support him [with] a lot of communication and love."

Forensic psychiatrist Dr Rajan Darjee, who has worked in prisons, mental health hospitals and in the community, says ASPD is a broad concept describing "people who, because of personality problems, are repeatedly breaking rules".

In the case of Zomi Frankcom , an Australian killed in a drone strike while delivering humanitarian aid to the Gaza Strip in 2024, Israel's military justice system has concluded there is no reasonable suspicion of criminal misconduct.

It announced this month its decision to close the investigation into the death of Frankcom and six other World Central Kitchen (WCK) colleagues.

Israel's ambassador to Australia, Hillel Newman, said there had been no intention to attack the aid workers and a "reasonable mistake" was made.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"There are tragic circumstances in a war zone and we're very sorry for the family, but that does not always mean that there's criminal liability," Newman told ABC Radio National.

Two Israel Defense Forces (IDF) officers were removed from their positions over the incident and another three were formally reprimanded.

But Foreign Minister Penny Wong has criticised the decision, noting "there are still many unanswered questions".

The Frankcom family and WCK are demanding an independent investigation into the airstrikes, saying "the IDF cannot credibly investigate its own conduct".

The case raises questions about whether Israel's military justice system is capable of delivering fair outcomes when its forces are accused of killing civilians, and where the line lies between a tragic operational error and conduct that warrants criminal investigation.

Michelle Burgis-Kasthala, professor of international law at La Trobe University, says there is "very compelling documentation" from many human rights organisations to suggest a "pattern of impunity" when it comes to the investigation of war crimes in Israel.

"A lot of the time they simply lapse and very rarely do they ever result in any form of criminal investigation, and even less likely [to result in] criminal conviction."

Last year, Action on Armed Violence (AOAV) looked at 52 publicly reported incidents in English-language media between October 2023 and June 2025, in which the Israeli media either reported an investigation was underway, or serious allegations of civilian harm.

The London-based charity found 88 per cent were either still under review or had been closed without any finding of wrongdoing.

So far, according to the cases examined by AOAV, only one case has resulted in a prison sentence against the accused.

IDF reservist soldier Israel Hajabi was convicted on 7 February 2025 for repeatedly beating bound Palestinian detainees with his fists, a baton and an assault rifle at the Sde Teiman military detention centre. Some of these attacks...

reflection.en: The news that the investigation into Zomi Frankcom's death has been closed leaves lingering questions about accountability. When justice systems fail to provide clear answers or redress for the loss of innocent lives, it can feel like the foundations of fairness are shaken. We pray for wisdom and integrity in all such processes, that the truth might be...
reflection.zh: 关于佐米·弗兰科姆之死调查已关闭的消息，留下了关于问责制的挥之不去的问题。当司法系统未能为无辜生命的逝去提供明确的答案或赔偿时，会让人感觉公平的基石动摇了。我们祈求所有此类程序都能有智慧和正直，使真相得以完全揭露，并使那些受苦的人能找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Central bar packed as Hongkongers aim to raise HK$50,000 for Nepal flood relief
title.zh: 香港酒吧爆满，港人筹款赈济尼泊尔洪灾

summary.en: Approximately one hundred patrons filled a bar in Central on Monday night to raise funds for victims of catastrophic flash floods and mudslides in Nepal. Members of Hong Kong's Nepalese community organized relief efforts for their homeland, where the death toll had risen to 919 as of Monday, with 4,247 people still...
summary.zh: 周一晚间，约百名顾客挤满中环一家酒吧，为尼泊尔灾难性洪水和泥石流的受害者筹集资金。香港尼泊尔社区成员正为他们的祖国组织救援工作，截至周一，尼泊尔的死亡人数已升至919人，失踪人数为4247人。

body.en: Around a hundred patrons packed a bar in Central on Monday night to raise funds for victims of catastrophic flash floods and mudslides in Nepal, as members of Hong Kong’s Nepalese community rallied to support relief efforts for their homeland. The death toll in Nepal had risen to 919 as of 1pm on Monday, with 4,247 people still missing, Chinese state broadcaster CCTV reported. The disaster struck on Wednesday when a massive wall of mud and rock collapsed into a river along the Himalayan border...
body.zh: 周一晚上，大约一百名顾客挤满了中环的一家酒吧，为尼泊尔灾难性山洪和泥石流的受害者筹集资金，香港尼泊尔社区的成员也团结起来支持祖国的救援工作。据中国国家电视台中央电视台报道，截至周一下午 1 点，尼泊尔死亡人数已升至 919 人，仍有 4,247 人失踪。灾难于周三发生，一堵巨大的泥石墙倒塌到喜马拉雅边境沿线的一条河流中……

reflection.en: In the face of devastating floods in Nepal, the Nepalese community in Hong Kong, alongside other patrons, demonstrated a powerful act of solidarity. Their gathering at a Central bar to raise funds for relief efforts reflects a commitment to advocate for the vulnerable and extend compassion across borders. This initiative embodies the spirit of Proverbs...
reflection.zh: 面对尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水灾难，香港的尼泊尔社区与其他顾客一起，展现了强大的团结互助精神。他们在一家中环酒吧的聚会，为救援工作筹集资金，体现了跨越国界、为弱势群体发声并伸出援手的决心。 这一行动体现了《箴言》31章8节的精神：“本应开口为那些不能开口的辩护，为所有被剥夺权利的人伸张正义，为穷人辩屈。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: New drug for chronic hives registered in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港注册慢性荨麻疹新药

summary.en: A new drug targeting chronic hives has been approved for registration in Hong Kong, providing patients with additional treatment choices. The drug was registered under the “1+” mechanism, which allows new drugs supported by local clinical data and recognized by local experts to be registered by submitting approval...
summary.zh: 一种针对慢性荨麻疹的新药已在香港获批注册，为患者提供了更多的治疗选择。该药物是在“1+”机制下注册的，该机制允许获得本地临床数据支持并获得本地专家认可的新药，只需提交一个外部药品监管机构的批准即可注册。该药物已获得美国相关机构的批准，并符合香港的安全、疗效和质量标准。

body.en: Patients suffering from chronic hives can enjoy more treatment options, as a new drug targeting the disease has been approved for registration in Hong Kong under the “1+” mechanism, the government said on Monday. Under the mechanism, new drugs that are supported by local clinical data as well as recognised by local experts can apply to get registered in the city by submitting the approval from just one external drug regulatory authority, instead of two in the past. The newly registered drug has been approved by an authority in the US, and the Registration Committee under the Pharmacy and Poisons Board of Hong Kong considers it to have satisfied safety, efficacy and quality criteria. “Chronic spontaneous urticaria is a chronic skin condition that causes unpredictable itch and hives, which can profoundly affect the quality of life,” a spokesman said. “This new drug can provide sustained improvement in symptoms control.” A total of 22 new drugs have been given the green light for registration since the mechanism was launched in 2023. The Department of Health has so far received more than 910 enquiries from over 220 pharmaceutical companies over the mechanism, the spokesman said, adding many of them are interested in getting their products registered in Hong Kong. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 政府周一表示，针对慢性荨麻疹的新药已在“1+”机制下获准在香港注册，为患有慢性荨麻疹的患者提供更多治疗选择。在该机制下，有当地临床数据支持并得到当地专家认可的新药，只需提交一个外部药品监管机构的批准即可申请在本市注册，而不是过去需要两个机构的批准。该新注册药物已获美国当局批准，香港药剂业及毒药管理局注册委员会认为该药物已符合安全性、功效及质量标准。 “慢性自发性荨麻疹是一种慢性皮肤病，会引起不可预测的瘙痒和荨麻疹，这会严重影响生活质量，”一位发言人说。 “这种新药可以持续改善症状控制。”该机制自2023年推出以来，共有22种新药获准注册。发言人表示，卫生署迄今已收到超过220家制药公司就该机制提出的逾910项查询，其中不少制药公司有意在香港注册其产品。谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: For those living with chronic hives, the news of a new treatment option offers a tangible measure of hope. It is a reminder that even in the face of persistent illness, dedicated research and regulatory processes can bring relief and improve quality of life. Let us pray for all who suffer from chronic conditions, that they may find healing and comfort.
reflection.zh: 对于那些饱受慢性荨麻疹困扰的人来说，新治疗方案的消息带来了切实的希望。这提醒我们，即使面对长期的疾病，专注的研究和监管流程也能带来缓解并改善生活质量。让我们为所有患有慢性疾病的人祈祷，愿他们找到医治和安慰。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: 99.1% of Wang Fuk Court homeowners accept buyout offer
title.zh: 王福庭99.1%的业主接受回购提议

summary.en: The government announced that 99.1% of Wang Fuk Court homeowners, totaling 1,967 households, accepted its buyout offer by the Monday 5 pm deadline. The Housing Bureau will consider letters postmarked by August 31 as accepted, and formal agreements are being arranged. As of Monday afternoon, 1,559 households (78.6%)...
summary.zh: 政府宣布，截至周一下午5时最后期限，王福庭99.1%的业主——即1967户家庭——已接受其回购提议。房屋局将考虑邮戳在8月31日或之前的信件为接受，并正在安排签署正式的买卖协议。截至周一下午，已有1559户家庭（占总数的78.6%）签署了协议。

body.en: The government said 99.1 percent of Wang Fuk Court homeowners – or 1,967 households – have accepted its buyout offer, as the deadline for acceptance ended on Monday at 5pm. Some acceptance letters might be delivered by post later, with the Housing Bureau saying it will consider homeowners to have accepted the offer as long as the letters are postmarked on or before August 31. A bureau spokesman said upon verification, it will arrange relevant owners to sign the formal Agreement for Sale and Purchase. As of Monday afternoon, the government has signed the agreement with 1,559 households, accounting for 78.6 percent of all units. "The government will continue to follow up on the procedures for acquiring the remaining titles at full speed to take forward the title acquisition exercise," the spokesman added. Edited by Aaron Tam
body.zh: 政府表示，99.1% 的宏福苑房主（即 1,967 户家庭）已接受其买断要约，接受截止日期于周一下午 5 点结束。部分接受函可能会稍后以邮寄方式送达，房屋局表示，只要函件盖有8月31日或之前的邮戳，就会视为已接受要约。房屋局发言人表示，经核实后，会安排相关业主签署正式买卖合约。截至周一下午，政府已与1,559户家庭签署了协议，占所有单位的78.6%。发言人补充：“政府会继续全速跟进收购余下业权的程序，以推展业权收购工作。”谭咏麟编辑

reflection.en: The successful buyout of nearly all homeowners at Wang Fuk Court demonstrates a significant administrative achievement. This large-scale agreement, involving 1,967 households, reflects a process that, for the vast majority, appears to have balanced the needs of the state with the rights and interests of the residents, embodying a form of justice and mercy...
reflection.zh: 王福庭近乎所有业主成功接受回购提议，显示了政府在行政管理上的一项重大成就。这项涉及1967户家庭的大规模协议，体现了一个过程，对绝大多数人而言，它似乎平衡了政府的需求与居民的权利和利益，象征着城市发展中的一种公正与怜悯。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Evening News on TV32 - Aug 31
title.zh: TV32 晚间新闻 - 8月31日

summary.en: Top stories for Monday, Aug 31, 2026 - President Xi Jinping says China is sparing no effort to rescue people in Xizang following the deadly mudslide and floods. - The government loses an appeal over its Fanling golf course flats plan. - The Middle East war flares up again with...
summary.zh: 2026年8月31日星期一主要新闻 - 习近平主席表示，中国正全力搜救西藏山体滑坡和洪水灾民。 - 政府在粉岭高尔夫球场建屋计划上诉失败。 - 中东战火重燃，...

reflection.en: The news reports that the Middle East war has flared up again, a somber reminder of persistent global conflicts. Psalm 46:9 speaks of Yahweh's ultimate power to end all wars, bringing peace to the earth. This offers a profound hope that even amidst ongoing strife, a divine intervention will one day bring lasting cessation of hostilities.
reflection.zh: 新闻报道中东战火重燃，令人忧虑地提醒我们全球冲突的持续存在。诗篇46:9篇讲述了雅伟最终将平息一切争战，为大地带来和平。这提供了深刻的希望，即使在持续的纷争中，神圣的干预终将带来持久的停火。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Freed Hongkonger sent back to jail as storm delays deportation from Philippines
title.zh: 风暴延迟遣返，获释港人重返菲律宾监狱

summary.en: A Hong Kong national, Tang Lung-wai, has been returned to a Philippine prison after his deportation was halted by severe weather. His legal team has condemned the move as "illegal detention," stating that prison authorities sent him back to the maximum-security New Bilibid Prison when government offices were closed...
summary.zh: 一名香港男子唐龙伟（Tang Lung-wai）在因恶劣天气导致其遣返行程受阻后，被重新送回菲律宾监狱。他的法律团队谴责此举为“非法拘留”，并称监狱当局在政府部门因台风关闭期间将其送往移民局，随后又将其送回新比立比监狱。

body.en: A Hong Kong man has been returned to a Philippine prison in what his legal team condemned as “illegal detention”, after severe weather halted his deportation following his release. Tang Lung-wai’s Philippine lawyer, Blessie Rose Carpena, told the South China Morning Post that prison authorities escorted Tang to the Bureau of Immigration last Friday. However, because government offices were suspended due to a passing typhoon, he was returned to the maximum-security New Bilibid Prison in...
body.zh: 一名香港男子获释后因恶劣天气而中止了驱逐出境，随后被送回菲律宾监狱，其法律团队谴责其为“非法拘留”。邓龙伟的菲律宾律师布莱西·罗丝·卡佩纳 (Blessie Rose Carpena) 告诉《南华早报》，监狱当局上周五将邓龙伟护送至移民局。然而，由于政府机关因台风过境而暂停，他被送回位于戒备最高的新比利比德监狱……

reflection.en: The plight of Tang Lung-wai, a Hong Kong man facing deportation and returned to prison due to a typhoon, underscores the vulnerability of those without a secure place. Scripture calls us to welcome the foreigner, recognizing their inherent dignity and need for compassion, especially when caught in circumstances beyond their control. May we remember those in...
reflection.zh: 唐龙伟的困境，一位因台风而遣返受阻、重返监狱的香港男子，凸显了那些没有稳固居所之人的脆弱。经文呼吁我们要接待客旅，认识到他们固有的尊严和对怜悯的需求，尤其是在他们身处无法控制的环境中时。 愿我们记念那些身处旅途或面临不确定未来的人们，伸出援手，倡导公正的对待，体现出雅伟爱邻舍的命令，无论他们来自何方。

verse.textEn: And you are to love those who are foreigners, for you yourselves were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要怜爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Nearly all Wang Fuk Court owners accept buy-out, leaving 17 holdouts as offer ends
title.zh: 王福苑业主近乎全数接受回购，补偿方案截止时仅剩17户未接受

summary.en: Over 99% of homeowners at Hong Kong's fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court have accepted a government buy-out offer for their flats. The scheme closed on Monday with 1,967 out of 1,984 owners accepting. The remaining 17 households may face compulsory acquisition with potentially lower compensation.
summary.zh: 香港王福苑因火灾受损的业主中，超过99%已接受政府的回购提议。该计划于周一截止，1984户中的1967户接受了回购。剩余的17户家庭可能面临强制征收，补偿金额可能较低。

body.en: More than 99 per cent of homeowners at Hong Kong’s fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court have accepted a government buy-out of their flats, leaving just 17 households facing potential compulsory acquisition after the scheme closed on Monday. By the cut‑off time at 5pm on Monday, 1,967 or 99.1 per cent of the estate’s 1,984 flat owners had returned acceptance letters. The remaining 17 may face compulsory acquisition at lower compensation levels in the future. Among those who accepted, 1,559, or 78.6 per...
body.zh: 香港遭受大火蹂躏的宏福苑，超过 99% 的房主已接受政府买断其公寓，只有 17 个家庭在周一该计划结束后面临潜在的强制收购。截至周一下午 5 点截止时间，该庄园 1,984 名业主中，有 1,967 名（即 99.1%）已退回录取通知书。其余17家未来可能面临较低补偿水平的强制收购。在接受的人中，有 1,559 人，即 78.6 人……

reflection.en: The government's buy-out scheme for the fire-damaged Wang Fuk Court demonstrates a commitment to public service and justice. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who suffers violence." This action, while not perfect for the remaining 17, reflects a mandate to care for citizens in...
reflection.zh: 政府为火灾受损的王福苑提供的回购计划，体现了对公共服务和公正的承诺。《耶利米书》22章3节呼吁统治者“施行公平和公义，拯救被欺压的脱离欺压者的手”。这一行动，尽管对剩余的17户并非完美，却反映了在危机中关怀民众的使命。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: In Pictures: Fans pay tribute to Hong Kong independent bookshop Have a Nice Stay on final day following raid
title.zh: 图文：香港独立书店“好好生活”遭搜查后最后一天，书迷前来致意

summary.en: Dozens of book lovers visited Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its last day of operation Sunday, honoring the shop that was raided by national security police last month. Fans had formed long queues throughout the week following the shop's announcement of a five-day clearance sale before its...
summary.zh: 上周日，数十名爱书之人涌入香港独立书店“好好生活”，送别这家在上个月被国安警察搜查的书店。在书店宣布结业前举行五天清仓大减价后，过去一周，书迷们排起了长龙。

body.en: Dozens of bookworms squeezed into Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on Sunday for its final day in business, paying tribute to the shop that was raided by national security police last month. Have a Nice Stay co-founder Sum Wan-wah waves to his customers on the final operating day of his independent bookshop in Prince Edward, on August 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Over the past week, fans had formed long queues winding up the Prince Edward tenement building where Have a Nice Stay is located, following the bookshop’s announcement that it would hold a five-day clearance sale before closing its doors forever. At about 9pm on Sunday, Have a Nice Stay co-founder Sum Wan-wah thanked customers for their support and wished them well as he prepared to pull down the shutters. Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its last day in business on August 30, 2026. Cards on the wall read: “Make every effort to enter through the narrow door.” Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Take care, everyone. Have a Nice Stay will cease operation from today,” Sum told customers and reporters in Cantonese before closing the door to the bookshop he operated for four years. Sum was among five independent booksellers arrested last month by the city’s national security police on suspicion of sedition. Three of the arrestees worked at Have a Nice Stay, while the other two were staffers at the 50-year-old Greenfield Bookstore in Mong Kok. Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay, on August 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Police also raided the two stores, seizing allegedly seditious materials. The five were later granted bail pending police investigations. See also: How an escalating crackdown on Hong Kong’s independent bookstores put Taiwan publishers in the spotlight A day before the raid, Have a Nice Stay announced that it would close by August 30, citing “unclear red lines” and financial struggles. Supporters line up to enter Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its final day of operation on August 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The arrests marked an escalation in a national security crackdown on the city’s independent booksellers, and came after arrests at Book Punch in March and Hunter Bookstore in June. Have a Nice Stay closed for weeks following the raid, opening only for the clearance sale that began last Wednesday. Supporters flocked over from across the city, many lining up patiently along the steps leading up to the third-floor bookshop. Two electric fans were set up in the staircase to alleviate the suffocating heat. Supporters – including former lawmaker Emily Lau in green – filled Hong Kong independent bookstore Have a Nice Stay on its closing day on August 30, 2026. Photo:...
body.zh: 周日，数十名书虫挤进香港独立书店“Have a Nice Stay”，这是其营业的最后一天，向这家上个月被国安警察突击搜查的商店致敬。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，Have a Nice Stay 联合创始人 Sum Wan-wah 在他位于太子的独立书店的最后营业日向顾客挥手致意。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。过去一周，书店宣布将举行为期五天的清仓甩卖活动，然后永远关门，粉丝们在《Have a Nice Stay》所在的爱德华太子唐楼排起长队。周日晚上 9 点左右，Have a Nice Stay 联合创始人 Sum Wan-wah 在准备关门时感谢顾客的支持并祝愿他们一切顺利。 2026年8月30日，香港独立书店Have a Nice Stay迎来了营业的最后一天。墙上的卡片上写着：“尽力从窄门进入。”照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “大家保重，住得好，从今天开始停止营业。”沉先生用粤语对顾客和记者说，然后关上了他经营了四年的书店的大门。萨姆是上个月因涉嫌煽动叛乱而被该市国家安全警察逮捕的五名独立书商之一。其中三名被捕者在Have a Nice Stay工作，另外两人则在旺角拥有50年历史的翠怡书店工作。香港独立书店祝你住得愉快，2026 年 8 月 30 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。警方还突袭了这两家商店，没收了涉嫌煽动性的材料。五人随后获准保释，等待警方调查。另请参阅：对香港独立书店不断升级的打压如何让台湾出版商成为众人瞩目的焦点在突袭前一天，Have a Nice Stay 宣布将于 8 月 30 日关闭，理由是“红线不明确”和财务困境。 2026 年 8 月 30 日，香港独立书店 Have a Nice Stay 营业最后一天，支持者排队进入。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。此次逮捕标志着国家安全对该市独立书商的打压行动升级，此前，3 月份的 Book Punch 和 6 月份的 Hunter 书店都曾遭到逮捕。突袭后，Have a Nice Stay 已关闭数周，仅在上周三开始的清仓大甩卖期间开放。支持者从城市各处涌来，许多人沿着通往三楼书店的台阶耐心地排队。楼梯处设置了两台电风扇，缓解闷热。 2026 年 8 月 30 日闭店日，香港独立书店 Have a Nice Stay 挤满了支持者，其中包括身着绿色衣服的前立法会议员刘慧卿。照片：...

reflection.en: Even as authorities may seek to control the flow of information and ideas, the human spirit often finds ways to express its convictions. The patrons of Have a Nice Stay, by showing up on its final day, demonstrate a commitment to the values the bookstore represented, choosing to honor it despite its closure under pressure.
reflection.zh: 即使当局试图控制信息和思想的流动，人的精神常常会找到表达其信念的方式。“好好生活”书店的顾客们，在它结业的最后一天前来致意，这表明了他们对这家书店所代表的价值观的坚持，选择在压力下关门之际仍给予尊重。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: China’s Xi and Iran’s Pezeshkian in Kyrgyzstan, Putin expected
title.zh: 中国国家主席习近平和伊朗总统佩泽什齐扬在吉尔吉斯斯坦会晤，普京预计将出席

summary.en: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian met in Kyrgyzstan for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit. Russian President Vladimir Putin is also expected at the two-day event, which includes leaders from over a dozen other nations. The SCO, celebrating its 25th anniversary, aims to...
summary.zh: 中国国家主席习近平和伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什齐扬在吉尔吉斯斯坦出席了上海合作组织峰会。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京也预计将出席为期两天的活动，该活动汇集了十几个其他国家的领导人。上海合作组织正在庆祝其成立25周年，旨在成为西方影响力的制衡力量。

body.en: China’s Xi Jinping and Iranian President Massoud Pezeshkian were in Kyrgyzstan for a summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, with Russia’s Vladimir Putin expected later on Monday for the two-day event that will involve over a dozen other leaders. Bishkek, capital of Kyrgyzstan. Photo: Arseniy Kotov, via Pexels. The regional SCO bloc — which seeks to be a counterinfluence to the West — is celebrating its 25-year anniversary. The group brings together Russia, China, India, Pakistan, Iran, four Central Asian countries and Moscow-allied Belarus. Arriving in Bishkek on Sunday, Xi hailed what he described as a “golden period” in relations with Central Asian Kyrgyzstan, as China deepens its influence in the historically Russia-dominated region. Putin and Xi have previously used SCO summits to promote their vision of a multipolar world and present a united front against the West. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian. Photo: Wikicommons. It takes place four-and-a-half years into Moscow’s Ukraine invasion and six months into the war between Washington and Tehran. Iran’s Pezeshkian also arrived in Bishkek, Tehran’s media reported. Putin, Xi and Pezeshkian, as well as India’s Narendra Modi and Pakistan’s Shehbaz Sharif, are due to take part in a plenary session chaired by Kyrgyz leader Sadyr Japarov. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan is also expected to attend, although his country is not a formal member. Diplomacy Putin is also due to hold separate bilateral talks with Pezeshkian and Xi, among other leaders, Kremlin spokesman Yuri Ushakov said. Russia and Iran — among the most sanctioned states in the world — have massively deepened their military and economic ties since Moscow invaded Ukraine. US President Donald Trump has warned Moscow and Beijing against arming Iran. Putin’s meeting with Pezeshkian comes days after the CIA’s director John Ratcliffe made a rare trip to Moscow, with US media speculating he could have discussed Ukraine and Iran with his Russian counterparts. The SCO has historically focused on economic issues but has gained momentum in recent years under Moscow’s and Beijing’s leadership. A monument stands beside war-torn buildings in Borodyanka, Ukraine. Photo: Алесь Усцінаў, via Pexels. On top of its 10 members, it now has 15 “dialogue partners”, including Turkey, Saudi Arabia and Qatar. It also has two observer countries — Afghanistan and Mongolia. The SCO’s founding declaration says the group is “not an alliance directed against other states”. But Putin and Xi have repeatedly made anti-Western speeches during its summits. Chinese leader Xi Jinping. Photo: Wikicommons. At last year’s...
body.zh: 中国国家主席习近平和伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安正在吉尔吉斯斯坦参加上海合作组织峰会，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京预计将于周一晚些时候参加为期两天的活动，其他十几位领导人也将参加。比什凯克，吉尔吉斯斯坦首都。照片：Arseniy Kotov，来自 Pexels。旨在对西方产生反作用的上海合作组织区域集团正在庆祝其成立 25 周年。该组织由俄罗斯、中国、印度、巴基斯坦、伊朗、四个中亚国家以及莫斯科盟友白俄罗斯组成。习近平于周日抵达比什凯克，对他所说的中亚吉尔吉斯斯坦关系的“黄金时期”表示欢迎，因为中国在这个历史上由俄罗斯主导的地区的影响力不断加深。普京和习近平此前曾利用上合组织峰会来宣传他们的多极世界愿景，并提出对抗西方的统一战线。伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安。照片：维基共享资源。它发生在莫斯科入侵乌克兰四年半后，以及华盛顿与德黑兰之间的战争六个月后。据德黑兰媒体报道，伊朗的佩泽什基安也抵达比什凯克。普京、习近平和佩泽什基安，以及印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和巴基斯坦总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫将参加由吉尔吉斯斯坦领导人萨德尔·贾帕罗夫主持的全体会议。土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安预计也将出席，尽管他的国家不是正式成员。克里姆林宫发言人尤里·乌沙科夫表示，普京还将与佩泽什基安和习近平等领导人举行单独的双边会谈。自莫斯科入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯和伊朗——世界上受制裁最严重的国家之一——大幅加深了军事和经济联系。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普警告莫斯科和北京不要向伊朗提供武器。普京与佩泽什基安会面几天前，中央情报局局长约翰·拉特克利夫罕见地访问了莫斯科，美国媒体猜测他可能与俄罗斯同行讨论了乌克兰和伊朗问题。上合组织历史上一直专注于经济问题，但近年来在莫斯科和北京的领导下取得了发展势头。乌克兰博罗江卡，一座纪念碑矗立在饱受战争蹂躏的建筑旁。照片：Алесь Усцінаў，来自 Pexels。除了10个成员国外，它现在还有15个“对话伙伴”，包括土耳其、沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔。它还拥有两个观察员国——阿富汗和蒙古。上合组织的成立宣言称，该组织“不是针对其他国家的联盟”。但普京和习近平在峰会期间多次发表反西方言论。中国领导人习近平。照片：维基共享资源。去年的...

reflection.en: As leaders gather for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit, the stated aim is to foster regional stability and influence. This pursuit of peace, even among nations with differing geopolitical alignments, echoes the call to actively pursue peace through diplomatic means. May these leaders seek pathways that lead to genuine understanding and...
reflection.zh: 随着各国领导人齐聚上海合作组织峰会，其公开目标是促进地区稳定和影响力。这种对和平的追求，即使是在地缘政治立场不同的国家之间，也呼应了通过外交途径积极寻求和平的呼吁。愿这些领导人寻求能够带来真正理解与合作的途径，而非加剧分裂。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: 伦敦股市避开了 Shein 这颗“子弹”

summary.en: Shein, the Chinese fast-fashion giant, is set to list in Hong Kong with a reduced valuation after a potential London IPO stalled. Despite intense wooing by UK politicians seeking to revitalize the local market with 'tech adrenalin,' significant concerns regarding Shein's business model and ethical practices led to a...
summary.zh: 中国快时尚巨头 Shein 在伦敦上市计划搁置后，将转往香港上市，但估值有所缩水。尽管英国政界此前为了振兴当地市场而积极拉拢，希望注入“技术兴奋剂”，但由于对其商业模式和伦理实践存在重大疑虑，伦敦金融界对于未能成事反而感到一种解脱。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大质疑在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。从 2024 年到去年，随着两大主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of rapid economic growth often tempts leaders to overlook the long-term health and ethical foundations of their institutions. While the 'tech adrenalin' of a massive IPO is attractive, true prudence involves recognizing when a short-term gain carries risks that outweigh the benefits. Yahweh values the wisdom that looks beyond the surface of a...
reflection.zh: 对经济快速增长的追求往往诱使领导者忽视机构的长期健康和伦理基础。虽然大规模 IPO 带来的“技术兴奋剂”极具吸引力，但真正的谨慎在于识别短期利益何时携带了超过收益的风险。雅伟看重那种能看透“缩水的价格标签”表面、审视内在工作诚信的智慧。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论天安门守夜活动定罪：香港也被噤声。其他人应发声 | 社论

summary.en: Two activists in Hong Kong face jail sentences for organizing commemorations of the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the annual vigil could publicly keep the memory of the pro-democracy protests alive, but recent crackdowns have suppressed these freedoms.
summary.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织纪念1989年天安门镇压的活动而面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一可以公开纪念天安门民主抗议活动的地方，但最近的镇压已经扼杀了这些自由。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年血腥镇压民主抗议活动的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of two Hong Kong activists for organizing a Tiananmen vigil highlights the silencing of memory and dissent. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves," a principle embodied by those who sought to keep the truth of 1989 alive. As freedoms are crushed in Hong Kong, this story reminds us of the moral...
reflection.zh: 两名香港社运人士因组织天安门守夜活动而被定罪，这凸显了记忆和异议被压制的情况。箴言31:8呼吁我们“为不能自辩的人开口”，这正是那些努力让1989年真相得以存留的人所体现的原则。随着香港自由的被扼杀，这个故事提醒我们，其他人有道德义务为那些被噤声的人发声。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Protecting the peanut: Sensors help fend off fungus
title.zh: 保护花生：传感器有助于抵御真菌

summary.en: Virginia Tech researchers are developing sensors to help farmers detect and prevent the spread of Sclerotinia blight, a fungal disease that has caused up to 50% yield loss in Virginia peanuts in recent years. Early detection is crucial for managing the disease.
summary.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学的研究人员正在开发传感器，以帮助农民检测和预防菌核病（Sclerotinia blight）的传播。这种真菌病在近年来已导致弗吉尼亚花生产量损失高达50%。早期检测对于控制该疾病至关重要。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Sweet, salty, crunchy or creamy—no matter how it's munched, the Virginia peanut has been a cash crop for the commonwealth for much of the past two centuries. But a fungal disease called Sclerotinia blight has decimated peanut plant populations in recent years, with severe outbreaks causing up to a 50% yield loss.

Virginia Tech researchers hope to help farmers detect and prevent its spread by building sensors that can detect infection early.

"Early detection is critical because once the disease produces these irregular, rice grain-sized structures, it spreads quickly on the farm and will stick inside the soil for the next farming season," said Frank Erukainure, a doctoral candidate in the Department of Biological Systems Engineering. "It can survive for years and years, making it difficult to get rid of the disease."

An Institute for Critical Technology and Applied Science doctoral scholar, Erukainure is the lead author of a paper published in ACS Agricultural Science & Technology describing the development and testing of these low-cost sensors. His work on this project earned him the 2026 Boyd-Scott Graduate Research Award, one of the American Society of Agricultural and Biological Engineers' top honors for graduate scholarship.

In 2024, farmers in southeastern Virginia harvested about 30,000 acres of peanuts (about 47 square miles) and brought in a cumulative $37.4 million. Historically, farmers have relied on time-consuming physical inspections to detect the fungus, often when it's already too late to stop its spread.

But if the fungus is detected early, the plant can be treated with a fungicide to help prevent spread to healthy parts of the plant.

The sensor developed by Erukainure and his team at the Virginia Tech Digital Ag Technologies Lab, led by his adviser, Abhilash Chandel, assistant professor of precision agriculture and data management, detects the Sclerotinia minor pathogen as early as five days after infection. Physical symptoms, by contrast, sometimes do not appear for two months.

Peanut plant sap is extracted and placed on the sensor, which is composed of 3D-printed resin substrates and platinum electrodes. The sensors detect high concentrations of oxalic acid, a chemical that plants infected with the fungus Sclerotinia minor produce abundantly and that is present in their sap.

Although the sensor's early detection capability has been validated in greenhouse trials, additional field testing is needed to determine how and when the technology will be deployed on plants in real farm environments. As development continues, researchers will evaluate...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 甜的、咸的、松脆的或奶油状的——无论如何咀嚼，弗吉尼亚花生在过去两个世纪的大部分时间里一直是联邦的经济作物。但近年来，一种名为核盘菌枯萎病的真菌病导致花生植株数量大量减少，严重的爆发导致产量损失高达 50%。 弗吉尼亚理工大学的研究人员希望通过构建可以早期检测感染的传感器来帮助农民检测和防止其传播。 生物系统工程系博士研究生 Frank Erukainure 表示：“早期发现至关重要，因为一旦这种疾病产生这些不规则的米粒大小的结构，它就会在农场迅速传播，并在下一个农耕季节停留在土壤中。” “它可以存活很多年，因此很难摆脱这种疾病。” Erukainure 是关键技术和应用科学研究所的博士生，他是《ACS 农业科学与技术》杂志上发表的一篇论文的主要作者，该论文描述了这些低成本传感器的开发和测试。他在该项目上的工作为他赢得了 2026 年博伊德-斯科特研究生研究奖，这是美国农业和生物工程师学会授予研究生奖学金的最高荣誉之一。 2024年，弗吉尼亚州东南部的农民收获了约3万英亩（约47平方英里）的花生，累计收入达3740万美元。从历史上看，农民一直依靠耗时的物理检查来检测真菌，但往往已经来不及阻止其传播了。 但如果及早发现真菌，可以用杀菌剂处理植物，以帮助防止真菌传播到植物的健康部位。 Erukainure 和他在弗吉尼亚理工大学数字农业技术实验室的团队开发的传感器，由他的顾问、精准农业和数据管理助理教授 Abhilash Chandel 领导，最早在感染后五天即可检测到核盘菌轻微病原体。相比之下，身体症状有时两个月才出现。 提取花生植物汁液并将其放置在由 3D 打印树脂基板和铂电极组成的传感器上。这些传感器检测到高浓度的草酸，这种化学物质是感染小核盘菌的植物大量产生的，存在于其汁液中。 尽管传感器的早期检测能力已在温室试验中得到验证，但还需要进行额外的现场测试来确定如何以及何时将该技术部署到真实农场环境中的植物上。随着开发的继续，研究人员将评估......

reflection.en: Faced with a devastating fungal blight that threatens a vital crop, these researchers are dedicating their skills and efforts to finding a technological solution. Their work embodies the principle of committing one's endeavors to God, trusting that their diligent efforts will yield fruit for the good of farmers and the sustenance of the land. May their...
reflection.zh: 面对威胁重要作物的毁灭性真菌病，这些研究人员正致力于运用他们的技能和努力寻找技术解决方案。他们的工作体现了将努力付托于雅伟的原则，并相信他们勤奋的付出将结出硕果，造福农民，滋养土地。 愿他们对知识和创新的追求得到智慧的指引，从而开发出有效的工具来保护收成，并荣耀大地。

title.en: Wildfire losses have lasting economic consequences for homeowners
title.zh: 野火损失对房主造成持久的经济后果

summary.en: A new working paper from the National Bureau of Economic Research at UC San Diego reveals that wildfire damage inflicts long-term economic consequences on households, including income loss, relocation, and prolonged rebuilding efforts lasting several years post-fire. The study analyzed damage data for approximately...
summary.zh: 国家经济研究所（National Bureau of Economic Research）的一份新工作论文显示，野火造成的损害会对家庭产生长期的经济后果，包括收入损失、居民搬迁以及火灾发生后数年的缓慢重建。该研究结合了约10万名个人和5万户家庭在野火燃烧区域的房屋地址级别损害数据。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new National Bureau of Economic Research working paper from the University of California San Diego shows that wildfire damage can have long-term economic consequences for households, resulting in income losses, resident relocation and slow rebuilding for several years after a fire.

The study combines home address-level damage data from about 100,000 individuals and 50,000 homes within wildfire burn areas.

It finds that wildfire victims are wealthier on average than victims of some other natural disasters, but the burden of wildfire damage is unevenly distributed. Within fire zones, lower-income households are more likely to lose their homes.

The paper, co-authored by Judson Boomhower, associate professor in the Department of Economics at the UC San Diego School of Social Sciences, finds that households that lose their homes in a wildfire see their earnings fall for three years after the event, with losses peaking at about 10% in the first year. Over that period, the average wildfire victim forgoes the equivalent of 26% of their pre-fire annual income, or about $35,000.

"While wildfire victims on average are relatively affluent, we find that losing a home leads to years of financial disruptions that go beyond the immediate costs of rebuilding the burned property," Boomhower said. "Earnings fall for years after the fire and people do not simply bounce back even after rebuilding."

Many burned homes take years to be reoccupied. Four years after a wildfire, about half of burned homes remain unoccupied. Among reoccupied homes, average resident income is systematically higher and average age is systematically lower than pre-fire levels. The authors say these data are consistent with anecdotal reports of what has been referred to as "post-disaster gentrification."

While the study does not directly measure whether homes had adequate insurance coverage, it offers a detailed look at the economic consequences of wildfire loss by linking property damage data with income tax and Census records. The analysis focuses on occupants of single-family homes, while also examining differences by homeownership status, giving a fuller picture of how households are affected and how their recovery unfolds over time.

Boomhower says the findings show that wildfire is not only a climate and public safety issue, but also a challenge for markets and policy.

"We're facing a much warmer world and the big question now is how markets, innovators and policymakers can help society adapt," Boomhower said.

The authors conclude that the economic burden of wildfire extends well beyond the fire line...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 加州大学圣地亚哥分校国家经济研究局的一份新工作文件显示，野火损害可能会给家庭带来长期的经济后果，导致收入损失、居民搬迁以及火灾后数年的缓慢重建。 该研究结合了野火烧毁地区约 100,000 名个人和 50,000 所房屋的家庭地址级损坏数据。 研究发现，平均而言，山火受害者比其他一些自然灾害的受害者更富有，但山火损失的负担分布不均。在火灾区内，低收入家庭更有可能失去家园。 这篇由加州大学圣地亚哥分校社会科学学院经济系副教授贾德森·布姆豪威尔 (Judson Boomhower) 合着的论文发现，在野火中失去家园的家庭在火灾发生后的三年内收入都会下降，第一年的损失达到峰值约 10%。在此期间，野火受害者平均损失相当于火灾前年收入的 26%，即约 35,000 美元。 布姆豪威尔说：“虽然野火受害者平均来说相对富裕，但我们发现失去房屋会导致数年的财务混乱，这超出了重建被烧毁财产的直接成本。” “火灾发生后，收入连续多年下降，即使在重建后，人们也不会简单地反弹。” 许多被烧毁的房屋需要数年时间才能重新入住。野火四年后，大约一半被烧毁的房屋仍然无人居住。在重新入住的房屋中，居民平均收入普遍高于火灾前水平，平均年龄普遍低于火灾前水平。作者表示，这些数据与所谓的“灾后中产阶级化”的传闻是一致的。 虽然该研究没有直接衡量房屋是否有足够的保险覆盖范围，但它通过将财产损失数据与所得税和人口普查记录联系起来，详细研究了野火损失的经济后果。该分析重点关注单户住宅的居住者，同时还研究了房屋所有权状况的差异，更全面地了解家庭受到的影响以及随着时间的推移他们的复苏如何展开。 布姆豪威尔表示，调查结果表明，野火不仅是气候和公共安全问题，也是对市场和政策的挑战。 “我们面临着一个更加温暖的世界，现在的大问题是市场、创新者和政策制定者如何帮助社会适应，”布姆豪威尔说。 作者得出的结论是，野火的经济负担远远超出了火线……

reflection.en: Wildfires leave behind more than just scorched earth; they inflict deep economic wounds that can take years to heal. For homeowners facing income loss and the daunting task of rebuilding, the present suffering can feel overwhelming. Yet, scripture reminds us that these present hardships, however severe, do not compare to the enduring hope and future...
reflection.zh: 野火留下的不仅仅是焦土；它们造成了深刻的经济创伤，可能需要数年才能治愈。对于那些面临收入损失和重建艰巨任务的房主来说，眼前的痛苦可能令人难以承受。然而，圣经提醒我们，这些眼前的苦难，无论多么严重，都无法与那永恒的盼望和未来的复兴相提并论。

verse.textEn: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.
verse.textZh: 我想，现在的苦楚若比起将来要显于我们的荣耀，就不足介意了。

title.en: Deadly virus stalks South Africa's sardines
title.zh: 致命病毒困扰南非沙丁鱼

summary.en: Thousands of dead sardines washed ashore on South Africa's south coast last week, with residents fearing a virus linked to devastating sardine die-offs overseas may be responsible. Local environmental groups described the scene as 'heartbreaking.'
summary.zh: 上周，数千条死去的沙丁鱼被冲上南非南海岸，居民们担心一种与海外毁灭性沙丁鱼死亡事件相关的病毒可能在作祟。当地环保组织形容这一景象“令人心碎”。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The tide came in last week carrying thousands of dead sardines onto South Africa's south coast, and by dawn, stretches of Gqeberha's shoreline were flecked with silver.

Along Hobie and Pollock beaches, bewildered residents watched as waves deposited more fish on the sand, fueling fears that a virus linked to devastating sardine die-offs overseas may be at work.

"It was a heartbreaking sight," local environmental group Algoa Bay Conservation said.

"We received numerous calls," Nadine Strydom, a professor in the zoology department at Nelson Mandela University, told AFP.

Most of the fish were sardines and pilchards, she said, adding that the true scale of the mortality could be far greater than what washed ashore.

"What we see on the beach is only a fraction, as some could be lying on the seabed," she said.

The mass stranding came just weeks after a similar die-off along South Africa's Western Cape coast, hundreds of kilometers away.

The wash-up has intensified concerns that pilchard herpesvirus, or PHV, a disease that devastated sardine populations in Australia and New Zealand in the 1990s, may be spreading through South African waters.

The Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment (DFFE) said on Sunday that a link between the Gqeberha and Western Cape events was considered likely, although it still required confirmation.

"PHV remains the leading explanation for the Western Cape mortality event," the department said, adding that other causes and environmental factors would also be investigated.

The virus was first confirmed in South African waters in July after sardines collected off Saldanha Bay, Cape Canyon, Elands Bay and Gansbaai tested positive, DFFE said.

Genetic sequencing showed more than 99% similarity to the strain associated with the Australian outbreak.

"This is the first time it has happened in South African history," Strydom said.

PHV genetic material was found in both dead and apparently healthy sardines collected off Saldanha Bay, with the highest viral levels recorded in dead fish.

But the finding does not prove that PHV caused the deaths, DFFE spokesperson Zolile Nqayi said.

Scientists are examining whether the virus is the primary cause or is infecting fish already weakened by environmental stress.

South Africa's sardine stocks are already low, while oxygen-depleted waters and harmful algal blooms can leave them more vulnerable to disease.

Government testing found no evidence of paralytic shellfish toxins and only low levels of other marine toxins, suggesting algal poisoning was unlikely to be the primary driver.
