title.en: ‘Superhuman’ AI tool spots heart disease in less than 2 seconds
title.zh: “超人”人工智能工具2秒内发现心脏病

summary.en: A new AI tool, trained on millions of routine ECGs, can detect heart disease in under two seconds by analyzing data beyond human visual capacity. This technology aims to expedite treatment for high-risk patients, potentially reducing the need for lengthy waits for echocardiograms.
summary.zh: 一款新的人工智能工具，通过对数百万份常规心电图进行训练，能在两秒内发现心脏病，其分析能力超越了人眼所能见的范畴。该技术旨在加快高风险患者的治疗进程，并可能减少对需要长时间等待的超声心动图检查的依赖。

body.en:
Doctors have developed a “superhuman” AI tool that can spot heart disease in less than two seconds.

The groundbreaking technology has been trained on millions of patients and works by extracting more information from a routine electrocardiogram (ECG) than the human eye can typically see.

The traditional ECG, which records electrical activity in the heart, including the rate and rhythm, has been a vital medical tool in diagnosing heart attacks and abnormal heart rhythms for a century.

But it cannot detect heart disease. That requires an echocardiogram, a type of ultrasound scan, which patients often have to wait months for.

Now a team have developed an AI tool that can spot signs of heart failure and heart valve disease – two of the most common forms of heart disease – from ECG results in “the blink of an eye”.

Details of the breakthrough, which could boost early diagnosis of heart disease, were presented to thousands of delegates at the European Society of Cardiology annual congress in Munich, the world’s largest heart conference.

Early diagnosis is vital for heart failure and heart valve disease, enabling those who need lifesaving medicines to be spotted sooner, before they become dangerously unwell.

The development is being seen as potentially significant, because ECGs are one of the most common tests in medicine, with about a billion performed worldwide each year.

In a trial involving 67,000 patients in the US, the AI tool was able to identify up to 81% of those who had heart failure, and up to 90% of those with heart valve disease.

Dr Sonya Babu-Narayan, a consultant cardiologist and clinical director of the British Heart Foundation (BHF), which funded the trial, said: “It is exciting to see that AI can now deliver a read-out from an ECG in what feels like the blink of an eye.

“Technology like the AI ECG in this research, which has the potential to identify high-risk patients early, will not detect everyone with a heart condition. But it could be a solution to help fast-track the patients who are most likely to have a heart abnormality. When it comes to the heart, earlier diagnosis and treatment saves and improves lives.”

The tech cannot be used on its own to definitively diagnose or rule out heart failure or heart valve disease, but it gives a very strong indication someone may have them.

Someone judged as highly likely to have either could be sent rapidly for an echocardiogram, rather than wait months on the standard waiting lists. That could mean a quicker diagnosis which would enable them to start treatment earlier.

Prof Fu Siong Ng, a professor of cardiology at Imperial College London, said: “Patients can often wait several months for a heart ultrasound scan after being referred for one by their doctor.

“This makes it exciting...
body.zh: 医生们开发出了一种“超人”的人工智能工具，可以在不到两秒的时间内发现心脏病。 这项突破性的技术已经在数百万患者身上进行了培训，其工作原理是从常规心电图 (ECG) 中提取比人眼通常可以看到的更多信息。 传统的心电图记录心脏的电活动，包括心率和节律，一个世纪以来一直是诊断心脏病和心律失常的重要医疗工具。 但它无法检测心脏病。这需要超声心动图（一种超声波扫描），患者通常需要等待数月。 现在，一个团队开发了一种人工智能工具，可以根据“眨眼间”的心电图结果发现心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病（两种最常见的心脏病形式）的迹象。 这一突破的细节可以促进心脏病的早期诊断，在慕尼黑举行的欧洲心脏病学会年会上向数千名代表介绍了这一突破，这是世界上最大的心脏病会议。 早期诊断对于心力衰竭和心脏瓣膜疾病至关重要，使那些需要救生药物的人能够在出现危险的不适之前尽早发现。 这一发展被认为具有潜在的重大意义，因为心电图是医学中最常见的测试之一，全世界每年进行约十亿次。 在美国一项涉及 67,000 名患者的试验中，AI 工具能够识别出高达 81% 的心力衰竭患者和高达 90% 的心脏瓣膜疾病患者。 资助这项试验的英国心脏基金会 (BHF) 的心脏病专家兼临床主任索尼娅·巴布-纳拉扬 (Sonya Babu-Narayan) 博士表示：“令人兴奋的是，人工智能现在可以在眨眼的时间内读取心电图读数。 “这项研究中的人工智能心电图等技术有可能及早识别出高危患者，但无法检测出每个患有心脏病的人。但这可能是帮助快速追踪最有可能患有心脏异常的患者的解决方案。当涉及到心脏时，早期诊断和治疗可以挽救并改善生命。” 该技术不能单独用于明确诊断或排除心力衰竭或心脏瓣膜疾病，但它给出了一个非常强烈的迹象，表明某人可能患有这些疾病。 被判断为极有可能患有这两种疾病的人可以被迅速送去做超声心动图检查，而不是在标准等待名单上等待数月。这可能意味着更快的诊断，使他们能够更早地开始治疗。 伦敦帝国理工学院心脏病学教授 Fu Siong Ng 教授表示：“在医生推荐进行心脏超声扫描后，患者通常需要等待几个月才能进行心脏超声扫描。 “这让人兴奋......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as seen in this new tool's ability to diagnose heart disease, reflects a world where human knowledge and technical capabilities are accelerating. As we witness such profound leaps in understanding and application, we are reminded of the biblical observation that in the end times, 'many will run to and fro,...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如这款能诊断心脏病的工具所示，反映了一个人类知识和技术能力日益加速的世界。当我们见证理解和应用上的巨大飞跃时，我们不禁想起圣经中的观察——在末世，“许多人往来奔跑，知识也必增长”。这种技术进步为治疗和福祉带来了巨大的潜力，呼唤我们以智慧和怜悯之心来管理它。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: ‘Scary’: how misinformation and AI hallucinations are infiltrating Australia’s parliament
title.zh: “可怕”：虚假信息和人工智能幻觉如何渗透澳大利亚议会

summary.en: Guardian analysis reveals that dozens of policy submissions across the political spectrum incorrectly summarize real research and invent or wrongly cite sources. This AI-generated material is flooding Australia's government inquiry process, inventing studies and attributing nonexistent research to real academics.
summary.zh: 《卫报》的分析显示，来自不同政治派别的数十份政策提交材料错误地总结了真实研究，并捏造或错误引用了来源。这些人工智能生成的材料充斥着澳大利亚的政府问询过程，捏造研究并将其归功于真实学者但实际上并不存在的来源。

body.en: Exclusive : Guardian analysis reveals that dozens of policy submissions from across the political spectrum incorrectly summarise real research and invent or wrongly cite sources Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s government inquiry process is supposed to help parliament make better decisions, hearing from experts and constituents alike. But Guardian Australia can reveal that the system is being flooded with AI-generated material, which is inventing studies and attributing nonexistent research to real academics and authors. In some cases, committee reports have cited submissions in which the majority of sources appear to be AI-generated “hallucinations”, when large language models (LLMs) invent content that looks real but doesn’t actually exist. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：《卫报》分析显示，来自各个政治派别的数十份政策提交文件错误地总结了真实的研究和发明，或错误地引用了消息来源。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 澳大利亚政府的调查程序应该帮助议会做出更好的决策，听取专家和选民的意见。但《澳大利亚卫报》可以透露，该系统正在充斥着人工智能生成的材料，这些材料正在发明研究，并将不存在的研究归因于真正的学者和作者。在某些情况下，委员会报告引用了提交的材料，其中大多数来源似乎是人工智能生成的“幻觉”，即大型语言模型（LLM）发明了看起来真实但实际上并不存在的内容。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The infiltration of AI-generated falsehoods into parliamentary submissions is a stark reminder of the corrosive power of untruth. Ephesians 4:25 calls us to "put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another." In an age where AI can mimic human communication, discerning truth and upholding integrity in our discourse becomes ever more critical.
reflection.zh: 人工智能生成的谎言渗透到议会提交材料中，这 stark地提醒我们虚假信息的腐蚀力量。以弗所书4:25呼吁我们“所以，你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话”。在一个人工智能可以模仿人类交流的时代，辨别真理并在我们的言论中坚守诚信变得至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: I've tested dozens of items to perfect my work-from-home setup. These 13 make all the difference
title.zh: 我测试了数十种物品，以完善我的家庭办公设置。这 13 种物品至关重要

summary.en: Build a home office you’ll actually enjoying working from with tried-and-true upgrades – from inexpensive speakers to a stand that can turn an iPad into a second monitor. The best wireless earbuds in the US – tested. Sign up for the Filter US newsletter, your weekly guide to buying fewer, better things. If you work...
summary.zh: 打造一个您真正乐于工作的家庭办公室，进行久经考验的升级——从便宜的扬声器到可以将 iPad 变成第二显示器的支架。美国最佳无线耳塞——经过测试。订阅 Filter US...

body.en: Build a home office you’ll actually enjoying working from with tried-and-true upgrades – from inexpensive speakers to a stand that can turn an iPad into a second monitor The best wireless earbuds in the US – tested Sign up for the Filter US newsletter, your weekly guide to buying fewer, better things If you work from home , even just a few days a week, you need more than a laptop perched on a sticky kitchen table. A dedicated desk setup allows you to step away from distractions, plop in your office chair and get to work. It also creates a vital separation between your personal and professional life. After spending my initial work-from-home days on a living room couch, I quickly realized the importance of creating a separate space, and I have spent seven years refining it. As a tech writer, I have tested dozens of products for my desk setup, and have found some to be totally invaluable. Here are the tried-and-true upgrades that will make working from home easier, more comfortable and even more productive. Continue reading...
body.zh: 通过经过验证的升级打造一个真正让您享受工作乐趣的家庭办公室 - 从便宜的扬声器到可以将 iPad 变成第二个显示器的支架 美国最好的无线耳机 - 经过测试 注册 Filter US 时事通讯，您的每周指南，购买更少、更好的东西 如果您在家工作，即使每周只有几天，您需要的不仅仅是放在粘糊糊的厨房桌子上的笔记本电脑。专用的办公桌设置可以让您远离干扰，坐在办公椅上开始工作。它还在您的个人生活和职业生活之间造成了重要的分离。在客厅的沙发上度过了最初在家工作的日子后，我很快意识到创建一个独立空间的重要性，并且我花了七年的时间来完善它。作为一名技术作家，我已经测试了数十种适合我的办公桌设置的产品，并发现其中一些是完全无价的。以下是经过验证的升级，它们将使在家工作变得更轻松、更舒适、甚至更高效。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Creating a productive and enjoyable workspace is more than just a matter of comfort or efficiency; it can be an act of dedication. When we approach our tasks, even those seemingly mundane like setting up a desk, with the intention of doing them wholeheartedly as for Yahweh, we infuse our work with purpose and dignity. This mindset transforms our daily...
reflection.zh: 创造一个高效且令人愉悦的工作空间，不仅仅是为了舒适或效率；它可以是一种奉献的行为。当我们怀着全心全意为雅伟而做的意图来对待我们的任务时，即使是设置办公桌这样看似平凡的事情，我们也能为工作注入目标和尊严。这种心态将我们日常的例行公事转变为忠诚和卓越的机会。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: ChatGPT and Reddit now face EU's toughest online safety rules
title.zh: ChatGPT和Reddit现面临欧盟最严苛的在线安全法规

summary.en: The rapid growth of AI services like ChatGPT and platforms like Reddit brings them under the European Union's stringent Digital Services Act, imposing obligations to remove illegal content and protect minors, with potential fines for non-compliance.
summary.zh: OpenAI的ChatGPT等人工智能服务以及Reddit等平台，因其爆炸式增长而受到欧盟《数字服务法》的严格监管，面临移除非法内容和保护未成年人的义务，否则可能面临巨额罚款。

body.en: OpenAI’s ChatGPT will have to comply with tougher EU rules such as removing illegal content or face potential fines, the European Commission said on Monday, as Brussels grapples with how its existing digital regulation applies to rapidly evolving AI services. The Commission said the chatbot, social media forum Reddit, and gaming platform Roblox would be classified as so-called very large online platforms under the EU Digital Services Act, its landmark online safety regime. The designation means all three services will face additional obligations such as removing illegal content and protecting the privacy and security of minors and could face fines of up to 6 percent of their global revenue if they fail to comply. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 欧盟委员会周一表示，OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 将必须遵守更严格的欧盟规则，例如删除非法内容，否则将面临潜在的罚款，因为布鲁塞尔正在努力解决其现有的数字监管如何适用于快速发展的人工智能服务的问题。欧盟委员会表示，根据欧盟数字服务法案（其具有里程碑意义的在线安全制度），聊天机器人、社交媒体论坛 Reddit 和游戏平台 Roblox 将被归类为所谓的超大型在线平台。这一指定意味着所有三项服务都将面临额外义务，例如删除非法内容以及保护未成年人的隐私和安全，如果不遵守规定，可能面临高达全球收入 6% 的罚款。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence and online platforms rapidly expand, the EU's new regulations for services like ChatGPT underscore the need for careful stewardship. The principle that 'not everything is beneficial' reminds us to discern the true good in technological progress, ensuring it serves humanity ethically and safely.
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能和在线平台的飞速发展，欧盟对ChatGPT等服务的新法规凸显了审慎管理的必要性。《凡事都可行，但不都有益》的原则提醒我们，要在技术进步中辨别真正的益处，确保其合乎伦理且安全地服务于人类。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: NASA's next "great observatory" begins mission to widen our view of the Universe
title.zh: NASA的新“伟大天文台”开始任务，拓宽我们对宇宙的视野

summary.en: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, a $4.3 billion mission launched Sunday, aims to reveal the mysterious forces driving the universe. With a 300-megapixel camera and a field of view 100 times wider than Hubble, it will complement the James Webb Space Telescope's work.
summary.zh: 美国宇航局耗资43亿美元的南希·格蕾丝·罗马空间望远镜于周日发射升空，旨在揭示驱动宇宙的神秘力量。该望远镜配备了3亿像素的摄像头，视野比哈勃望远镜宽100倍，将补充詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜的工作。

body.en: NASA's $4.3 billion Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, equipped with a 300-megapixel camera sighted through a refurbished spy mirror, launched Sunday from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on a mission to reveal the mysterious forces driving the Universe. The new mission will extend the vision of NASA's other famous observatories, providing a field of view 100 times wider than the Hubble Space Telescope and complementing the groundbreaking work of the James Webb Space Telescope . Roman is just the second NASA-led astrophysics mission to launch this century, following the launch of Webb in 2021 . Unlike Webb, which suffered many years of delays before reaching space, Roman arrived at the launch pad nine months before NASA's commitment to send it skyward by May 2027. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 美国宇航局耗资 43 亿美元的南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜周日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射升空，其任务是揭示驱动宇宙的神秘力量，该望远镜配备了通过翻新间谍镜观察的 300 兆像素相机。新任务将扩展NASA其他著名天文台的视野，提供比哈勃太空望远镜宽100倍的视场，并补充詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的开创性工作。罗曼只是继 2021 年韦伯太空望远镜发射之后，本世纪由 NASA 领导的第二个天体物理任务。与韦伯号在抵达太空之前经历了多年的延误不同，罗曼比 NASA 承诺在 2027 年 5 月之前将其送上天空的时间早九个月到达发射台。 阅读全文

reflection.en: The launch of the Roman Space Telescope marks a profound moment for human curiosity. As this instrument turns its gaze outward, it will capture images of cosmic scale, reminding us that the vastness of creation testifies to its Creator. May this expanded vision inspire awe and humility, drawing us closer to understanding the grandeur of Yahweh's handiwork.
reflection.zh: 罗马空间望远镜的发射标志着人类好奇心的又一个重要时刻。当这个仪器将目光投向宇宙深处时，它将捕捉到宇宙尺度的图像，提醒我们，创造的浩瀚见证着它的创造者。愿这扩展的视野激发敬畏和谦卑，使我们更接近理解雅伟工之伟大的程度。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Pocket's AI made my game ideas real. Now Meta controls the results.
title.zh: Pocket 的 AI 让我的游戏创意成真。现在 Meta 控制了结果。

summary.en: Interactive mobile "gizmos" are easy to make, but difficult to share outside of Meta's platform.
summary.zh: 交互式移动“小玩意”很容易制作，但在 Meta 平台之外却难以分享。

body.en: The relatively recent rise of AI-assisted coding tools and the whole concept of "vibe coding" have effectively upended entire software development workflows. While these tools have been available to novice coders willing to put in the work to set them up , those with little to no coding experience could still be a little put off by the CLIs , IDEs , and terminal-based tinkering needed to create a complex AI-coded project these days. Meta's latest AI-based project launch wants to make that kind of vibe coding as instantly accessible as posting on social media. Pocket—which launched in the US last Friday, August 21, after Meta acquired the staff behind the now-defunct vibe-coding app Gizmo in March—is a mobile app that lets users create fully functional interactive "gizmos" just by typing prompts into a text box, without even the option to look at a line of code. Those gizmos can then be shared with the world in a TikTok-style endless scroll complete with likes, comments, reposts, and all the other hallmarks of social media addiction. After playing around with Pocket for the better part of a week, I found myself getting hooked on the simple process of quickly standing up functional, relatively feature-rich game prototypes simply by chatting with an LLM. But the result of all that time and AI effort is a couple of interactive toys that are effectively trapped in Meta's new walled garden, without any real way to turn them into something separate. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 最近兴起的人工智能辅助编码工具和“vibe 编码”的整个概念有效地颠覆了整个软件开发工作流程。虽然这些工具已经可供愿意投入工作来设置它们的新手编码人员使用，但那些几乎没有编码经验的人仍然可能会对当今创建复杂的人工智能编码项目所需的 CLI、IDE 和基于终端的修补感到有点犹豫。 Meta 最新推出的基于人工智能的项目希望使这种氛围编码像在社交媒体上发布一样立即可用。 Pocket 是一款移动应用程序，用户只需在文本框中输入提示即可创建功能齐全的交互式“小玩意”，甚至不需要查看一行代码。Meta 于 3 月份收购了现已解散的振动编码应用程序 Gizmo 的开发人员后，Pocket 于 8 月 21 日上周五在美国推出。然后，这些小玩意可以通过 TikTok 风格的无尽滚动与全世界分享，其中包括点赞、评论、转发以及社交媒体成瘾的所有其他标志。在玩了一周的 Pocket 后，我​​发现自己迷上了这个简单的过程，只需与法学硕士聊天即可快速建立实用的、功能相对丰富的游戏原型。但所有这些时间和人工智能努力的结果是几个互动玩具，它们实际上被困在 Meta 的新围墙花园中，没有任何真正的方法将它们变成单独的东西。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Meta's Pocket app aims to democratize creation through AI, allowing users to build interactive 'gizmos' with ease. This technological leap, while exciting, raises questions about control and accessibility, mirroring the ancient story of Babel where human ambition to build and connect on a grand scale was met with divine intervention. The challenge lies in...
reflection.zh: Meta 的 Pocket 应用旨在通过人工智能普及创作，让用户轻松构建交互式“小玩意”。这一技术飞跃虽然令人兴奋，但引发了关于控制和可访问性的问题，这与古代巴别塔的故事相似，当时人类大规模建造和连接的雄心壮志受到了神的干预。挑战在于，如何利用这些强大的工具来实现真正的连接，而不是被中心化的控制所束缚。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: I've been to Gamescom six times - here's what excited me this year
title.zh: 我曾六次参加Gamescom——今年让我兴奋的是这些

summary.en: The BBC's Laura Cress gets a first look at the biggest games in Cologne from Witcher 3 to Alien: Isolation 2.
summary.zh: BBC记者劳拉·克雷斯在科隆首次看到了《巫师3》到《异形：隔离2》等大作。

body.en:
Gamescom is the largest in-person gaming event in the world, and this year it lived up to expectations with big games on show from The Witcher 3's new expansion, to Alien: Isolation 2.

Last year over 350,000 people flocked to the halls of the Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany to get a chance to see and play the most hotly anticipated games.

This year that number of attendees is expected to have been even bigger, with the likes of Xbox and Sega showcasing games to the public alongside indie studios with only one or two developers.

This was my sixth time attending Gamescom, which never fails to make me excited about the games industry. Here are a few of the big things I got to check out this week.

When CD Projekt Red announced it was making a new expansion for the hugely popular action-role playing game The Witcher 3, it came as a shock.

Yet it was clear sitting in the crowd for Opening Night Live on Tuesday that there's still a lot of love for the older game. There were gasps and audible shouts of joy when the team announced they were providing a free upgrade to the original.

As for the expansion, Songs of the Past will follow the gruff-voiced protagonist Geralt in an adventure discovering more about the past of his close friend Dandelion.

Doug Cockle, who voices Geralt, told me it was a "thrill" to return as The Witcher.

"I love this character so much...it's like slipping into a warm bath, or putting on an old pair of shoes," he said.

From what I got to see, it's clear choice will once again be front and centre of the player's experience, with lots of options to choose from in how to react to people.

For those hoping to take their time tossing a coin to their Witcher, the head of co-developer Fool's Theory Jakub Rokosz told me this expansion would be "on par with the size" of previous additions such as Blood and Wine and Hearts of Stone.

Alien: Isolation 2 is the long-awaited sequel to Horsham-based Creative Assembly's 2014 survival-horror game.

One of the things that made the original Alien: Isolation so terrifying was its seemingly intelligent Xenomorph, which appeared to learn from your behaviour and adapt to it.

Considering I physically jumped out of my seat at one point playing the demo when avoiding the Alien, it's safe to say Creative Assembly will once again be ratcheting up the tension with the sequel.

This time rather than playing as the daughter of Ellen Ripley, you play as Blake, a chief executive of the infamous Weyland-Yutani corporation.

As well as claustrophobic spaceship corridors, in the sequel you will also be avoiding the Alien in bigger, open air spaces.

But the game's Project Art Director Anastasia Sopikova said that did not mean you would always feel safer.

body.zh: Gamescom 是世界上最大的现场游戏盛会，今年它不负众望，展出了从《巫师 3》新资料片到《异形：隔离 2》等大型游戏。 去年，超过 350,000 人涌入德国科隆科隆展览馆的大厅，有机会观看和体验最受期待的比赛。 今年的参加人数预计会更多，Xbox 和世嘉等公司将向公众展示游戏，而独立工作室也只有一到两名开发者。 这是我第六次参加科隆游戏展，这始终让我对游戏行业感到兴奋。以下是我本周要检查的一些重要事项。 当 CD Projekt Red 宣布将为广受欢迎的动作角色扮演游戏《巫师 3》制作新资料片时，人们感到震惊。 然而，坐在周二开幕夜现场的人群中可以明显看出，人们仍然对这款老游戏充满喜爱。当团队宣布他们将提供对原始版本的免费升级时，大家都惊呼不已，欢呼雀跃。 至于资料片，《往日之歌》将跟随声音粗哑的主角杰洛特踏上冒险之旅，更多地了解他的好友丹德里恩的过去。 为杰洛特配音的道格·科克尔告诉我，回归扮演《巫师》是一种“兴奋”。 “我非常喜欢这个角色……这就像洗个热水澡，或者穿上一双旧鞋，”他说。 从我所看到的来看，很明显，选择将再次成为玩家体验的前沿和中心，在如何对人做出反应方面有很多选项可供选择。 对于那些希望花时间向《巫师》投掷硬币的人来说，《愚人理论》的联合开发者负责人 Jakub Rokosz 告诉我，这次扩展包的规模将与《血与酒》和《石之心》等之前的新增内容“相当”。 《异形：隔离 2》是总部位于霍舍姆的 Creative Assembly 2014 年推出的生存恐怖游戏的续作，人们期待已久。 让原版《异形：隔离》如此可怕的原因之一是它看似聪明的异形，它似乎可以从你的行为中学习并适应它。 考虑到我在玩演示时在躲避外星人时从座位上跳了起来，可以肯定地说，《Creative Assembly》将再次加剧续集的紧张气氛。 这次你不再扮演艾伦·里普利的女儿，而是扮演臭名昭著的韦兰·尤塔尼公司的首席执行官布莱克。 除了幽闭恐怖的太空飞船走廊外，在续集中，你还将在更大的露天空间中躲避外星人。 但游戏的项目艺术总监阿纳斯塔西娅·索皮科娃（Anastasia Sopikova）表示，这并不意味着你总是会感到更安全。 “你走出去。你会说，‘哦，是的，我......

reflection.en: Gamescom, the world's largest in-person gaming event, showcases the latest innovations in interactive entertainment. As technology rapidly advances, Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when "knowledge will increase." This event is a vivid example of that, with hundreds of thousands gathering to experience the cutting edge of digital creation. This surge in...
reflection.zh: 作为全球最大的线下游戏盛会，Gamescom展示了互动娱乐领域的最新创新。随着科技的飞速发展，但以理的预言说，那将是“知识增长”的时代。这次盛会生动地体现了这一点，数十万人聚集于此，体验数字创作的前沿成果。 这种技术发展的激增及其广泛传播，正如游戏行业所见，促使我们思考在追求和应用新知识时应有的智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville among actors calling for law on AI voice cloning
title.zh: 马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利等演员呼吁针对人工智能语音克隆立法

summary.en: Actors including Matt Lucas and Hugh Bonneville are urging the UK government to establish legal ownership rights over individual voices to protect against AI cloning. They argue that the ability of AI to replicate a person's voice in minutes poses an existential threat to the performing arts industry.
summary.zh: 包括马特·卢卡斯和休·博内威利在内的演员正敦促英国政府确立个人声音的法律所有权，以防止人工智能克隆。他们认为，人工智能在几分钟内就能复制一个人声音的能力，对表演艺术行业构成了生存威胁。

body.en:
Actors including Matt Lucas, Hugh Bonneville and Nicola Coughlan have written to the UK government demanding greater protection against their voices being used by AI.

The performers are asking Prime Minister Andy Burnham to introduce legislation which would give every person in the UK a legal right to own their voice.

Voice clones are created by training AI on recordings of real people. Quick versions can be made in minutes from a few seconds of audio, but high-quality copycats tend to require hours.

Audiobook narrator Alice Sockett, who co-founded the campaign, called it "an existential threat to our entire industry".

"My voice is out there in the public domain but completely unprotected," she said.

A government spokesperson told the BBC that, while "digital replicas can be a powerful tool, including for the creative industries," there was also possibility for harm.

"We value and protect human creators, and that is why we have announced we will launch a consultation on how we address these harms, while protecting legitimate innovation", the spokesperson said.

More than 80 performers have signed the letter, with Derry Girls actress Siobhán McSweeney saying she was "deeply worried" that the government was lagging behind.

"There is a way to work alongside AI and to use it as a tool that benefits us rather than rendering us obsolete," she said.

As well as actors, other signatories include those working in other performing industries.

That includes Scottish singer Sandi Thom, known for her 2006 hit I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker (With Flowers in My Hair).

She said she was signing the letter because her voice was "unique to me and was handed to me at birth".

"Behind that voice is the emotion, the life, the pain, the tears and joy that I've felt along the way," she said.

It comes a few months after lawyers warned UK legislation has become "unfit for purpose" because of the advancements of AI tech.

"The law comes close, but it doesn't fully protect your voice, your face or your identity," Dr Mathilde Pavis said in June .

However, some people - for example those who are unable so speak properly because of illness - have welcomed technology that can replicate a person's voice.

Yvonne Johnson, who lost her voice due to motor neurone disease, told the BBC's Tech Life programme in February how having it cloned by AI had "totally blown her mind", and brought her closer to her family, who had forgotten what she sounded like.

Others have gone a step further and used AI not only to replicate a person's voice, but to create a holographic representation of them.

Pam Cronrath, from Washington state, used the tech to surprise mourners at her husband's funeral, where a digital version of her deceased partner addressed those who attended his wake.

Sign up...
body.zh: 马特·卢卡斯、休·博纳维尔和尼古拉·考夫兰等演员已写信给英国政府，要求加强保护，防止他们的声音被人工智能使用。 表演者们要求首相安迪·伯纳姆提出立法，赋予英国每个人拥有自己声音的合法权利。 语音克隆是通过用真人录音训练人工智能来创建的。几秒钟的音频可以在几分钟内制作出快速版本，但高质量的模仿者往往需要几个小时。 该活动的联合创始人、有声读物旁白爱丽丝·索克特称其为“对我们整个行业的生存威胁”。 “我的声音在公共领域，但完全不受保护，”她说。 一位政府发言人告诉英国广播公司，虽然“数字复制品可以是一个强大的工具，包括创意产业”，但也有可能造成伤害。 该发言人表示：“我们重视并保护人类创造者，这就是为什么我们宣布将就如何解决这些危害，同时保护合法创新展开磋商。” 超过 80 名表演者签署了这封信，德里女孩 (Derry Girls) 女演员西奥布汉·麦克斯威尼 (Siobhán McSweeney) 表示，她“深感担忧”政府的滞后。 “有一种方法可以与人工智能一起工作，并将其用作使我们受益而不是让我们过时的工具，”她说。 除了演员之外，其他签署者还包括其他表演行业的工作人员。 其中包括苏格兰歌手 Sandi Thom，她因 2006 年的热门单曲《I Wish I Was a Punk Rocker》（《头发里有花》）而闻名。 她说她在这封信上签名是因为她的声音“对我来说是独一无二的，是我出生时就被赋予的”。 “这个声音的背后是我一路走来感受到的情感、生活、痛苦、泪水和喜悦，”她说。 几个月前，律师警告称，由于人工智能技术的进步，英国立法已变得“不适合其目的”。 “法律已经很接近了，但它并不能完全保护你的声音、你的脸或你的身份，”马蒂尔德·帕维斯博士在六月说道。 然而，有些人——例如那些因病而无法正常说话的人——对能够复制人声的技术表示欢迎。 伊冯·约翰逊 (Yvonne Johnson) 因运动神经元疾病失去了声音，她在二月份向 BBC 的《科技生活》节目表示，人工智能克隆了她的声音，“完全让她大吃一惊”，并拉近了她与家人的距离，而她的家人已经忘记了她的声音是什么样的。 其他人则更进一步，使用人工智能不仅可以复制人的声音，还可以创建他们的全息表示。 来自华盛顿州的帕姆·克朗拉特 (Pam ​​Cronrath) 在她丈夫的葬礼上使用这项技术给哀悼者带来惊喜，她已故伴侣的数字版本在葬礼上向参加葬礼的人们致辞。 报名...

reflection.en: The human voice is more than just a collection of frequencies; it is a unique signature of our personhood, crafted by Yahweh. When actors like Hugh Bonneville call for legal protection, they remind us that our biological identity is a gift to be honored, not a resource to be exploited. We must ensure that technology serves to enhance human dignity rather...
reflection.zh: 人的声音不仅仅是频率的集合，它是雅伟所塑造的我们人格的独特标志。当休·博内威利等演员呼吁法律保护时，他们提醒我们，我们的生理身份是值得尊重的恩赐，而不是可以随意开发的资源。我们必须确保技术是为提升人的尊严服务，而不是将我们“奇妙可畏”的特质贬低为纯粹的数字商品。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Singapore spending billions to adapt to climate change, but deforestation continues
title.zh: 新加坡斥巨资应对气候变化，但森林砍伐仍在继续

summary.en: Singapore is investing billions to adapt to climate change, yet deforestation persists. A public demonstration protested the environmental impact assessment for Maju Forest, arguing it overlooked climate and health effects of clearing the site, which is slated for development due to housing shortages.
summary.zh: 新加坡正投入数十亿资金以适应气候变化，但森林砍伐仍在继续。一场公众示威抗议了对马朱森林（Maju Forest）的环境影响评估，认为其忽视了清理该地点的气候和健康影响，而该地点因住房短缺而计划进行开发。

body.en: SINGAPORE — At a rare public demonstration against a state development plan, 22-year-old environmental studies student Saw Yun Ya called on the Singaporean government to redo an environmental impact assessment (EIA) for Maju Forest, arguing that it had overlooked the climate and health effects of clearing the site. The EIA for Maju, a 23-hectare (57-acre) patch of regenerating forest bordered by housing in central Singapore, was announced in July, prompting an unusually impassioned public backlash in the conservative city-state. Maju is one of several secondary forests facing development as the 744-square-kilometer (287-square-mile) city looks to address an acute housing crunch amid a growing population. Forests at Sembawang, Woodlands, Tengah and Gillman Barracks are also on the chopping block. Secondary forests cover about 16% of Singapore’s land area, having regrown over abandoned villages and plantations after much of the population was moved into high-rise housing from the 1960s. The island lost almost all of its primary forests in the British colonial era. Singapore’s EIAs assess the pollution, waste and biodiversity impacts of developing an area, and have identified critically endangered species such as the Sunda pangolin (Manis javanica) and straw-headed bulbul (Pycnonotus zeylanicus) at sites including Maju and Gillman Barracks. But residents and environmental groups say EIAs do not adequately account for the climate and health benefits provided by forests. A protester at a rally against deforestation on Aug. 16 holds a banner reading: “Know your enemy,” in reference to sites that could be used as alternatives to forest to build…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 新加坡——在一次罕见的反对国家发展计划的公开示威中，22 岁的环境研究学生苏云雅 (Saw Yun Ya) 呼吁新加坡政府重新对 Maju 森林进行环境影响评估 (EIA)，认为政府忽视了清理该地区对气候和健康的影响。 Maju 是新加坡中部一片 23 公顷（57 英亩）的再生森林，毗邻住宅区，其环境影响评估于 7 月宣布，在这个保守的城邦国家引发了异常激烈的公众强烈反对。 Maju 是数个面临开发的次生林之一，这座占地 744 平方公里（287 平方英里）的城市希望解决人口不断增长带来的严重住房危机。三巴旺、兀兰、登加和吉尔曼军营的森林也受到威胁。次生林覆盖了新加坡约 16% 的土地面积，自 20 世纪 60 年代起大部分人口搬进高层住宅后，次生林在废弃的村庄和种植园上重新生长。在英国殖民时代，该岛几乎失去了所有的原始森林。新加坡的环境影响评估评估了某个地区开发对污染、废物和生物多样性的影响，并在 Maju 和 Gillman 军营等地点确定了极度濒危物种，如巽他穿山甲 (Manis javanica) 和草头鹎 (Pycnonotus zeylanicus)。但居民和环保组织表示，环境影响评估没有充分考虑森林提供的气候和健康效益。 8 月 16 日，在反对砍伐森林的集会上，一名抗议者举着横幅，上面写着：“了解你的敌人”，指的是可以用作森林替代品的地点……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: As Singapore invests heavily in climate adaptation, the continued clearing of forests like Maju Forest raises questions about our stewardship of creation. The psalmist reminds us that the Earth is Yahweh's and all that is in it. This calls for a deeper consideration of how our development plans align with caring for the planet He has entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 新加坡正大力投资于气候适应，但像马朱森林这样的森林却在持续被砍伐，这引发了关于我们如何管理受造界的疑问。诗人提醒我们，地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。这呼吁我们更深入地思考，我们的发展计划是否与我们所受托的、照管这片土地的责任相符。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Thriving lichen-loving moth is an exception to the rule | Letter
title.zh: 繁盛的嗜石蛾是规则的例外 | 信

summary.en: Mark R Shaw states that airborne pollutants have caused a massive decline in insect numbers, in response to Nigel Brown’s understandable joy in finding a rosy footman moth in his trap (Country Diary, 25 August), which ends with “an important ecological message” that the substantial elimination of airborne sulphur...
summary.zh: 马克·R·肖（Mark R Shaw）表示，空气污染物已导致昆虫数量急剧下降，以回应奈杰尔·布朗（Nigel Brown）在他捕虫器中发现一只玫瑰色足蛾（rosy footman...

body.en: Mark R Shaw says airborne pollutants have caused a massive decline in insect numbers, in response to a Country Diary Nigel Brown’s understandable joy in finding a rosy footman in his moth trap ( Country diary, 25 August ) ends with “an important ecological message” that the substantial elimination of airborne sulphur dioxide pollution, which was devastating to the lichens and algae on which caterpillars of footman moths largely feed, has allowed recovery and even geographical spread. However, what might be a more realistic message is that the balance has changed in our major airborne pollutants since the 1990s, from sulphur dioxide to nitrogen oxides (a byproduct of internal combustion engines, among others), and this has benefited lichens and algae, which thrive under the current regime – and hence also footman moths as a special case. Continue reading...
body.zh: 马克·R·肖（Mark R Shaw）表示，空气中的污染物导致昆虫数量大幅下降，这是对《乡村日记》奈杰尔·布朗（Nigel Brown）在他的飞蛾陷阱中发现玫瑰色男仆的喜悦的回应（《乡村日记》，8月25日），其结尾是“一个重要的生态信息”，即空气中的二氧化硫污染的大幅消除（这种污染对地衣和藻类是毁灭性的，而男仆蛾的毛毛虫主要以这些藻类为食），从而实现了恢复甚至地理扩散。然而，更现实的信息可能是，自 20 世纪 90 年代以来，我们主要空气污染物的平衡发生了变化，从二氧化硫变为氮氧化物（内燃机等的副产品），这有利于地衣和藻类，它们在当前制度下蓬勃发展，因此也有利于步兵蛾作为一个特例。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The recovery of the rosy footman moth, detailed in this letter, is a testament to the resilience of creation when human impact lessens. The intricate relationship between the moth's caterpillars and the lichens they feed on, thriving once more as sulphur dioxide levels dropped, points to the delicate balance Yahweh designed into ecosystems. Even as new...
reflection.zh: 这封信中详细描述的玫瑰色足蛾的恢复，是当人类影响减小时，创造物韧性的证明。当二氧化硫水平下降后，这种蛾的幼虫与其赖以生存的地衣之间错综复杂的关系得以再次繁盛，这指向了雅伟在生态系统中设计的精妙平衡。即使出现了氮氧化物这样新的挑战，这个故事也提醒我们，自然界以其复杂性和相互关联性，反映了其创造者的智慧。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Environmental crimes don’t stop at borders. Neither can the reporting
title.zh: 环境犯罪不会止于边境，报道也不能停止

summary.en: High gold prices have fueled illegal mining across the Amazon. As Brazil tightened controls on the trade, criminal groups found another route through Venezuela, where it could be laundered and then exported overseas, according to a Mongabay investigation published last year. Documenting the trade required journalists...
summary.zh: 高金价助长了亚马逊地区的非法采矿活动。据《Mongabay》去年发布的一项调查显示，随着巴西收紧了对黄金贸易的管制，犯罪集团找到了通过委内瑞拉的另一条途径，在那里黄金可以被洗白，然后出口到海外。记录这种贸易需要三国记者的合作——正如 Daniela Quintero...

body.en: High gold prices have fueled illegal mining across the Amazon. As Brazil tightened controls on the trade, criminal groups found another route through Venezuela, where it could be laundered and then exported overseas, according to a Mongabay investigation published last year. Documenting the trade required journalists in three countries to work together—an approach Daniela Quintero considers essential because environmental crimes rarely respect national borders. Near the Mavicure Hills with residents of the El Venado Indigenous Reserve. Credit: Rhett A. Butler As investigations editor at Mongabay Latam, Bogotá-based Quintero develops projects that combine field reporting with official records, satellite imagery, scientific papers, and legal documents. She also coordinates Mongabay’s Nature Crimes Fellowship, working with journalists from Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru on investigations in the Amazon and the Pacific. Quintero previously covered environmental issues and worked in the investigative unit at El Espectador before joining Mongabay in early 2025. Her reporting has ranged from glass-eel fisheries in the Dominican Republic to the gold smuggling story. Ahead of Mongabay Latam’s PUMA FEST in July, I traveled with Quintero to Colombia’s Guainía department, where I interviewed her about her work and her path into environmental journalism. Daniela Quintero Diaz An interview with Daniela Quintero Mongabay: Can you introduce yourself? Daniela Quintero: I’m a Colombian journalist and sociologist based in Bogotá. I’m an investigations editor at Mongabay Latam, where I develop and edit cross-border investigations into nature crimes and environmental issues across Latin America. Mongabay: What does a normal day at Mongabay look like…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 高金价助长了亚马逊地区的非法采矿。根据去年公布的 Mongabay 调查显示，随着巴西加强对贸易的控制，犯罪团伙发现了另一条通过委内瑞拉的路线，可以在那里进行洗钱，然后出口到海外。记录这一贸易需要三个国家的记者共同努力——丹妮拉·金特罗 (Daniela Quintero) 认为这种方法至关重要，因为环境犯罪很少尊重国界。靠近 Mavicure 山，居住着 El Venado 土著保护区的居民。图片来源：Rhett A. Butler 作为 Mongabay Latam 的调查编辑，总部位于波哥大的 Quintero 开发了将现场报告与官方记录、卫星图像、科学论文和法律文件相结合的项目。她还协调 Mongabay 的自然犯罪奖学金，与哥伦比亚、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁的记者合作，在亚马逊和太平洋地区进行调查。 Quintero 曾报道环境问题，并在 El Espectador 的调查部门工作，然后于 2025 年初加入 Mongabay。她的报道范围从多米尼加共和国的玻璃鳗渔业到黄金走私故事。在 7 月 Mongabay Latam 的 PUMA FEST 之前，我与 Quintero 一起前往哥伦比亚的瓜伊尼亚省，在那里我采访了她，了解她的工作以及她进入环境新闻的道路。 Daniela Quintero Diaz 采访 Daniela Quintero Mongabay：您能介绍一下自己吗？ Daniela Quintero：我是一名居住在波哥大的哥伦比亚记者和社会学家。我是 Mongabay Latam 的调查编辑，负责对整个拉丁美洲的自然犯罪和环境问题进行跨境调查。 Mongabay：Mongabay 的正常一天是什么样的……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The illegal gold trade flowing through Venezuela reveals a breakdown in justice and accountability, as criminal networks exploit weak oversight for profit. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves not only acting justly but also loving mercy and walking humbly with Yahweh, a call to integrity that transcends borders.
reflection.zh: 非法黄金贸易经由委内瑞拉的流动，暴露了司法和问责制的失灵，犯罪网络利用监管薄弱牟取暴利。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义不仅在于行公义，还在于喜爱怜悯、谦卑地与雅伟同行，这是超越国界的正直呼召。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Ben Jennings on the end of the UK summer – cartoon
title.zh: 本·詹宁斯谈英国夏末——漫画

summary.en: This is a cartoon by Ben Jennings commenting on the end of summer in the UK.
summary.zh: 这是本·詹宁斯关于英国夏末的评论漫画。

reflection.en: As the seasons turn and summer gives way to autumn, we are reminded that all of creation, from the longest days of sunshine to the crisp air of fall, belongs to its Creator. The earth and all that is in it are a testament to Yahweh's enduring power and artistry. May we approach the changing seasons with gratitude, recognizing the divine hand that...
reflection.zh: 随着季节更替，夏末秋初，我们被提醒，从最长的日光到秋日清爽的空气，一切受造之物都属于其创造者。大地及其中的万物都证明了雅伟永恒的力量和艺术。 愿我们怀着感恩的心迎接季节的变化，认识到那安排自然循环、维系万物生命的属神之手。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Border area between Nepal and China where 33 Australians are missing still almost entirely cut off
title.zh: 尼泊尔和中国边境地区仍几乎完全与世隔绝，33名澳大利亚人失踪

summary.en: The majority of the missing Australians were near Gyirong Port minutes before the impact. Rescuers say the area is now destroyed, covered in meters of silt and debris. It has been almost a week since the catastrophic floods in Nepal, and not even a vehicle can access the area where most of the missing Australians were...
summary.zh: 失踪的澳大利亚人大部分在事发前几分钟还在吉隆港附近。救援人员称，该地区现已满目疮痍，被数米厚的淤泥和瓦砾覆盖。尼泊尔发生灾难性洪水已近一周，但仍无法有车辆进入大部分失踪澳大利亚人最后被听到消息的区域。尼泊尔和中国边境的吉隆港是首当其冲的地区。中国救援队拍摄的图像显示，该地区已被夷为平地，移民局大楼和电线杆等一切都被冲毁...

body.en: Majority of missing Australians were near Gyirong Port minutes before impact. Rescuers say the area is now destroyed, covered in metres of silt and debris Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast It has been almost a week since the catastrophic floods in Nepal and not even a vehicle can get into the area where the majority of missing Australians were last heard from. Gyirong Port, the border area between Nepal and China, was the first to be hit. Images from Chinese rescue teams who have managed to get in by helicopter or hiking show the area has been completely flattened. The immigration building, the power lines, everything, just wiped away. Continue reading...
body.zh: 大多数失踪的澳大利亚人在撞击发生前几分钟就在吉隆港附近。救援人员表示，该地区现已被摧毁，覆盖着数米厚的淤泥和碎片。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 尼泊尔灾难性洪水已经过去近一周了，甚至没有车辆可以进入大多数失踪澳大利亚人最后消息所在的地区。尼泊尔与中国边境地区的吉隆口岸首当其冲。中国救援队通过直升机或徒步抵达的图片显示，该地区已完全被夷为平地。移民大楼、电线，一切，都被夷为平地。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The earth itself groans, bearing the weight of natural disasters and human suffering. In the wake of devastating floods that have flattened communities and left dozens missing, we see creation's vulnerability. Amidst the silt and debris, may we remember that Yahweh is with those who grieve and that He promises a future where creation is renewed.
reflection.zh: 大地本身也在呻吟，承受着自然灾害和人类苦难的重负。在毁灭性的洪水摧毁了社区并导致数十人失踪之后，我们看到了受造界的脆弱。在淤泥和瓦砾之中，愿我们记念雅伟与那些哀痛的人同在，并且祂应许一个受造界更新的未来。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Gold miners breach a crucial refuge for rescued Sumatran orangutans
title.zh: 金矿工人闯入苏门答腊猩猩救助的关键保护区

summary.en: Illegal gold miners in Indonesia's Aceh province have breached a crucial reintroduction forest for critically endangered Sumatran orangutans rescued from the illegal wildlife trade. Monitoring indicates dozens of excavators are suspected of operating in the Jantho forest area, which was established by the government...
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚亚齐省的非法金矿工人闯入了为从非法野生动物贸易中获救的濒危苏门答腊猩猩设立的关键重新引入森林。监测显示，据信有数十台挖掘机在该省最大的环保组织印尼环境论坛（Walhi）的宣传和倡导负责人阿菲夫丁称，亚齐省的占托森林地区活动。该地区是印尼政府在占托自然保护区内建立的猩猩重新引入区，已有15年历史。

body.en: JANTHO, Indonesia — Illegal gold miners in Indonesia’s Aceh province have breached a crucial reintroduction forest for critically endangered Sumatran orangutans rescued from the illegal wildlife trade. “The result of our monitoring indicates that maybe dozens of excavators are suspected of operating in the Jantho forest area,” said Afifuddin, campaign and advocacy lead at the provincial chapter of the Indonesian Forum for the Environment (Walhi), the country’s largest environmental pressure group. The Indonesian government established the Jantho orangutan reintroduction area more than 15 years ago within the wider protected forest known as the Jantho Nature Reserve. Jantho is located in Aceh province, on the northern tip of Sumatra. There were no Sumatran orangutans (Pongo abelii) living in what is now the Jantho reintroduction forest when conservationists began releasing animals there in 2011. Since then, the Sumatran Orangutan Conservation Programme (SOCP), which works with the Indonesian government on the reintroduction effort, has released nearly 200 orangutans into the forest. It remains one of the country’s most successful release sites for the critically endangered great apes. The Jantho sanctuary was chosen for reintroduction due to its habitat of fig trees, a key food source for orangutans, and proximity to the Leuser Ecosystem, which is home to most of the Sumatran orangutans that remain in the wild. Forest near Jantho. Image by Rhett A. Butler/Mongabay. Rainforest river near Jantho. Image by Rhett A. Butler/Mongabay. However, new analysis by Walhi’s Aceh chapter found that approximately 14 hectares (35 acres), of the Jantho Nature Reserve…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 印度尼西亚杰托——印度尼西亚亚齐省的非法金矿开采者破坏了一片至关重要的放归森林，这些森林是从非法野生动物贸易中解救出来的极度濒危苏门答腊猩猩的栖息地。 “我们的监测结果表明，可能有数十台挖掘机涉嫌在 Jantho 森林地区作业，”印尼环境论坛 (Walhi) 省分会的活动和宣传负责人阿菲夫丁说，该论坛是该国最大的环境压力团体。 15 年前，印度尼西亚政府在更广泛的森林保护区（称为 Jantho 自然保护区）内建立了 Jantho 猩猩重新引入区。 Jantho位于苏门答腊岛北端的亚齐省。 2011 年，自然资源保护主义者开始在现在的 Jantho 放归森林中放生苏门答腊猩猩 (Pongo abelii) 时，这里已经没有苏门答腊猩猩 (Pongo abelii) 了。自那时起，与印度尼西亚政府合作开展放归工作的苏门答腊猩猩保护计划 (SOCP) 已将近 200 只猩猩放归到森林中。它仍然是该国最成功的极度濒危类人猿放归地之一。选择 Jantho 保护区进行重新引入是因为这里栖息着无花果树，这是猩猩的主要食物来源，而且靠近 Leuser 生态系统，该系统是大多数野生苏门答腊猩猩的家园。 Jantho 附近的森林。图片来源：Rhett A. Butler/Mongabay。 Jantho 附近的雨林河。图片来源：Rhett A. Butler/Mongabay。然而，Walhi 亚齐分会的新分析发现，Jantho 自然保护区的面积约为 14 公顷（35 英亩）……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The earth and all its inhabitants belong to Yahweh, yet human greed leads to the destruction of precious habitats. The intrusion of excavators into the Jantho forest, a sanctuary for endangered orangutans, serves as a stark reminder of our responsibility to care for creation. May we recognize that these spaces are not ours to exploit, but are entrusted to...
reflection.zh: 雅伟拥有大地及其一切。然而，人类的贪婪导致了宝贵栖息地的破坏。挖掘机闯入占托森林——一个濒危猩猩的庇护所——这鲜明地提醒我们有责任照顾受造物。愿我们认识到这些地方不是供我们剥削的，而是托付给我们去精心管理的。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: As Death Toll From Nepal Flood Rises, Officials Call to Tackle Warming
title.zh: 尼泊尔洪水死亡人数上升，官员呼吁应对气候变暖

summary.en: Five days after a devastating flood swept through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to rise. Authorities reported on Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, with another 4,247 missing, as the country grapples with a disaster experts suggest may be linked to melting glacial ice.
summary.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦地区发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数持续攀升。当局周一报告称，已有903人确认死亡，另有4247人失踪，该国正努力应对一场专家认为可能与冰川融化有关的灾难。

body.en:
Five days after a calamitous flood washed through Rasuwa, Nepal, the death toll continues to climb. Authorities said Monday that 903 people have been confirmed dead, while another 4,247 are missing, as the country reels from a disaster that experts say may be linked to the melting of glacial ice.

Officials believe the collapse of a glacier on Langtang Lirung peak sent an avalanche of ice and rock careening into a valley below, where it blocked the flow of the Trishuli River. When the rock barrier finally gave way, they say, it unleashed a rush of water and mud several stories high. The floodwaters inundated villages along the river, not just in Nepal but also in neighboring Tibet, where 16 people are confirmed dead and another 546 are still missing, according to Chinese state media.

Researchers with the HiRisk project, which tracks threats from melting ice in the Himalayas, say that the shrinking and thawing of glaciers may have fueled the disaster. Over the last three decades, Nepali mountains have lost roughly a third of their ice , the U.N. says. The glacier on Langtang Lirung retreated roughly 1,500 feet between 1990 and 2020, and experts say the loss of ice may have left the slope more vulnerable to a landslide.

Further upping the risk of collapse was a warm spell that melted snow atop Langtang Lirung in the days before the flood. “That snowmelt had to go somewhere – and it may have supplied the water that lubricated the rockfall,” said Umesh Haritashya , a geoscientist at the University of Dayton.

The upper Himalayas are warming nearly twice as fast as the global average, experts say, and August is the warmest time of year in the region. “While scientists are still studying the exact causes of this disaster, it is exactly the type of event that is triggered by climate change,” said Wouter Buytaert , a hydrologist at Imperial College London.

U.N. climate chief Simon Stiell said in a statement that a warming climate “is making tragedies like this one, and so many others around the world, much more likely, frequent, and severe, with vulnerable communities often hardest hit.”

In a press conference on Saturday, Nepal’s foreign minister, Shisir Khanal, called on countries to address warming. “We’d ask the world,” he said, “to take climate change as one of the major challenges that Nepal and its citizens face, and this has to be a global effort.”
body.zh: 尼泊尔拉苏瓦发生灾难性洪水五天后，死亡人数继续攀升。当局周一表示，已确认 903 人死亡，另有 4,247 人失踪，专家称这场灾难可能与冰川融化有关，该国正遭受这场灾难的困扰。 官员们认为，Langtang Lirung峰上的冰川崩塌导致雪崩，冰块和岩石倾泻到下面的山谷中，阻塞了Trishuli河的水流。他们说，当岩石屏障最终崩溃时，它释放出了几层楼高的水和泥浆。据中国官方媒体报道，洪水不仅淹没了尼泊尔，还淹没了邻近的西藏沿河村庄，已确认 16 人死亡，另有 546 人失踪。 HiRisk项目的研究人员追踪喜马拉雅山冰川融化的威胁，他们表示，冰川的缩小和融化可能加剧了这场灾难。联合国称，在过去三十年里，尼泊尔山区大约失去了三分之一的冰。 1990 年至 2020 年间，Langtang Lirung 上的冰川后退了大约 1,500 英尺，专家表示，冰的消失可能使斜坡更容易发生山体滑坡。 洪水发生前几天，Langtang Lirung 山顶的积雪融化，进一步增加了塌陷的风险。代顿大学地球科学家乌梅什·哈里塔什亚 (Umesh Haritashya) 表示：“融雪必须流向某个地方，它可能提供了润滑落石的水。” 专家表示，喜马拉雅山上游的变暖速度几乎是全球平均水平的两倍，而八月是该地区一年中最温暖的时间。伦敦帝国理工学院水文学家 Wouter Buytaert 表示：“虽然科学家仍在研究这场灾难的确切原因，但这正是气候变化引发的事件类型。” 联合国气候变化负责人西蒙·斯蒂尔在一份声明中表示，气候变暖“正在导致像这样的悲剧以及世界各地许多其他悲剧发生，而且发生的可能性更大、更频繁、更严重，脆弱社区往往受到的打击最严重。” 在周六的新闻发布会上，尼泊尔外交部长希西尔·卡纳尔呼吁各国应对气候变暖问题。 “我们要求世界，”他说，“将气候变化视为尼泊尔及其公民面临的主要挑战之一，而这必须是全球的共同努力。”

reflection.en: The earth groans, as the Apostle Paul wrote, and this flood in Nepal is a stark reminder of that reality. The melting glacier that likely triggered this disaster points to the deep interconnectedness of our world and the impact of environmental changes on vulnerable communities. May we heed the calls to address warming and care for the creation entrusted to...
reflection.zh: 正如使徒保罗所写，万物都在一同叹息，而尼泊尔的这场洪水正是这一现实的严峻提醒。可能引发这场灾难的冰川融化，揭示了我们世界深刻的相互联系，以及环境变化对脆弱社区的影响。愿我们听从应对气候变暖的呼吁，并照管那托付给我们的受造之物。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: ‘It was like fighting a dinosaur’: Sydney shark attack survivor recalls left hook that helped save her life
title.zh: “就像在与恐龙搏斗”：悉尼鲨鱼袭击幸存者回忆用左勾拳救了自己一命

summary.en: Leah Stewart, who lost an arm after a shark attack at Sydney's Coogee beach, described punching a four-meter great white shark as it lunged at her. She recounted asking herself 'which limb am I willing to lose' as she fought back against the predator.
summary.zh: 在悉尼库吉海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击并失去一条手臂的莉亚·斯图尔特（Leah Stewart）描述了她如何用一记“左勾拳”击退一条四米长的巨鲨。她回忆说，在与鲨鱼搏斗时，她问自己“我愿意失去哪条肢体”。

body.en: Leah Stewart, who was bitten while swimming at Coogee beach, says she asked herself ‘which limb am I willing to lose’ as she fought back An Australian woman who lost an arm after a shark attack at a Sydney beach has described delivering a “left hook” punch to the four-metre great white as its open mouth came within centimetres of her face. Leah Stewart, 34, a teacher and mother of a one-year-old, was attacked by the shark while on a morning swim at Coogee beach in Sydney’s eastern suburbs on 13 June. Continue reading...
body.zh: 莉亚·斯图尔特(Leah Stewart)在库吉海滩游泳时被咬伤，她在反击时问自己“我愿意失去哪一条肢体”。一名在悉尼海滩遭遇鲨鱼袭击后失去手臂的澳大利亚妇女描述，当鲨鱼张开的嘴距离她的脸只有几厘米时，她向这条四米长的大白鲨打出了“左勾拳”。 34 岁的 Leah Stewart 是一名教师，也是一名一岁孩子的母亲，6 月 13 日，她在悉尼东郊库吉海滩晨泳时遭到鲨鱼袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Leah Stewart’s harrowing encounter with a great white shark highlights the primal instinct for survival when faced with overwhelming danger. Her courageous fight back, even as she contemplated losing a limb, speaks to the human spirit’s capacity to resist and overcome when confronted by forces that threaten to consume it. It reminds us that even in the face...
reflection.zh: 莉亚·斯图尔特与大白鲨惊心动魄的遭遇，凸显了在面对压倒性危险时，人类最原始的生存本能。她勇敢地反击，甚至在思考失去肢体的可能时，也展现了人类精神在面对威胁要吞噬自己的力量时的抵抗和克服能力。这提醒我们，即使面对巨大的邪恶，求生和为生命而战的意志也可以是一种强大的力量。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Country diary: For the gannets of Bass Rock, it’s a slow road to recovery | Lev Parikian
title.zh: 乡村日记：巴斯岩上的塘鹅，复苏之路漫漫 | 列夫·帕里基安

summary.en: North Berwick, East Lothian: As I admire the aerial feats of house martins in Tantallon Castle, my eye is drawn across the water. The sign asks us not to disturb the birds. Understandable. It’s easy to miss the nests a couple of feet above your head until your hair’s parted by an incoming house martin.
summary.zh: 北伯威克，东洛锡安：当我欣赏坦塔隆城堡中白鹇的空中技艺时，我的目光被吸引到水面。标志要求我们不要打扰鸟类。可以理解。很容易错过头顶几英尺处的巢穴，直到你的头发被一只飞来的白鹇掠过。

body.en: North Berwick, East Lothian: As I admire the aerial feats of house martins in Tantallon Castle, my eye is drawn across the water The sign asks us not to disturb the birds. Understandable. It’s easy to miss the nests a couple of feet above your head until your hair’s parted by an incoming house martin. They slalom the red sandstone ruins, metallic blue flashes in the morning sun. Occasionally one jinks up to the corner, disappears into the nest to meet the needs of demanding mouths, emerges and darts away again, a sleek silhouette against a backdrop of water. Continue reading...
body.zh: 北贝里克，东洛锡安：当我欣赏坦塔伦城堡中家燕的空中壮举时，我的目光被水面吸引了。标志要求我们不要打扰鸟类。可以理解。很容易错过头顶几英尺处的巢穴，直到你的头发被即将到来的家貂分开。他们在红色砂岩废墟上进行回转，在早晨的阳光下闪烁着金属般的蓝色。偶尔，一只会跳到角落里，消失在巢穴中以满足挑剔的嘴巴的需求，然后再次出现并飞走，在水的背景下形成光滑的轮廓。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author observes the swift, precise movements of house martins, a testament to the intricate design woven into the fabric of creation. These birds, navigating their environment with such skill, remind us that the natural world itself speaks of its Creator's wisdom and power. In their effortless flight, we see a glimpse of the divine artistry that...
reflection.zh: 作者观察到白鹇鸟敏捷而精准的飞行，这是造物界精巧设计的明证。这些鸟类以如此娴熟的技巧驾驭着它们的环境，提醒我们大自然本身就彰显着其创造者的智慧与大能。在它们毫不费力的飞翔中，我们瞥见了维系万物的神圣艺术。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: In Africa, a Growing Underground Solar Boom
title.zh: 非洲地下太阳能蓬勃发展

summary.en: Households and businesses across Africa are driving a significant, yet largely unrecorded, solar energy boom. This rapid expansion of rooftop arrays and small-scale systems is pushing new solar installations to record levels, despite often being overlooked in official statistics.
summary.zh: 非洲各地的家庭和企业正在推动一场规模可观但大多未被官方记录的太阳能热潮。屋顶太阳能板和其他小型系统的迅速普及，正将新增太阳能装机量推向创纪录水平，尽管这些数据常被官方统计所忽视。

body.en:
Households and businesses are driving a solar boom in Africa, where rooftop arrays and other small systems account for the bulk of new solar installations. But this rapid buildout, which is driving solar additions to record levels, is largely unaccounted for in official statistics, analysts say.

“The rapid spread of distributed solar in sub-Saharan Africa is an underreported success story,” write analysts at the energy think tank Ember and the African Tech Futures Lab. “However, since African countries are running blind to this change, they are not reflecting this rise in distributed solar in their plans.”

Because most distributed solar systems are not tracked or regulated, most households cannot sell their surplus power back to the grid, analysts say. Ultimately, the lack of data on distributed solar could lead countries to underinvest in the batteries and grid infrastructure needed to store and distribute solar energy, and to overinvest in fossil fuels.

Because official statistics are lacking, analysts used customs data to track the flow of solar equipment to Africa from China, the biggest manufacturer of solar panels globally. They found that Africa will add the equivalent of 17 gigawatts of solar capacity this year, more than enough to meet the continent’s average yearly growth in demand. Some 36 countries will install record volumes of solar in 2026, while 19 will install more than twice as much solar as they did last year.

In countries with rickety power grids, many people rely on diesel generators to cope with recurrent blackouts. But analysts say the Iran war has pushed up diesel prices, making solar a more attractive alternative. “Generating the same electricity from a diesel generator as from a solar panel would cost as much in diesel, every three months, as the solar panel itself,” they write. In almost every country in Africa, more than half of solar capacity installed since 2023 is distributed, analysts estimate.

“This transition is chaotic and disruptive, and far from the orderly model planned in national strategies,” said Joel Nana, research director at African Tech Futures Lab. “The choice now is whether these distributed assets remain a parallel power system that compensates for grid failure or are integrated in ways that unleash a wider range of benefits.”
body.zh: 家庭和企业正在推动非洲太阳能热潮，其中屋顶阵列和其他小型系统占新太阳能装置的大部分。但分析人士表示，这种快速建设将太阳能发电量推向创纪录水平，但官方统计数据很大程度上没有考虑到这一点。 能源智库 Ember 和非洲科技期货实验室的分析师写道：“分布式太阳能在撒哈拉以南非洲的迅速普及是一个被低估的成功故事。” “然而，由于非洲国家对这一变化视而不见，他们没有在计划中反映分布式太阳能的增长。” 分析师表示，由于大多数分布式太阳能系统没有被跟踪或监管，因此大多数家庭无法将剩余电力卖回电网。最终，缺乏分布式太阳能数据可能导致各国对存储和分配太阳能所需的电池和电网基础设施投资不足，并对化石燃料投资过度。 由于缺乏官方统计数据，分析师利用海关数据来追踪从全球最大太阳能电池板制造商中国流向非洲的太阳能设备。他们发现，非洲今年将新增相当于 17 吉瓦的太阳能装机容量，足以满足非洲大陆年均增长的需求。到 2026 年，约 36 个国家的太阳能安装量将创历史新高，其中 19 个国家的太阳能安装量将是去年的两倍多。 在电网不稳定的国家，许多人依靠柴油发电机来应对经常性的停电。但分析人士表示，伊朗战争推高了柴油价格，使太阳能成为更具吸引力的替代方案。他们写道：“每三个月用柴油发电机产生与太阳能电池板相同的电力，柴油成本与太阳能电池板本身一样多。”分析师估计，自 2023 年以来，非洲几乎每个国家安装的太阳能发电量一半以上都是分布式的。 非洲科技未来实验室研究主任乔尔·纳纳表示：“这种转变是混乱和破坏性的，与国家战略中规划的有序模式相去甚远。” “现在的选择是，这些分布式资产是否仍然是一个并行电力系统，以补偿电网故障，或者以释放更广泛效益的方式进行集成。”

reflection.en: The 'underground solar boom' in Africa, where households and businesses are rapidly adopting small-scale systems, highlights a profound human capacity for discernment and innovation. As people seek practical solutions for their energy needs, they embody the wisdom of acquiring knowledge and applying it to improve daily life, even when official recognition...
reflection.zh: 非洲“地下太阳能热潮”中，家庭和企业迅速采用小型系统，这凸显了人类卓越的洞察力和创新能力。当人们寻求实用的能源解决方案时，他们体现了获取知识并将其应用于改善日常生活的智慧，即便官方认可迟迟未到。这种足智多谋的精神反映了人类深入理解和利用周围世界以造福自身的内在动力。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: The Black Garden review – haunting study of growing up in war-torn Nagorno-Karabakh
title.zh: 《黑花园》评论——对在战火纷飞的纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫长大的孩子的凄美研究

summary.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict. After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless...
summary.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米扬的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔和阿沃两个十岁出头的男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地被残酷的冲突所伤害。苏联于1991年解体后，一场持续数十年的领土争端在纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发，当地主要是亚美尼亚人口与阿塞拜疆军队进行了无数次军事战役的斗争。这部影片拍摄历时三年，于2023年纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政...

body.en: Alexis Pazoumian’s documentary follows Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys whose lives will be unavoidably scarred by brutal conflict After the Soviet Union collapsed in 1991, a decades-long territorial dispute exploded in the region of Nagorno-Karabakh, as its largely Armenian population fought against countless military campaigns from the Azerbaijani army. Shot over the course of three eventful years, which culminated in the surrender of Nagorno-Karabakh’s separatist government in 2023 , Alexis Pazoumian’s haunting documentary harnesses the collective turmoil that dominated generations of Armenians. From the elderly to the very young, the community are united by an unwavering sense of pride, one that carries them through never-ending bloodshed and displacement. The film opens with the harrowing sight of a bombed-out school in the small village of Talish, where childlike innocence contrasts with wartime trauma. Samvel and Avo, two preteen boys, roam through the wreckage and scavenge for remains of past normalcy, like the scattered notebooks left behind by their former classmates. The threat of the enemy, however, is drilled into every aspect of their daily life. At school, they learn how to assemble guns, and at family gatherings, they join in songs that speak of heroic valour. That the children here – boys and girls – will grow up to become soldiers is a foregone conclusion. Continue reading...
body.zh: 亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 的纪录片讲述了萨姆维尔 (Samvel) 和阿沃 (Avo) 这两个青春期男孩的故事，他们的生活将不可避免地因残酷的冲突而受到创伤。 1991 年苏联解体后，纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫地区爆发了长达数十年的领土争端，该地区主要是亚美尼亚人，与阿塞拜疆军队的无数军事行动进行了斗争。亚历克西斯·帕祖米安 (Alexis Pazoumian) 这部令人难忘的纪录片历时三年多的时间拍摄，最终导致纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫分离主义政府于 2023 年投降，讲述了统治几代亚美尼亚人的集体动乱。从老年人到年幼的孩子，社区都以一种坚定不移的自豪感团结在一起，这种自豪感使他们经历了永无休止的流血和流离失所。影片以塔利什小村庄一所被炸毁的学校的悲惨景象开始，孩子般的纯真与战时的创伤形成鲜明对比。萨姆维尔和阿沃是两个青春期前的男孩，他们在废墟中漫步，寻找过去常态的遗迹，比如他们以前的同学留下的散落的笔记本。然而，敌人的威胁渗透到他们日常生活的方方面面。在学校，他们学习如何组装枪支，在家庭聚会上，他们一起唱颂英雄勇气的歌曲。这里的孩子们——男孩和女孩——长大后成为士兵已成定局。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The documentary "The Black Garden" brings to light the profound impact of war on children, focusing on Samvel and Avo. Their young lives are shaped by conflict, a stark reminder of the voiceless who bear the brunt of adult disputes. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute."...
reflection.zh: 纪录片《黑花园》揭示了战争对儿童的深远影响，聚焦于萨姆维尔和阿沃。他们年幼的生活被冲突所塑造，这鲜明地提醒我们那些承受着成人争端重担的无声者。《箴言》31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能自辩的开口，为所有困苦者判定公正”。这部影片有力地证明了这一呼召，敦促我们铭记并倡导那些卷入全球冲突战火中的儿童。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

summary.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film,

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

reflection.en: José Mourinho's documentary is critiqued for his unwillingness to truly open up, despite the public platform it offers. This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: The Isaac Mizrahi Documentary ‘Unzipped’ Is the Ultimate ’90s Fashion Portrait — Watch the Trailer
title.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》是终极的90年代时尚肖像——观看预告片

summary.en: Douglas Reeve's 1995 documentary follows Mizrahi into his 1994 fall collection. Access was helped amply by the fact that they were dating at the time.
summary.zh: 道格拉斯·里夫1995年的纪录片跟随米兹拉希进入他1994年的秋季系列。由于当时他们正在约会，因此获得了充分的便利。

body.en:

Filmmaker Douglas Keeve’s 1995 documentary “ Unzipped ” follows fashion designer and eventual mogul Isaac Mizrahi, then the director’s boyfriend, into his fall 1994 collection. The ’90s-centric movie remains the ultimate portrait of New York’s high fashion world at the time, with guest appearances including Cindy Crawford, Naomi Campbell, Linda Evangelista, and Kate Moss. Plus, the film won the audience award at the 1995 Sundance Film Festival. Now, Janus Films is bringing the movie back to theaters courtesy of a new restoration. Watch the trailer below.

Here’s the synopsis courtesy of Janus Films: “Designer Isaac Mizrahi proved a force of nature on the road to his legendary fall 1994 collection, a career-defining triumph that was documented with an effervescent intimacy by Douglas Keeve, Mizrahi’s then-partner. Both a time capsule of the buoyant, raucous 1990s, when pop culture and high art became interchangeable, and a vérité-style, in-the-trenches report on the daily agonies and ecstasies of the creative process, this seminal artistic portrait — sumptuously shot by Ellen Kuras and Robert Leacock — transcends glitz and glamour to offer an extraordinary view of the charisma and force of will inherent to genius, as well as its personal costs.” Related Stories ‘Coyote vs. Acme,’ Viewed as Unreleasable by Warner Bros., Just Beat a Jacob Elordi and Ridley Scott Movie at the Box Office From Timothée Chalamet and Tom Cruise to Cynthia Erivo: It’s Time for Some Overdue Actors to Finally Win an Oscar

Charli XCX recently told Vogue : “Directed by Douglas Keeve, it follows Isaac Mizrahi as he gets ready for his New York Fashion Week collection. If you love fashion, you have to see this documentary. All the legends are there — Kate, Naomi, Christy — and even Galliano and Polly Mellen. But most importantly, the film perfectly captures the artist’s creative process: bursts of inspiration, self-doubt, vulnerability, and finally, triumph.”

Janus Films opens “Unzipped” on Friday, September 25 at Film Forum in New York City. Then, the film opens in Los Angeles at the Laemmle Royal and Glendale on Friday, October 9. A national rollout will follow. The Sundance Institute and UCLA Film & Television Archive digitally restored the film.

body.zh: 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商也可能处理您的信息以帮助提供我们的服务。本网站受 reCAPTCHA Enterprise 保护，并适用 Google 隐私政策和服务条款。 电影制作人 Douglas Keeve 于 1995 年拍摄的纪录片《Unzipped》讲述了时装设计师、后来的大亨 Isaac Mizrahi（当时是导演的男友）走进他 1994 年秋季系列的故事。这部以 90 年代为中心的电影仍然是当时纽约高级时尚界的终极写照，客串包括辛迪·克劳馥、娜奥米·坎贝尔、琳达·伊万格丽斯塔和凯特·莫斯。此外，该片还获得了1995年圣丹斯电影节观众奖。现在，杰纳斯电影公司正在通过新的修复将这部电影带回影院。观看下面的预告片。 Janus Films 提供的概要如下：“设计师 Isaac Mizrahi 在 1994 年秋季系列的传奇之路上证明了自然的力量，这是一场定义职业生涯的胜利，Mizrahi 当时的合作伙伴 Douglas Keeve 热情洋溢地亲密记录了这一胜利。这既是一个充满活力、喧闹的 1990 年代的时间胶囊，当时流行文化和高雅艺术可以互换，也是一个这幅开创性的艺术肖像画由艾伦·库拉斯 (Ellen Kuras) 和罗伯特·利科克 (Robert Leacock) 精心拍摄，以真实风格、现场报道的方式记录了创作过程中日常的痛苦和狂喜，超越了浮华和魅力，以非凡的视角展示了天才固有的魅力和意志力，以及其个人成本。”相关故事雷德利·斯科特讲述从《塞尔玛与路易丝》到《狗明星》的爱情故事，用 11 个摄像机拍摄，以及为什么沉默是最好的音效《起义》认为需要罗宾汉，但农民的起义已经足够令人兴奋 Charli XCX 最近告诉《Vogue》：“这部由 Douglas Keeve 执导的影片讲述了 Isaac Mizrahi 为纽约时装周系列做准备的故事。如果你热爱时尚，你一定要看看这部纪录片。所有的传奇人物都在其中——Kate、Naomi、Christy——甚至 Galliano 和 Polly Mellen。但最重要的是，这部电影完美地捕捉了艺术家的创作过程：灵感的爆发、自我怀疑、脆弱，以及最后的胜利。” Janus Films 将于 9 月 25 日星期五在纽约电影论坛上放映《Unzipped》。然后，影片将于 10 月 9 日星期五在洛杉矶的莱姆勒皇家和格伦代尔上映。随后将在全国上映。圣丹斯学院和加州大学洛杉矶分校电影电视档案馆对这部电影进行了数字修复。 提供您的信息，即表示您同意我们的使用条款和隐私政策。我们使用的供应商...

reflection.en: The documentary 'Unzipped' offers a glimpse into the intense dedication and creative labor behind Isaac Mizrahi's 1994 fall fashion collection. It showcases the passion and effort poured into bringing a vision to life, reminding us that all work, whether in design or any other field, can be offered as a service to God.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《Unzipped》让我们得以一窥艾萨克·米兹拉希1994年秋季时装系列背后倾注的专注和创造性劳动。它展示了将一个愿景变为现实所付出的热情和努力，提醒我们，所有工作，无论是在设计领域还是其他任何领域，都可以作为对雅伟的服事。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

body.zh: 由尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导的电影，他们与巴塞尔·阿德拉 (Basel Adra) 和哈姆丹·巴拉尔 (Hamdan Ballal) 联合执导了《No Other Land》，调查了“以色列在战争期间有计划地大规模屠杀巴勒斯坦平民”。一部关于以色列在加沙的轰炸行动的新纪录片，由奥斯卡获奖导演尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕 (Yuval Abraham) 和雷切尔·索尔 (Rachel Szor) 执导，由《卫报》制作，将在威尼斯电影节上进行全球首映。这部名为《NAZA》的影片由吉姆·威尔逊 (Jim Wilson) 制作，并由《兴趣地带》(The Zone of Interest) 背后的团队乔纳森·格雷泽 (Jonathan Glazer) 担任监制，也是今年唯一一部角逐威尼斯著名金狮奖的纪录片。继续阅读...
